Job Description

• Industry/ Organization Type: Wholesales and Retail Clothing Industry

• Position Title: Sales & Retail Support Manager

• Working Location: Central – Bugis (Walking distance from the company to MRT)

• Working Hours: 5 days / Mon-Fri: 8.45am-5.30pm

• Salary Package: Up to SGD 5000 + Variable Bonus

• Duration: Permanent

•

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and curate attractive product assortments to propose to external stakeholders in support of in-store events.

• Conduct market research and recommend new business opportunities and ideas for service improvements to drive profitability.

• Ensure service and operational excellence by establishing and enforcing organizational standards across the sales team.

• Deliver product training to Retail Promoters and ensure they are equipped with the necessary product knowledge.

• Ensure the sales team adheres to the company's SOPs and policies.

• Oversee product displays and POP (Point of Purchase) materials, including price and product tags, ensuring compliance with company and departmental store guidelines.

• Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders by providing timely support, guidance, and communication.

• Prepare and present weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing relevant data.

• Monitor and manage healthy inventory levels across retail stores.

• Assist with stock movements and event setups (e.g., setting up wagons), including the flexibility to travel between stores as needed.

• Mentor and support the sales team by providing solutions, answering procedural and technical queries, and promoting skills development.

• Oversee daily retail operations including inventory processing, logistics coordination, and team support including weekends when necessary.

• Develop and implement sales strategies, collaborate closely with the sales team to meet targets, and lead monthly sales meetings.

• Support the Merchandising Team with stock-taking activities and ensure compliance with company SOPs related to stock movement.

• Carry out any other ad-hoc duties as assigned.

•

APPLY NOW!!!

• Min.3 years of working experience as a Sales manager in the retail industry

• Proven background in retail sales, preferably with experience managing retail outlets or department store counters

• Candidates with prior experience overseeing departmental counters in major retail establishments such as Takashimaya, CK Tangs, or Isetan will be highly preferred

• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Especially Excel and PowerPoint), PS (Photoshop) or Al (Adobe Illustrator) will be added advantage

• Must be willing to work late hours when required, especially during event setups and teardowns.

•

Kindly apply through ANY of the following methods:

• Submit your application by clicking the APPLY button;

• Email your resume to Job@anradus.com.sg. Please indicate #79648 on the email subject.

description:
Job Descriptions
Corporate and Institutional Banking Japan Graduate Programme
What you can expect
Whether your degree relates to finance, science or the arts there is a place for you on our Corporate and Institutional Banking (“CIB”) Graduate Programme. Your skills and fresh ideas will help you establish an exciting career in a Corporate Banking role.
Our CIB business is one of the largest banking businesses of its kind. We offer 24-hour coverage of local markets and provide a full range of banking services to our clients. You can expect to work on exciting projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and interact with clients and colleagues around the world to create and offer innovative solutions to our clients.
CIB manages HSBC’s largest clients and delivers comprehensive solutions to complex strategic and capital market challenges. You will trade ideas and strategies, and interact with a broad range of clients, from multinational corporates to private equity firms. It’s a career choice that requires dedication, but one that will give you many rewards in return.
What you will do
Corporate Banking : You will gain first-hand experience of how our relationship managers, working closely with our product specialists, create innovative solutions to meet the banking needs of our largest corporate and institutional clients. You will have a chance to understand how we build trusted relationships with our clients, gain a great overview of the breadth of products HSBC can offer and see how we respond to our clients’ need by deploying these products into tailored solutions across multiple countries. You will also see how we help the Bank manage the risk inherent from dealing with these clients, to ensure we foster a sustainable business model.
A dynamic, challenging and diverse environment with on-the-job learning and structured development lies ahead of you. There will be many opportunities to develop your network of contacts within CIB 　 and beyond. You’ll also be able to take part in our sustainability initiatives. Our volunteering programme, Diversity & Inclusion activities, for example, could help you to develop new skills, while contributing to the communities in which we work.
As well as your immediate team, we have Employee Resource Groups ( “ ERGs ” ), also known as networks. They are similar to the clubs and societies that you may have had access to at school, college or university. ERGs are voluntary employee-led groups. Our employees lead eight global networks to promote diversity within the bank [ http://www.hsbc.com/our-approach/diversity-and-inclusion/employee-networks ] : Ability, Balance, Embrace, Faith & Belief , Generations, Nurture , Pride and Strive . We also have common interest groups that connect employees on a variety of different topics. They are open to all employees.
We offer a market-competitive pay and benefits package according to your role and location.
Learning and development
We offer a high-quality learning and development programme. You will begin your rotation program in Tokyo for up to 18 months which consists of a combination of on-the-job training as well as a series of e-learning courses. The on-the-job training is comprised of rotating through teams within the CIB business , which may include relationship coverage, product s , risk management, and client services . JSDA qualification will be required by the end of the programme.
We’ll provide the support, tools and opportunities for you to drive your own career development. Your training will be carefully structured, with events and other opportunities to build your wider HSBC and banking knowledge. You’ll have regular access to business leaders for coaching and advice, while constructive feedback will enable you to measure your performance.
Career paths
If you succeed here, you could continue the work you’re doing in Corporate Banking where you’ll have the opportunity to take your career in a number of directions. This may include taking on international opportunities or working across multiple products and geographies, while feeding your curiosity and developing an understanding of how we can best serve our clients.
Who does this suit?
We are looking for dedicated and courageous people who are:
Passionate role models. Being able to inspire, lead, manage and listen to both individuals and teams is important in building relationships that encourage mutual respect. Looking to the future for our clients is what keeps us ahead of our competition.
Dedicated multi-task players. You might be working on several projects at any one time, meaning you should prioritize and manage your time, while keeping on top of constantly changing markets. Adhering to the rules and regulations we have will ensure you deliver the right results for multiple projects.
Supportive and open-minded team players. Teamwork is an important part of our business, and your development. Having a collaborative attitude and open to feedback will help you solve problems quickly and start to build a network of peers who are there to support you and be supported too.
Opportunity takers. We are an international company that can offer opportunities to motivated, courageous people. Taking on a challenging project will not only be rewarding but will also show that you have the power to explore your interests and drive your career growth.
Intellectual curiosity. Our CIB business has a unique breadth of products in terms of what we offer and where we offer these solutions. Being curious will help you explore new perspectives, build deeper understanding, and accelerate your learning.
Independent and discipline d worker. Ways of working constantly evolv es and we expect flexibility and adaptability to work effectively in different situations.

Q ualifications
The base location for this role is Tokyo.
Open to graduates in 2026, or recent graduates with 1-2 years of working experience and bachelor degree or above from a reputable university.
Fluent in English and Japanese, both written and verbal.

At HSBC we are open to different ideas and cultures, connected to our customers, communities and each other, and dependable, we do the right thing. These are the values that guide us every day. We seek to recruit people who share these values and will help us to sustain them.

Eligible candidates will be invited for next stage

Value-Based Assessment

Complete within 14 days of invitation

Candidates must choose to test in ‘Japanese’ Language

Complete within 10 days of invitation

On-Demand Video

Record responses to a series of questions to understand your motivation, communication style and potential fit

Complete within 10 days of invitation

Interview

Short-listed candidates will be invited for interviews with the hiring team

06

Offer

Successful candidates will receive official employment offer

The APAC Risk team helps Stripe launch and grow products responsibly across a diverse and rapidly evolving region. We work closely with global and regional partners across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Partnerships, and Risk to identify emerging risks, define practical controls, and make risk decisions easier to execute at scale.

The team supports Stripe’s growth in APAC by combining deep regional context with strong analytical judgment. We assess how fraud patterns, payment methods, user behavior, market structures, and regulatory expectations vary across countries. We use those insights to build strategies that protect Stripe and the broader payments ecosystem while preserving a strong experience for legitimate users.

What you’ll do

As a Fraud Strategist on the APAC Risk team, you will be responsible for identifying and reducing transaction and merchant fraud across Stripe’s products and markets in the region. You will monitor the health of Stripe’s APAC portfolio, investigate emerging threats, and build scalable strategies that reduce losses without creating unnecessary friction for legitimate businesses.

You will work on complex and fast moving problems where the available information is often incomplete and fraud patterns evolve quickly. Your work may range from investigating an anomalous fraud trend to designing a regional control, defining a model feature, improving a manual review workflow, or shaping the risk approach for a new product, payment method, or country launch.

Responsibilities

• Monitor transaction and merchant fraud trends across APAC and investigate anomalous behavior at the merchant, account, and transaction level.

• Define, build, and maintain regional fraud health metrics. Set targets, identify material changes, and communicate the drivers of performance.

• Develop short and long term fraud strategies for APAC markets, products, and payment methods. Translate investigations into clear controls, product requirements, model improvements, and operational actions.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Partnerships, and other Risk teams to scope, prioritize, and deliver fraud mitigation work.

• Assess fraud risks for new country, product, and local payment method launches. Define mitigations before launch and monitor outcomes after launch.

• Balance fraud loss, user experience, operational cost, conversion, and growth when recommending or implementing controls.

• Improve and automate fraud risk workflows through data, internal tools, and agent based solutions where these can increase consistency, speed, or coverage.

• Work with users and external partners when needed to explain fraud risks, improve controls, and support a healthy payments ecosystem.

• Produce clear regional reporting for senior stakeholders, risk governance forums, and other internal audiences.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, analytically strong, and comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situations. You investigate unusual patterns until you understand the underlying mechanism. You can turn data and domain context into a clear risk decision, then work across teams to make that decision operational.

You understand that effective fraud strategy is not simply about reducing losses. It requires thoughtful tradeoffs between protection, growth, user experience, and operational complexity. You communicate those tradeoffs clearly and remain open to new evidence and feedback.

Minimum requirements

• 4 - 8 years of relevant experience in fraud strategy, payments risk, financial services, fintech, trust and safety, data, or a related field.

• Experience investigating fraud or other risk patterns using account and transaction data.

• Strong analytical judgment and the ability to frame business decisions and tradeoffs through quantitative analysis.

• Intermediate SQL skills and experience applying SQL in a business environment.

• Experience defining metrics, assessing performance, and translating analysis into practical recommendations.

• Experience partnering with technical and operational teams such as Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, or Partnerships.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex risk issues to technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to drive execution across teams with different priorities.

• Sound decision making in ambiguous or time sensitive situations, with a willingness to learn and iterate as new evidence emerges.

• Empathy for legitimate users and an ability to balance scaled risk controls with user experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with transaction fraud, merchant fraud, account takeover, or abuse in an online payments environment.

• Experience working across APAC markets or with regional payment methods and local market structures.

• Advanced SQL skills or experience with quantitative tools such as Python, R, or Stata.

• Experience partnering with machine learning or Data Science teams on model features, rules, detection, or measurement.

• Experience assessing fraud risk for new products, payment methods, or country launches.

• Experience designing risk controls, monitoring frameworks, operational workflows, or policy.

• Experience using automation, AI tools, or agent based workflows to improve risk processes.

• Experience in a fast moving environment where threats, products, and priorities change quickly.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. The Global Self-Serve Product team's goal is to make Stripe the #1 self-serve financial infrastructure provider for users outside the U.S. We drive product-led growth for the millions of users who adopt Stripe without a sales relationship, and we own self-serve activation goals across our ex-US business.

We're a cross-functional team of Engineers, Data Scientists, Growth Marketing Managers, Designers, and Product Managers, organized around three focus areas:

• Growing our self-serve domestic business across a portfolio of our core, mature markets

• Growing cross-border self-serve business across the next wave of emerging markets and launching bespoke registration, onboarding and upsell pathways for new markets

• Raising the bar on the quality of the localized experience of our international users by building and improving our localization platform at scale

About the role

Most of Stripe's future users outside the US will never speak to a salesperson—they'll discover, sign up, and scale on Stripe entirely on their own. Getting that self-serve journey right, in every market and language, is one of the biggest growth opportunities ahead of us.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own self-serve activation and growth across our ex-US business. You'll set the strategy for how we win self-serve users in international markets and then make it real—turning funnel data and customer insight into a sequenced roadmap, and shipping the experiments and features that move the metrics.

The right person for this role thinks like a growth PM and a founder: you're fluent in funnels and experimentation, you have genuine taste for 0-to-1 product, and you move fast under ambiguity. You bring deep user empathy to localizing Stripe with contextual relevance, and you think in systems and platforms—turning experimental features into scaled growth levers

• Own the self-serve growth roadmap: identify the highest-leverage opportunities to grow activation across our ex-US markets, and build the case for investment

• Build a deep understanding of our customers—from bootstrapped solopreneurs to well-funded founders—synthesizing funnel metrics, experiment results, and time in the product into sharp hypotheses about what will drive growth

• Partner with engineering to ship—you'll drive specs, prioritization, and execution with a high degree of hands-on involvement, and run experiments to build conviction in your roadmap

• Scale what works: take wins proven in small samples and roll them out through our localization and recommendation platforms, so the right experience reaches each market and use case

• Collaborate with Stripe's global product teams to ensure regional needs are reflected in platform decisions, and advocate for regional investment at the right moments

Who you are

• You have 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent shipping 0-to-1 products

• You reason from first principles—breaking ambiguous growth problems down to fundamentals, forming a sharp point of view, and moving fast under uncertainty with the ownership of a founder

• You're data-savvy: fluent in funnels, metrics, and experimentation, you let the numbers sharpen your instincts, and you know when a test earns conviction and when it only adds noise

• You have strong product taste and are technically comfortable—you sweat the details of a localized experience (message clarity, contextual guidance) and can engage credibly with engineers on API design and system tradeoffs

• You're an exceptional communicator—verbal and written—who can influence without authority across a matrixed organization

• You're based in Singapore or have a strong reason to be

Why Stripe

Stripe is still early in its presence outside the US, which means the person in this role will have genuine influence over how we show up in some of the world's most important emerging markets. You'll have the scope of a startup with the resources of a company that processes hundreds of billions of dollars a year.

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Why you should join the Adyen Sales Team

Sales at Adyen is captured with one phrase: we sell the best to the best. You will have the opportunity to work alongside world-class salespeople and boost your career by being trained through our Adyen Sales Academy. You'll work with world-class merchants, technology, and colleagues while selling the best to the best.

At Adyen, our sales teams take initiatives, allowing them to make an impact from day one and we highly encourage working as a team because winning is more important than ego. Adyen is the place where sales mavericks can take flight.

Being able to tell stories is fundamental to how we operate. Our team is fantastic storytellers when speaking to prospective and current clients to foster excitement about our product and strengthen customer relations. We are looking for a sales manager who will succeed aboard the Adyen rocket ship and take our current successful momentum to the next level of growth through the acquisition of new (Enterprise) merchants.

Sounds exciting? Keep reading!

What You’ll Do

• Own the sales cycle with our largest merchants - from the prospecting stage to closing deals;

• Creatively drive innovation for merchants in retail, digital, platforms, and financial services;

• Become an expert in selling Adyen's world class financial solutions;

• Partner with technology leaders and solution providers while working closely with our Sales Support, Implementation and Account Management teams;

• Travel and network (~25%);

Who You Are

• You have high levels of energy, love networking, connecting and thrive in hands-on environments.

• Proven experience in an enterprise sales role (5+ years) selling complex solutions;

• You are a team player who enjoys working with a global team across different offices, roles, and cultures;

• You are an analytical, strategic negotiator with a commercially driven, goal-getting attitude

• You have the ability to execute, manage time-sensitive tasks in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment;

• Working in the financial space against large banking institutions is a challenge, so these individuals should be prepared to educate and pitch transparently with a consultative approach;

• You are an industry specialist with solid experience in selling into retail / hospitality / e-commerce / gaming or other consumer centric industry where payments happens.

• Fluency in Japanese and business level English is required.

Ready to meet us?

If you are excited about this role, apply by clicking the link below. We can’t wait to meet you!

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based out of our Tokyo office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

• High-Visibility Impact: Work directly alongside APAC commercial leads and global leadership to shape and scale the regional channel strategy from the ground up.

• Strong understanding of how financial technology is embedded and deployed (APIs, core banking platforms, payment gateways).

• Familiarity with regional regulatory frameworks and banking ecosystems across Southeast Asia, India, and APAC.

• Comprehensive understanding of Correspondent banking product and solutions

• Experience working directly with Tier 1 or Tier 2 banks or at large fintechs in an enterprise environment.

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the team

• As a key digital asset hub, Singapore is an integral part of our global strategy. Licensed by MAS, OKX SG is focused on providing Singapore users with a secure and user-friendly platform for trading digital assets.

• The Commercial team is responsible for developing and deepening relationships with high-value individual and institutional clients, understanding their needs, and connecting them with relevant products and solutions across the OKX ecosystem.

About the Opportunity

• We are seeking an experienced Assistant Relationship Manager to support our Relationship Managers in delivering a responsive, seamless experience for high-value clients in Singapore.

• You will take ownership of client preparation, day-to-day servicing, follow-up, and internal coordination across the client lifecycle. This includes ensuring RMs are well prepared for client conversations, agreed actions are completed promptly, and client requests are handled with care and professionalism across Product, Operations, Compliance, and other internal teams.

• This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who understands the expectations of sophisticated clients, anticipates what needs to be done, and follows through reliably. Success requires strong attention to detail, sound judgement, and a high level of ownership in ensuring both RMs and clients receive consistent, high-quality support.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Client & Meeting Preparation
- Prepare concise client briefs covering relationship history, account activity, outstanding requests, and relevant discussion points, ensuring RMs are well prepared for client conversations.
- Coordinate meeting agendas, materials, and logistics, and conduct client or prospect research as required.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, ensuring relevant information is readily accessible to RMs.

•
Onboarding & Account Support
- Guide clients through onboarding and account maintenance, clearly communicating documentation requirements, next steps, and progress.
- Coordinate KYC and account-related requests with Operations and Compliance, checking submissions for completeness and following up on outstanding information.
- Drive operational blockers towards resolution, recognising when matters require RM involvement or specialist review and escalating promptly.

•
RM Enablement & Process Improvement
- Maintain CRM records, action trackers, and reporting so RMs have clear visibility of client priorities and outstanding actions.
- Develop knowledge of OKX products and processes to independently handle routine enquiries and anticipate information RMs may need.
- Identify recurring service issues and improve workflows to reduce administrative burden, strengthen follow-through, and improve the overall client experience.

• Commercial Support
- Support RMs with research and preparation for prospective high-value clients, including understanding their business, trading or investment needs, and relevant market developments.
- Support prospect follow-up and progression through the sales process, coordinating agreed next steps and maintaining momentum.
- Where appropriate, support targeted outreach and initial client engagement under the direction of RMs.

What We Look For In You

•
5+ years of experience in financial services, fintech, crypto, wealth management, institutional sales, client servicing, or another relevant commercial environment.

•
Strong interest in crypto and financial markets, with the curiosity and ability to develop deep product knowledge quickly.

•
Commercially minded and confident engaging directly with clients, with the ambition to develop into an independent Relationship Manager.

•
Experience supporting HNW/UHNW, family-office, institutional or other sophisticated clients, including complex account structures and time-sensitive instructions.

•
Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple client requests and ensure issues are driven through to resolution.

•
Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to use client and activity data to identify commercial opportunities.

•
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across clients and internal stakeholders.

•
Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

•
Fluency in English and Mandarin is required

Competitive total compensation package

•
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

Various team building programs and company events

Wellness and meal allowances

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

Overview
Lease Planning Manager
Provide planning, scheduling, and schedule assurance support for Microsoft leased data center construction projects across the SEA region.

Responsibilities
Roles and Responsibilities

• Perform monthly review and assessment of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) submitted by Lease Providers (LPs), validating schedule credibility, critical path integrity, logic sequencing, durations, progress updates, and overall schedule health.

• Conduct schedule compliance reviews to ensure Lease Provider schedules align with Microsoft Lease Schedule specifications, reporting expectations, and provide guidance to drive compliance improvements.

• Develop independent schedule forecasts and delivery outlooks using planning methodologies such Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA), trend/interpolation analysis, and progress performance assessment.

• Identify, analyse, and communicate schedule risks, delay indicators, critical path concerns, float erosion, and potential delivery impacts to project teams and management.

• Update Microsoft IMS in the P6 EPPM following the set data schema, making sure the BL, UD and Microsoft RFS dates are updated.

• Cross check the data analytics such as TSR scorecard, duration benchmark, variance or others available in the AI tools or platform to make sure they reflect the correct status and all the data available

• Review pre-award / SOQ project schedules and high-level delivery plans submitted by prospective Lease Providers, providing independent assessment on schedule realism, feasibility, and risk exposure. Ensure the schedule reflects the full scope of work.

• Support management decision-making through schedule analytics, forecasting, reporting, and recommendations across active and pipeline lease projects.

• Engage with Lease Providers or internal Microsoft stakeholders to clarify schedule assumptions, resolve planning issues, and improve schedule quality and consistency.

• Provide portfolio-level planning support across multiple projects within the SEA region, including schedule benchmarking, trend analysis, and regional delivery insights.

• Validate LP baseline schedules within 30 days of lease execution to confirm compliance with LIP requirements, fit-out integration, and milestone maturity.

• Align early with CIA-Lease, DCBM, ITIM, LCM, and project teams on schedule readiness, milestone movements, and decision support.

• Establish creditability as a trusted advisor across functions, driving alignment by ensuring all project dates are centrally governed and communicated by planning lead as single source of truth.

• Maintain governance for RFS and RNI milestone movements by documenting root cause, developer negotiation context, and leadership alignment.

• Ensure fit-out scope is fully integrated into lease schedules and aligned with build sequencing, dependencies, and downstream impacts.

• Validate milestone and RNI movements using critical path logic so that schedule changes are supported before approval.

• Partner with DCBM to assess delay legitimacy, claims, mitigation options, and present a One Microsoft position in developer engagement.

• Microsoft IMS schedule updates and milestone confidence assessments.

• Portfolio heat maps and dashboard updates reflecting health status, forecast trends, and regional insights.

Overview
Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) is the business unit responsible for operating Microsoft’s cloud and the Datacenter Construction Delivery (DCD) team is responsible for constructing datacenter capacity. We have a portfolio of complex, multi-disciplinary, multi-million, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects underway. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for an individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services.

The role of the Lease Delivery Manager (LDM) requires interpersonal, communication, organizational skills, ability to self-direct, background in datacenter design, engineering, controls, operational requirements, managing teams and vendors, and an emphasis on project/construction management.

The Lease Delivery Manager is ultimately responsible for the complete project delivery of Ready for Service (RFS) for each lease site location. The LDM is responsible for ensuring that each project meets the Data Center Development (DCD) guidelines and standards, which may be adjusted from time-to-time based on best practices and Lesson Learned drawn from previous projects as well as industry changing best practice. In addition, LDM will be responsible for ensuring that the lease provider is complying with the Microsoft requirements in the lease contract when delivering a project.

The LDM will coordinate with Microsoft’s Subject Matter Experts (SME) and stakeholders to support the efforts of achieving RFS for each lease datacenter sites. The LDM will manage the deliveries of projects from lease execution through RFS. In managing the delivery of projects, this position aligns team objectives, business processes, vendor management strategies, and cross-group collaboration efforts with the Data Center Development Project Strategy.

The LDM will be a relentless advocate for managing a safe worksite. Safety is one of the four pillars of CO+I’s mission in delivering cloud capacity; joined by Quality, Schedule adherence, and Cost Management. In addition, this position will be responsible in reviewing potential lease sites providing preconstruction expertise and assisting site selection teams in providing feedback on lease provider’s qualifications.

このポジションは、ディスカバリーセッションをリードし、価値ベースのセリングを活用しながら、お客様固有の優先事項とユースケースを通じて、測定可能なビジネス成果を提供していきます。またSSEには、プレゼンテーションやデモを行い、お客様がServiceNowのD&Aソリューションへの投資に確信を持てるよう支援する技術的な対応力が必要です。
この役割で担当すること

• コアのAccount Executiveと共同で主担当を務め、商談創出から受注、継続的な活用まで、D&Aのセールスサイクルをエンドツーエンドでリードする。

• 担当アカウントに対して、D&Aポートフォリオ全体（Workflow Data Fabric、RaptorDB Pro、Data Apps、Autonomous Data-Analyticsなど）を担当し、販売する。

• ServiceNowのD&Aソリューションを、お客様のAI、リアルタイムアナリティクス、データ戦略の基盤として位置付ける戦略的なD&Aアカウントプランを策定する。特に既存ServiceNow顧客における新規ビジネスの創出に注力する。

• AI、データ、アナリティクスに関する技術的な対応力。エグゼクティブ、ServiceNow Platform Owner、データ＆アナリティクスのリーダーに対して、信頼性のあるディスカバリー、価値訴求、ユースケース特定を行い、プレゼンテーションとデモを実施できること。

• 従量課金型モデルの経験、および初回販売後のお客様の活用拡大を推進した経験。

• 自ら進んで行動し、実務にも深く関与できるソートリーダーとして、スピード感のある製品・営業・GTM環境で業務を遂行できること。

• 技術部門とビジネス部門の双方のステークホルダーに対する、優れたコミュニケーション能力と関係構築力。

• 主要な購買担当者に加えて、第二の購買担当者またはインフルエンサーを開拓するなど、アカウント内で複数の部門や関係者との接点を構築した実績。

• AI関連ソリューションの提案経験。

• Tableau、ThoughtSpot、Power BI、Qlik、Oracle AnalyticsなどのアナリティクスまたはBIの知見または販売経験。

description:
会社概要
すべての始まりは2004年、カリフォルニア州の陽光あふれるサンディエゴで始まりました。革新的なエンジニアであるフレッド・ラディが、働き方を変革できる可能性を見出したのです。
それから今日まで、ServiceNowはグローバル市場のリーダーとして、革新的なAI強化テクノロジーを8,100社以上のお客様に提供し、その中にはFortune 500に選ばれた企業が85％程含まれています。
当社のインテリジェントなクラウドベースプラットフォームは、人・システム・プロセスをシームレスにつなぎ、組織がよりスマートで迅速、そして優れた働き方を実現できるよう支援します。
しかし、これは私たちの旅の始まりに過ぎません。世界をより良く働ける場所にするという目的を追求する私たちと共に歩みませんか？

Solution Sales Executiveは、Moveworksを含むServiceNowのAIを活用したEmployee ExperienceおよびCorporate Services領域において、日本市場の中で担当テリトリーのビジネス成長をリードするポジションです。 Account Executiveをはじめとする社内外の関連チームと連携し、担当テリトリーにおける新規営業機会の創出と案件獲得に責任を持ち、経営層向けの価値提案からクロージングまでを推進します。
日本企業の従業員が、必要な情報を探し、問い合わせを行い、支援を受け、業務を実行する体験をAIによって変革するとともに、人事、経理・財務、調達購買、総務・ワークプレイス、法務などのCorporate Services領域における業務変革を支援します。
お客様の経営層や各業務部門のリーダーと対話し、経営・業務課題をAI、Employee Experience、Core Business Workflowsを活用した変革機会へと発展させ、具体的なユースケース、Business Outcome、ROIへつなげていくSolution Salesとしての役割を担います。
また、MoveworksをはじめとするServiceNowがグローバルおよび日本で培ってきたAIイノベーション、成功事例、ベストプラクティスを日本企業へ展開し、日本企業のニーズや市場環境に合わせた価値提案へと発展させていきます。
GlobalのProduct、Go-to-Marketチームやパートナーとも密接に連携し、日本のお客様から得られたフィードバックをGlobalへ還元するなど、日本とGlobalをつなぎながら、AI時代の新しいEmployee Experienceと働き方を実現していくポジションです。
主な役割

• MoveworksおよびHRSD、S2PなどのCore Business Workflowsを含むAI-powered Employee ExperienceおよびCorporate Services領域において、担当テリトリーのビジネス成長をリードし、新規営業機会の創出と案件獲得に責任を持つ

• 担当テリトリーの市場特性やお客様の優先課題を理解し、重点ユースケース、重点アカウント、競合環境を踏まえた成長戦略を策定・実行し、新たな営業機会を創出する

• 日本企業の経営層、IT部門や各業務部門のリーダーとの対話を通じて、経営・業務課題を深く理解し、AIやWorkflow Automationによる変革機会とユースケースを創出するとともに、従業員生産性、従業員体験、業務効率、サービス品質などのBusiness OutcomeやROIにつながる価値提案・ビジネスケースを構築する

• 他社のEnterprise AIソリューションに関する知識を有し、それらとServiceNowとの連携や役割の違いを理解した上で、ServiceNowおよびMoveworksの差別化された価値を、お客様の課題やニーズに即して明確に訴求する

• Account Executive、Solution Consultant、Specialist Solution Consultant、パートナーおよびその他の専門チームと連携し、複数のステークホルダーが関与する営業活動を推進する

• パイプラインの管理とフォーキャストを適切に行い、案件の進捗とリスクを可視化して、Account Executiveや関連チームと共有する

• お客様やAccount Team、関連チームと継続的に連携し、導入後に期待するBusiness Outcomeを明確化するとともに、そのValue Realizationに向けた活動を支援する

• グローバルおよび日本で蓄積されたMoveworksおよびServiceNowの顧客成功事例、ユースケース、ベストプラクティスを活用し、日本市場に適した価値提案やSales Playへと発展させる

• GlobalのProductおよびGo-to-Marketチームと連携し、日本企業のお客様から得られたニーズやフィードバックをGlobalへ還元する

• マーケティングイベントやお客様向けExecutive Sessionの企画・講演などを通じて、AI時代のEmployee ExperienceおよびCorporate Services Transformationに関するServiceNowの価値を市場へ発信する

• 多様性を尊重し、オープンでインクルーシブな環境づくりに貢献する

• エンタープライズ向けSaaS／ソフトウェアのSolution Sales、Consulting、Business Transformation、またはそれに類するCustomer-facing roleにおける5年以上の経験

• 担当テリトリーの市場や顧客特性を踏まえて重点領域やユースケースを定め、Account Executiveと連携して、新規開拓または既存拡張における営業機会の創出から案件推進までをリードした実績

• お客様の経営層、Business Leader、IT Leaderなどとの対話を通じて、経営・業務課題を深く理解し、具体的な変革機会やユースケースを創出し、Business Outcomeと定量・定性効果、ROIを踏まえた価値提案やビジネスケースへと発展させた経験

• MEDDICC等のセールス手法に基づく案件管理・フォーキャストの経験

• 人事、経理・財務、調達購買、総務・ワークプレイス、法務などのCorporate Services領域のうち、少なくとも一つの領域における深い知識または実務経験

• Enterprise AIに関する製品、市場、テクノロジー、主要なユースケースに関する十分な知識

• 複数のお客様や案件、社内外のステークホルダーとの活動を並行して進めながら、ビジネスインパクトや緊急性に基づいて優先順位を適切に判断し、状況を自ら捉えて、必要なアクションをプロアクティブかつタイムリーに実行した経験

• 日本語：ネイティブレベル

英語：Globalチームとの会議に参加して意見を伝えられ、メール、資料の読み書きを含む業務上のコミュニケーションが可能なレベル

• 出張：必要に応じて国内外への出張あり（目安：20%程度）

歓迎要件

• AI、AI Agent、Enterprise Search、Conversational AI、Workflow Automation、Digital Workplaceなど、Enterprise AIに関連するソリューションの販売または導入経験

• 新しいテクノロジーやSolution領域において、ユースケース、Sales Play、Partner Motion、Go-to-Market Strategyなどを開発・展開した経験

• 英語：GlobalのProduct / Go-to-Marketチームとのディスカッションをリードできるビジネスレベル

勤務条件

• 勤務地：東京

• レポートライン：Core Business Workflows Director

• 勤務形態：ハイブリッド

このポジションの魅力
このポジションでは、AI × Employee Experience × Corporate Servicesという、企業変革の中心的なテーマに携わることができます。
日本市場の中で担当テリトリーを持ち、日本企業の経営層や各業務部門のリーダーと、これからの従業員体験や働き方について上流から議論します。自ら重点領域やユースケースを考え、Account Executiveとともに新たな営業機会を創出し、AIを活用した新しい業務のあり方をお客様と構想していきます。
また、Moveworksをはじめ、ServiceNowがグローバルおよび日本のお客様と培ってきたInnovation、Customer Success、Best Practiceをより多くの日本企業へ展開するとともに、日本のお客様から得られる知見をGlobalのProduct Teamへ直接フィードバックする機会があります。
さらに、マーケティングイベントやExecutive Sessionにおける企画・講演など、自身の専門性を活かしてServiceNowの価値を市場へ発信する機会もあります。
Solution Selling、Business Transformation、AI、Corporate Servicesの専門性を高めながら、自ら担当テリトリーのビジネス成長をリードし、Globalとも連携して日本企業への価値提供を拡大していけることが、このポジションの大きな魅力です。

私たちは、テクノロジーと人の力がともに発揮される「AIネイティブ」なカルチャーを築いており、その挑戦はまだ始まったばかりです。 AIを人のために活かす未来を、私たちと一緒に創りませんか。

ServiceNowのCRMは、問い合わせを記録するだけのCRMではありません。フロントからバックオフィスまでをひとつのプラットフォームとワークフローでつなぎ、問い合わせを最後まで解決するCRMです。AIが答えるだけでなく、実際に業務を動かして解決する。この点がAI時代のCRMに欠かせない条件だと、私たちは考えています。
日本でも、幅広い業界の大企業で、顧客接点を担うミッションクリティカルなDXプロジェクトへの採用が続いています。この成長に合わせて、CRM Japanでは営業チームを拡大し、営業マネージャーのポジションを新設します。欠員補充ではなく、新しいチームを一から立ち上げていただくポジションです。
営業マネージャーは、CRMセールスエクゼクティブのチームを率いて、担当テリトリーでの新規ビジネスを大きく伸ばす役割です。戦略づくりから、メンバーの採用・育成、お客様の経営層との対話、重要案件のクロージングまでをリードしていただきます。チームと事業の両方を自分の手でつくりたい方、変化の速い環境を楽しめる方を歓迎します。

このポジションで担っていただくこと

• CRM セールスエクゼクティブのチームを率い、担当テリトリーでの新規ビジネスを大きく伸ばしていただきます

• Sales Operationsと連携し、市場や競合の状況、テリトリーでの自社の立ち位置を踏まえて、営業戦略を立てて実行します

• テリトリープランの策定、顧客との関係づくり、商談の創出に自ら関わります。メンバーの商談クロージングを支援し、売上を伸ばします

• チームメンバーを採用し、コーチングやメンタリングを通じて育成します

• メンバーごとのテリトリーと目標を設計し、期待する成果を明確に伝えます

• フォーキャストとパイプラインを正確に管理し、経営に報告します

• 四半期ごと、年間の売上目標の達成に責任を持ちます

• お客様の経営層との対話にServiceNowのエキスパートとして参加し、経営課題の解決にServiceNowがどう役立つかを伝えます

• CRMソリューションコンサルタント、テクニカルサポート、プロフェッショナルサービス、法務、Sales Operations、マーケティング、経営陣など、社内の関係部門と連携してビジネスを進めます

このポジションで活躍するために必要な経験・スキル

• 業務プロセスや意思決定、課題解決にAIを活用した経験、またはAIの活用可能性について具体的に検討した経験。AIを活用したツールの利用、ワークフローの自動化、AIによるインサイトの分析、担当領域や業界にAIが与える影響の検討などを含みます

• CRMやCXソリューションを販売するテクノロジー企業で、営業チームを3年以上率いた経験

• 営業チームの採用、育成、マネジメントで高い成果を上げた経験

• 顧客の経営課題や業務課題に対して、AIを活用した課題解決の提案をリードした経験

• 日本市場において、テクノロジーソリューションの高い成長率の実現や新規開拓に関わる豊富な実績

• 経営層へのプレゼンテーションや交渉の経験

• 目標を達成し、さらに上回るための戦略的な思考力。分析力と数字に基づく計画力

• 営業プロセスをリードし、Sales Operationsと連携してビジネスを進めた経験

• IT導入の背景にあるお客様のビジネス課題や経営の視点を理解する力

• 経営層などシニアな立場の方と、長期的な信頼関係を築ける力

• 変化が速く、成長中の環境でも柔軟に成果を出せること

• ビジネスレベルの英語力

• ビジネスと財務についての確かな理解

私たちは、テクノロジーと人の力がともに発揮される「AIネイティブ」なカルチャーを築いており、その挑戦はまだ始まったばかりです。 AIを人のために活かす未来を、私たちと一緒に創りませんか。

ServiceNowのCRMは、問い合わせを記録するだけのCRMではありません。フロントからバックオフィスまでをひとつのプラットフォームとワークフローでつなぎ、問い合わせを最後まで解決するCRMです。AIが答えるだけでなく、実際に業務を動かして解決する。この点がAI時代のCRMに欠かせない条件だと、私たちは考えています。
日本でも、幅広い業界の大企業で、顧客接点を担うミッションクリティカルなDXプロジェクトへの採用が続いています。この成長に合わせて、CRM Japanではセールスエグゼクティブを複数名、純増で採用します。
CRMセールスエグゼクティブは、ServiceNowのCRMの市場での成功を牽引する営業職です。これらの製品は、ServiceNow AI Platform上に構築された営業管理、CPQ、オーダー管理、カスタマーサービス管理、フィールドサービス管理といった広範な業務機能を有しています。「CRM built to finish the work」というスローガンのもと、AIネイティブで、あらゆる顧客の要望や問い合わせを「解決」することができる、強力なワークフロー製品群です。

担当アカウントおよび/またはテリトリーにおける四半期・年間の売上目標の達成に向けて、以下の業務を担当いただきます。

• 担当テリトリーにおける営業戦略の策定(ターゲット企業リストの作成、営業計画の立案を含む)

• 経営層・CxOとのエグゼクティブミーティングの設定・実施。ソリューションコンサルタントおよび関連チームと緊密に連携し、ServiceNowのCRMソリューションを示すデモンストレーションを提供

• お客様の現在および将来のCX/営業・サービス変革のロードマップを深く理解し、信頼されるアドバイザーとしてServiceNowプラットフォームの活用を推進

• コアセールスチーム(アカウントエグゼクティブ、ソリューションコンサルタント、リーダーシップ)および他のソリューションエリアと緊密に連携し、お客様や見込み顧客にCRMのソリューションを提供

• 担当アカウントエグゼクティブおよびソリューションコンサルタントと協力し、CRM ソリューションの提案を、見込み顧客、既存のお客様、パートナー、業界イベントやセミナーで直接実施

• 担当テリトリーのServiceNowパートナーチャネルを支援し、お客様にとって最適な体験を実現

• カスタマーサクセスのための戦略を顧客担当チームに共有し、プラットフォームのプレゼンテーションやバリュープロポジションの標準化・効率化を推進

• セールスおよびパートナーエコシステム向けのセールスイネーブルメント

• インサイドセールスからの支援が限られた環境での、見込み顧客の選定と新規商談・継続的な収益源の創出

• 営業プロセスの管理と案件のクロージング

• お客様の満足度向上と追加収益の創出に向けた、継続的なアカウントマネジメント

この役割で成功するために、以下の経験・スキルをお持ちの方を求めています。

• 業務プロセス、意思決定、課題解決にAIをどのように組み込めるかを実践的または批判的に考え、取り組んだ経験(AIツールの活用、ワークフローの自動化、AIによるインサイトの分析、自社の職種や業界へのAIの影響の探求など)

• 高度なエンタープライズ向けソリューション受注をリードするための、アカウントエグゼクティブ、または専門ソリューション営業をリードした7年以上の知見

• ソリューションセールスの経験(CRM/CX/CCaaSベンダーでの経験が望ましい)

• CRMまたはCXソリューションに関連する業務プロセスへの理解

• スピード感があり、成長を続け、納期の厳しい環境で力を発揮できる方

• 厳しい競争環境のなかでも、市場での勝利のために期待以上の努力を惜しまない姿勢

• 複雑な内容を、書面・口頭を問わず、さまざまな相手に分かりやすく伝えるコミュニケーション力

• お客様のCレベル経営層、ならびに社内外のエコシステムに関わる人々と、強固なビジネス関係を築く力

• Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures , including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

• Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions , working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures , lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services , ideally within large or strategic accounts.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a playbook. As the Go-to-Market Leader for APAC Retail & Consumer Goods, you will architect and execute a category-defining strategy from the ground up. You'll operate with the mindset of a founder of a hyper-growth enterprise—a rare opportunity that demands entrepreneurial instincts, relentless drive, and the courage to build in ambiguity.

Databricks is scaling at extraordinary speed. Databricks is the market share leader in data + AI in Retail & Consumer Goods, and this vertical represents one of the most significant growth opportunities in our portfolio. We need a leader who thrives in white space, who sees undefined territory not as risk but as canvas. You will shape how APAC’s largest retailers and consumer brands harness Data and AI to transform their operations, unlock new revenue streams, and reimagine customer experiences.

You will report to the Global VP of Consumer Industries, but your impact will extend across the entire organization—influencing product direction, shaping partner ecosystems, and setting the strategic agenda for one of our most consequential markets.

The impact you will have

• A Scalable APAC Growth Engine Design and execute a go-to-market strategy that doesn't yet exist in its final form. You’ll establish C-level relationships with flagship accounts, construct an ecosystem of ISVs, SIs, and alliance partners, and create repeatable motions that accelerate revenue growth across Retail, Consumer Goods, Restaurants, and Wholesale.

• Programmatic Opportunity Capture Identify the highest-value use cases and industry-specific opportunities—demand forecasting, unified customer intelligence, supply chain optimization, real-time pricing—and build scalable programs that systematically convert these opportunities into revenue. You won't pursue targets one at a time; you'll construct the engines, assets, and activation frameworks that allow us to capture entire categories of opportunity across the region simultaneously.

• A Partner Ecosystem from First Principles Identify, cultivate, and scale relationships with the partners who will amplify our reach. This isn't about managing existing relationships—it's about seeing what partnerships should exist and making them real.

• Data-Driven Operational Excellence Use rigorous analysis to surface gaps, inefficiencies, and untapped opportunities within our go-to-market approach. Build the feedback loops and improvement mechanisms that compound our effectiveness over time.

• Sales Plays That Travel Create comprehensive, scalable sales initiatives tailored to APAC’s diverse geographies while contributing frameworks that support Americas and EMEA. You'll work cross-functionally to ensure these plays move from concept to revenue.

• Industry Thought Leadership Establish Databricks as the authoritative voice in Retail & Consumer Goods transformation. Author white papers, command stages at premier industry events, and engage C-suite executives with a point of view that shapes how the market thinks about Data and AI.

• Cross-Functional Influence Serve as a trusted advisor across product, sales, pre-sales, marketing, and partner teams. Your credibility will be earned through results, and your influence will extend far beyond your formal remit.

• Market-Defining Content Collaborate with marketing to develop industry-specific collateral, demand generation campaigns, and event strategies that resonate with sophisticated enterprise buyers.

• Sales Team Acceleration Build enablement content and coaching programs that elevate the entire verticalized sales organization—making others more effective is as important as your direct contributions.

What we look for

• An Industry Insider with Builder DNA You've held senior leadership or practitioner roles in Retail or Consumer Goods. You understand the industry's challenges from the inside—but you're energized by building something new rather than optimizing what exists.

• Entrepreneurial by Nature You've operated in environments where the path wasn't paved. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, moving quickly, and course-correcting based on market feedback. Ambiguity is where you do your best work.

• A GTM Architect You have extensive experience constructing vertical go-to-market programs on technology platforms, working cross-functionally to deliver measurable revenue growth and customer value.

• An Executive Relationship Builder You engage naturally with CXOs and senior business leaders. You create trust through substance, not just polish, and you know how to translate technical capability into strategic business value.

• A Transformation Leader You've led large-scale change initiatives and understand both the technical and human dimensions of enterprise transformation in complex organizations.

• Technically Fluent You possess deep familiarity with the data and AI landscape, retail technology standards, and the broader ecosystem trends reshaping the industry.

• Regulatory Aware You understand key APAC regulatory environments—such as data privacy, payments, sustainability, and sector-specific compliance—and can navigate these considerations in strategic conversations.

• A Program Operator You've managed complex vertical initiatives end-to-end: gathering requirements, coordinating technical teams, driving marketing alignment, and managing partner relationships to hit milestones.

An overview of this role

As a Strategic Account Executive for Singapore, you will own and grow GitLab’s enterprise relationships in the Singapore market. You’ll help large organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform by leading the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through rollout and long-term adoption. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager or Regional Director, you’ll use a consultative approach to understand complex customer needs, guide them through evaluation, and coordinate pre- and post-sales resources to ensure successful deployments and visible business outcomes.

You’ll work under minimal supervision on complex deals, act as the voice of the customer into GitLab, and partner closely with our strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities and develop new customers. What you’ll do

• Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in the Singapore Market, with a focus in the financial services industry, owning the full sales cycle for large and enterprise accounts

• Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals

• Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers

• Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products

• Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management

• Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes

• Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels

• Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements

What you’ll bring

• Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers, ideally selling into Financial Services institutions.

• Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management

• Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion

• Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes

• Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis

• Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams

• Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management

• Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly

About the team

The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the Singapore market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.

• Act as the "Coach" for local teams and partner managers in South Korea, Taiwan, and ASEAN sub-regions, providing structured frameworks, deal mentorship, and pipeline-acceleration coaching.

• Revenue & Pipeline Management

• Accurately forecast regional partner-influenced and partner-sourced ACV (Annual Contract Value) and new pipeline generation across all covered territories.

• Establish and execute Mutual Business Plans (MBPs) with tier-1 partners and select GSIs, setting clear KPIs for certification, enablement, joint marketing, and revenue goals.

• Partner closely with the regional Sales Leaders (including ASEAN, Korea, and Greater China GTM heads) to map territories, align account-planning efforts, and eliminate channel conflict.

• Stakeholder & Relationship Management

• Build deep, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, practice leads, and channel heads within our focus partner and GSI organizations.

• Navigate internal cross-functional teams within Okta—including Field Marketing, Partner Enablement, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering—to unlock resources and resolve operational bottlenecks for partners.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Experience within Identity or Cybersecurity environments

• 10+ years of experience in Channel Management, Alliances, or Enterprise Field Sales within a SaaS or cybersecurity vendor, with a proven track record of exceeding revenue quotas.

• Willingness to Travel: Comfortable traveling up to 30-40% across the sub-regions to build face-to-face partner alignment as required.

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における10年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

As a business leader, you will conduct executive business reviews with both the distributor and Elastic leadership teams. You should be capable and comfortable delivering demonstrations of Elastic products. You will arrange technical workshops and certification boot camps with distributors and Elastic reseller teams. Additionally, you will create and improve sales plays. And most importantly drive business execution across distributors and distributor-led partner ecosystem.

What You Will Be Doing

Distribution Strategy & Business Planning:

•
Manage business plans with distribution partners. Set quarterly targets for the pipeline and for recruiting resellers. Prioritize segments for Elastic's Enterprise, Public Sector, and Commercial business.

•
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with distribution executive team, and drive business growth initiatives with Elastic Field Sales teams, Managed Partners teams, and distributors

•
Develop and execute a distribution GTM playbook aligned to Elastic's Fiscal year priorities and key performance indicators such as: partner-sourced pipeline, New & Expansion business targets and reseller coverage model.

•
Work with Global Partner Sales Operations to track distributor performance using KPIs. These KPIs include partner-sourced ARR, deal registration volume, pipeline coverage ratio, and reseller activation rates.

•
Onsite & Virtual - Independently design and deliver technical enablement programs for reseller sales engineers, architects, and pre-sales teams — onsite at distributor offices, reseller HQs, and industry events, as well as in virtual/webinar formats.

•
Build and maintain a reusable enablement content library: demo environments, hands-on lab guides, discovery decks, competitive battle-cards, and certification study aids tailored to the Elastic platform (Search, Observability, Security).

•
Run monthly/quarterly distributor enablement days with coordinated technical tracks (observability, SIEM/security analytics, vector/AI search) and business tracks (program updates, incentives, pipeline reviews).

•
Drive reseller technical certifications and training completions through proactive cohort scheduling, remediation support, and accountability reporting back to Elastic Partner Enablement.

•
Deliver or co-deliver Elastic product demonstrations for reseller-led opportunities, serving as the technical point of contact for pre-sales support through distribution when a dedicated SE is unavailable.

•
Identify, recruit, and enable net-new resellers through distribution partners; manage tiering and partner program alignment.

•
Drive reseller activation through demand generation programs, MDF utilization, and joint marketing motions with distributors

•
Maintain a healthy, active reseller pipeline across APJ markets

•
Partner with Elastic Regional Sales field managers (RVPs, AEs) to integrate distribution into account and territory planning.

•
Own execution across Elastic account segments - Work with Global Partner Sales Operations & Strategy on distributor discount structures, incentive programs, and data integrity within Salesforce/Impartner.

•
Collaborate with Elastic's Marketing team to develop and deploy partner-funded demand generation campaigns through public sector distribution partners.

•
Escalate and resolve distributor-facing channel conflicts, pricing disputes, and deal registration exceptions in coordination with Global Partner Sales leadership and Deal Desk.

What You Bring

•
7+ years of channel sales or partner management experience, with at least 3 years focused on distribution.

•
Demonstrated track record of driving partner-sourced revenue through distributor-managed reseller ecosystems.

•
Proven ability to independently deliver sales pitches and business value proposition to partners, ability to showcase product or solution demos, co-deliver hands-on workshops, and lab-based training — to Sales and technical audiences (SEs, architects, pre-sales).

•
Experience building or managing a self-sustaining partner enablement program: content design, delivery cadence, certification tracking, and outcomes measurement.

•
Hands-on fluency with at least one of the following domains: observability/monitoring, SIEM/security analytics, log management, or enterprise search — sufficient to lead credible technical conversations and live product walkthroughs.

•
Deep familiarity with account segments and how channel partners serve and execute business with Enterprise, Public Sector and commercial customers.

•
Experienced with diverse region and working directly with partners based in different countries across APJ - Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder distributor relationships across sales, marketing, and executive functions.

•
Strong command of channel mechanics: deal registration, margin stacking, MDF management, reseller tiering, and co-sell program execution. - Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for pipeline management, reporting, and partner attribution workflows.

Excellent executive communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — and equal comfort presenting to a CISO as to a room of reseller SEs. - Willingness and ability to travel onsite to distribution and reseller locations (estimated 20%–30%) for enablement events, QBRs, and partner marketing activities.

Direct experience with Elastic (ELK/ECE/ECK), Splunk, Datadog, CrowdStrike, or another enterprise observability or security analytics platform — including hands-on configuration or demonstration capability.

description:
About Team & About Role
Rubrik’s Channel team is how we bring cyber resilience to the organizations across Japan that people rely on every day, including hospitals, banks, government bodies, manufacturers and utilities. As Channel Development Manager for Japan, you’ll own the relationships with our reseller, SI and distribution partners and turn them into a repeatable engine for pipeline and Partner Initiated Deals. This is an individual contributor role with real autonomy over which partners you invest in, how you plan with them, and how fast you help them grow.

Rubrikのチャネルチームは、病院、銀行、官公庁、製造業、公益事業など、人々の日常を支える日本全国の組織にサイバーレジリエンスを届ける役割を担っています。日本担当チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーとして、リセラー、SI、ディストリビューターとのパートナーリレーションを統括し、パイプラインとパートナー起点の案件(Partner Initiated Deals)を継続的に生み出す仕組みへと育てていただきます。本ポジションは個人貢献型(IC)の役割で、どのパートナーに投資するか、パートナーとどのように計画を立てるか、そしてパートナーの成長をどれだけ早く後押しするかについて、大きな裁量があります。

What You’ll Do

• Build and execute joint business plans with key Japan resellers, SIs and distributors, so partners have a clear path to growing their Rubrik business and Rubrik has a clear view of where it will come from.

• Drive Partner Initiated Deals and net-new pipeline by working with partner sales teams to identify, qualify and close opportunities alongside Rubrik Account Executives.

• Run account mapping and joint planning sessions between Rubrik field teams and partners, opening access to partner customer bases, both existing accounts and new logos.

• Lead enablement for partner sales and SE teams, so partners can position, demo and deploy Rubrik independently and customers see value from day one.

• Develop and manage distribution relationships, using them to extend Rubrik’s reach into the mid-market, public sector and regional enterprise accounts.

• Identify, onboard and grow new partners that fill gaps in regional, vertical or solution coverage.

• Work with Channel Marketing and Field Marketing to plan and host partner and customer events and campaigns that put Rubrik in front of the right buyers.

• Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at your partners, earning Rubrik a place as a strategic vendor in their portfolio.

• Report on partner performance, pipeline and forecast to Channel and Sales leadership, giving the business a clear read on Japan.

主な業務内容

• 日本の主要なリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと共同ビジネスプランを策定・実行し、パートナーがRubrikビジネスを拡大するための明確な道筋と、Rubrikが売上の見通しを把握できる状態をつくる。

• パートナーの営業チームと連携し、Rubrikのアカウントエグゼクティブとともに商談の発掘、案件化、クロージングを行い、パートナー起点の案件と新規パイプラインを創出する。

• Rubrikのフィールドチームとパートナーとの間で、アカウントマッピングおよび共同プランニングセッションを実施し、既存顧客・新規顧客の両面でパートナーの顧客基盤へのアクセスを広げる。

• パートナーの営業チームおよびSEチームのイネーブルメントをリードし、パートナーが自立してRubrikの提案、デモ、導入を行え、お客様が初日から価値を実感できる状態をつくる。

• ディストリビューターとの関係を構築・管理し、ミッドマーケット、公共部門、地方の大企業顧客へのリーチを拡大する。

• 地域、業種、ソリューションのカバレッジに不足がある領域で、新規パートナーを発掘、オンボーディングし、成長を支援する。

• チャネルマーケティングおよびフィールドマーケティングと連携し、適切な購買層にRubrikを届けるパートナー向け・顧客向けのイベントやキャンペーンを企画・開催する。

• パートナーの経営層・意思決定者との信頼関係を築き、パートナーのポートフォリオにおけるRubrikの戦略的ベンダーとしての地位を確立する。

• パートナーの実績、パイプライン、フォーキャストをチャネルおよびセールスのリーダーシップに報告し、日本の状況を明確に共有する。

Experience You’ll Need

• Strong track record in a channel development, channel sales or partner management role at a technology vendor, working with resellers, SIs and distributors in Japan.

• An Account Executive who has successfully managed client accounts may transition into a Channel Development Manager role.

• Good working knowledge of the data protection, data management, cybersecurity or storage market.

• Established relationships and a strong reputation with Japan partners and distributors.

• Experience identifying, initiating and closing deals with partners in close coordination with direct sales teams.

• Experience running quarterly and annual planning for partner sales activity and reporting on pipeline and forecast.

• Confidence presenting to larger audiences and hosting events with partners and end customers.

• A collaborative approach to working across Sales, Systems Engineering, Marketing, Alliances and Sales Operations.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese and English proficiency at a beginner level, to work with Japan partners and with regional and global teams.

求める経験・スキル

• テクノロジーベンダーにおけるチャネルデベロップメント、チャネルセールス、またはパートナーマネジメントの実績があり、日本のリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと協業した経験

• 顧客アカウントの運営で成果を上げたアカウントエグゼクティブが、チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーへ転身することも可能です

• データ保護、データ管理、サイバーセキュリティ、またはストレージ市場に関する実務的な知識

• 日本のパートナーおよびディストリビューターとの確立した関係と高い評価

• 直販チームと緊密に連携し、パートナーとの案件の発掘、開始、クロージングを行った経験

• パートナー営業活動の四半期・年間計画の策定と、パイプラインおよびフォーキャストの報告の経験

• 大規模な聴衆の前でのプレゼンテーションや、パートナー・エンドユーザーとのイベント開催に自信を持って取り組める方

• セールス、システムエンジニアリング、マーケティング、アライアンス、セールスオペレーションと協力して業務を進める協調的な姿勢

• 日本のパートナーや地域・グローバルチームと業務を行うための、ビジネスレベルの日本語、および初級レベルの英語力

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling or partnering on competitive backup and recovery or cyber resilience solutions.

• A background running partner enablement or training programs.

• Experience building joint solutions with adjacent security and infrastructure vendors (e.g. identity, endpoint, network or storage).

• Experience acquiring and onboarding new partners.

歓迎する経験・スキル

• 競合するバックアップ・リカバリーまたはサイバーレジリエンスソリューションの販売、またはそれらでのパートナー協業の経験

• パートナーイネーブルメントまたはトレーニングプログラムの運営経験

• 隣接するセキュリティ・インフラベンダー(ID、エンドポイント、ネットワーク、ストレージなど)との共同ソリューション構築の経験

• 新規パートナーの開拓およびオンボーディングの経験

Available Locations: Singapore

About the Department

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

About This Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of public sector and enterprise accounts in the Philippines market . The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Role Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Required Experience

• Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
