About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role
Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as one of the founding members of our Japan Customer Success team as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across Japan, helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities: API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.
You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.
In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives. You'll work closely with them to provide best practices and guidance, and support them as their usage (consumption and seat based) grows and evolves.
Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies. That makes you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.
As one of the founding members of our Customer Success team in Japan, you'll help shape how we build the function in-region. That includes establishing regional processes, developing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market alongside a small, growing team. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams. This requires someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.
Key responsibilities

• Build trusting, strategic relationships with key Japanese customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion

• Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions

• Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption and adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer

• Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both our consumption-based and seat-based products to drive full value from contracted commitments

• Serve as the customer's thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic's product roadmap, driving awareness of new products, and engaging Product PMs as the voice of Japanese customers

• Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment

• Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows

• Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement

• Own the customer experience across their lifecycle: manage comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conduct Quarterly Business Reviews, and serve as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic

• Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as part of our founding in-region CS team, developing Japan-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices where needed that account for regional business cultures

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/Functional Consultant, Success Engineer or similar)

• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns

• Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences

• Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships

• Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems

• Fluency in English and Japanese

Preferred qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in relevant field

• Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each

• Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans

• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs

• Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US-based headquarters

• A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality. You are a true team player

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. As an Editor for Japan, you will help Pinners discover relevant ideas through high-quality content curation, Japanese-language editorial writing and trend-led experiences.

You will work with regional and global Editorial partners, Japan Creator Partnerships, Product and Sales to improve content quality, support business needs and bring Japanese seasonal and cultural trends to life on Pinterest.

What you’ll do

• Curate visually compelling, culturally relevant and inclusive content for Japanese Pinners across a range of categories including Entertainment, Art, Fashion or Beauty and seasonal moments.

• Execute editorial programming from content selection, Japanese copywriting and visual assets handling through launch, performance review and optimization.

• Create, edit and review Japanese headlines, descriptions, articles, page copy, emails and localized materials for accuracy, natural expression, brand consistency and local relevance.

• Plan and develop optimized web or email contents for the Japanese audience.

• Curate content that supports client and business needs while maintaining a useful, inspiring Pinner experience.

• Use platform data, search behavior and market signals to identify trends, audience needs and opportunities to improve content quality and new-user acquisition.

• Share performance insights and editorial recommendations with cross-functional and global stakeholders.

• Use AI tools to improve research, analysis and workflow efficiency, while independently validating output for accuracy, cultural nuance, quality and brand safety; own final editorial decisions.

• Manage multiple priorities and stay current on Japanese trends, creators, brands, publishers and audience behavior, particularly among Gen Z.

What we’re looking for

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in editorial, content, curation, publishing, media, marketing, lifestyle, technology or a similarly fast-paced consumer environment.

• Native-level Japanese, plus business-level English for global collaboration.

• Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of the Japanese content market, consumer behavior and local trends.

• A data-informed, customer-centered approach to analyzing content performance and turning insights into action.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and critically evaluate the quality and appropriateness of outputs.

• Ability to manage multiple projects independently, communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Experience with CMS tools, Google Workspace and Excel or similar tools.

• Experience with Canva, Figma or Adobe Photoshop; SEO-oriented content development is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

ポジションについて

Pinterest は、インスピレーションを見つけたり、アイデアをまとめたり、ショッピングを楽しんだりといったポジティブな体験ができるビジュアル探索プラットフォームです。日本担当のエディターとして、質の高いコンテンツキュレーション、日本語コンテンツの編集・執筆、トレンドを軸とした体験づくりを通じて、ユーザーが素晴らしいアイデアを発見できるよう支援するエディターを募集します。

リージョナルおよびグローバルのチーム、日本のコンテンツパートナーシップチーム、プロダクト、セールスと連携し、コンテンツの品質向上、ビジネスニーズの支援、日本の季節性や文化的トレンドをPinterest上で魅力的に表現することに取り組むポジションです。

業務内容

• エンターテインメント、アート、ファッション、ビューティーなどのカテゴリや季節毎のイベントにおいて、日本のユーザーが楽しめる、魅力的で包括的なコンテンツをキュレーションする。

• 日本語の編集枠におけるプログラムのコンテンツの選定、日本語コピーの執筆、ビジュアルアセットの取り扱いから公開、パフォーマンスのレビュー、最適化まですべてを一貫して担当する。

• その他日本語コンテンツに関する各業務、見出し、説明文、記事、ページコピー、メール、翻訳資料などの作成・編集・レビューを行い、ユーザーの目に触れる日本語コンテンツの正確性、自然な表現、ブランドの一貫性、ローカル市場との関連性などを担保する。

• 日本のオーディエンスに特化したWebコンテンツやメールコンテンツを企画・制作する。

• 素晴らしいインスピレーションを得られるユーザー体験を維持しながら、クライアントおよびビジネス上のニーズに応えるコンテンツをキュレーションする。

• プラットフォームデータ、検索行動、市場シグナルを活用し、トレンド、オーディエンスのニーズ、コンテンツ品質向上や新規ユーザー獲得の機会を特定する。

• パフォーマンスに関するインサイトと編集上の提案を、部門横断およびグローバルの関係者と共有する。

• AIツールを活用してリサーチ、分析、業務フローの効率を高めつつ、正確性、文化的ニュアンス、品質、ブランドセーフティの観点から出力内容を独立して検証し、最終的な編集判断に責任を持つ。

• 複数の優先事項を管理しながら、特にZ世代を中心とした日本のクリエイター、ブランド、出版社、オーディエンスの人気コンテンツや行動について、常に最新の知見を持つ。

応募要件

• 編集、コンテンツキュレーション、出版、メディア、マーケティング、ライフスタイル、テクノロジーなど急速に変化するBtoC環境で、3年以上の関連実務経験をお持ちの方。

• ネイティブレベルの日本語力と、グローバルな協業に必要なビジネスレベルの英語力をお持ちの方。

• 優れた編集判断力を持ち、日本のコンテンツ市場、消費者行動、ローカルトレンドに精通している方。

• コンテンツのパフォーマンスをデータに基づき、かつ顧客中心の視点で分析し、得られたインサイトを具体的なアクションへとつなげられる方。

• AIを活用したツールを責任を持って使用し、その出力の品質や妥当性を客観的に評価できることを示した経験をお持ちの方。

• 複数のプロジェクトを自律的に管理し、明確にコミュニケーションを取りながら、職能や地域をまたいで効果的に協働できる方。

• Canva、Figma、またはAdobe Photoshopの使用経験をお持ちの方。SEOを意識したコンテンツ開発の経験があれば歓迎します。

• 関連分野の学士号、またはそれに相当する実務経験をお持ちの方。

私たちは、業務内容に応じた最適なコラボレーションの形を大切にしています。そのため、常にオフィスで勤務するわけではありませんが、重要な協働や交流の機会には出社の必要があります。

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines of deployments (of control systems in new data centers), projects (of controls capital improvement works at live data center sites), and service (of control systems at live data center sites), with additional specializations in the disciplines of colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, on-call support (of data center control systems in the Americas (AMER), Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), as part of a global “follow-the-sun” support arrangement), and governance.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:
- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
- Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
- Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Technicians support data center building automation systems, including Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). In this role, you will deploy and service these critical systems to ensure optimal data center health and performance.

Your responsibilities include deploying new BMS or EPMS installations during data center construction, upgrading existing Amazon-owned or leased facilities, and implementing Amazon hardware in colocated environments. You'll also provide regional servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally support global operations.

Success in this position requires effective collaboration with multiple Amazon teams, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams. You'll maintain strong vendor relationships that drive successful deployments and operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Deploy and maintain critical systems: Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot BMS and EPMS systems across multiple data centers, ensuring optimal performance through diagnostics, programming, and hardware maintenance.
- Execute technical projects: Manage installations from server provisioning to sensor calibration, supervise contractor work, and ensure all activities meet AWS safety and quality standards.
- Drive operational excellence: Provide commissioning support, conduct root cause analysis, create system documentation, and follow change management processes to maintain system integrity.
- Enable team success: Mentor facilities teams on system operations, collaborate with vendors on Factory Witnessed Tests, and recommend design improvements based on operational insights.
- Deliver reliable service: Respond to emergencies, manage on-call rotations, oversee service agreements, and prioritize work through ticketing systems to maintain data center availability.

- Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
- Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
- Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
- Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

description:
Amazon Logistics Japan is hiring a Program Manager for JP DSP New Business Initiatives, focused on Speed. This is a hands-on role launching new speed-focused delivery models with our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs). You will act as the link between DSP operations and cross-functional project teams, and you will own each initiative from start to finish: feasibility assessment, pilot launch, expansion planning, and continuous improvement.

This role will turn program strategy into results by leading pilots and running operations after launch until each program is stable enough to hand over as business-as-usual (BAU). This role manage several new programs at once, responsible for execution planning, launch readiness, and post-launch monitoring for each one. This role will also be responsible for identifying operational risks early and fix them before they affect delivery speed or partner experience.

Data is central to this role. This role will set up the metrics for each program, find gaps and areas to improve, and make data-driven decisions that keep programs on track. You will need to influence stakeholders across operations, finance, product, and DSP teams, often without direct authority, to keep execution moving.

You will work closely with senior program managers. This gives you the chance to build the skills to shape each program's long-term strategy, including which DSP capabilities are needed and how to run them at scale.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Act as owner from the DSP organization for new business initiatives, from feasibility assessment through BAU transition.
- Build execution plans and lead pilot launches, setting timelines, milestones, dependencies and readiness criteria.
- Influence cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, Finance, Product, Tech, Safety and DSP partners) to keep execution smooth without direct authority.
- Spot and reduce operational, partner and launch risks early, and put contingency plans in place.
- Set up performance metrics and tracking. Monitor results after launch, find gaps and make data-driven improvements.
- Build scalable, documented processes and make sure each program hands over cleanly to steady-state owners.
- Work with senior program managers on long-term program strategy, defining which DSP capabilities to enable and how to run them at scale.

As an Executive Coach, you will deliver both M360 and executive coaching to Netflix leaders. You will combine strong coaching capabilities with expertise in stakeholder feedback, assessment, and leadership development to help leaders understand the patterns that drive their impact and make meaningful shifts in how they lead.

This is a highly contextual role. You will develop a deep understanding of Netflix’s culture, business, and leadership environment and use that context—alongside data, assessment, and coaching expertise—to support leaders navigating complex roles and organizational dynamics.

Responsibilities
The role is grounded in four core capabilities: Executive Coaching, Feedback & Insight Integration, Stakeholder Management, Decision-Making, and Practice Stewardship.

Feedback & Insight Integration

• Lead both Onboarding and Growth M360 experiences for senior Netflix leaders.

• Conduct discovery to understand the leader’s role, business context, stakeholder landscape, and development priorities.

• Conduct stakeholder interviews and synthesize complex qualitative feedback into clear, concise, executive-ready insights.

• Integrate M360 feedback, Hogan and other relevant assessments, ESS data, and real-time feedback to help leaders understand the patterns underlying their impact and inform coaching.

• Write high-quality development-focused reports that clearly identify leadership strengths, opportunities, and priority shifts.

• Lead feedback debriefs and development-planning conversations that help leaders translate insight into meaningful action.

• When appropriate, integrate M360 and coaching into a connected development experience tailored to the leader’s needs.

• Apply sound judgment about when to coach, challenge, provide perspective, or create space for reflection based on the leader, business context, and development objective.

Executive Coaching Capability

• Provide high-quality, inclusive executive coaching aligned with ICF competencies and ethical standards.

• Partner with leaders to establish clear development goals grounded in their role, business context, feedback, and development needs.

• Help leaders identify the beliefs, behaviors, and patterns that shape their impact, and translate insights into focused development and sustained change.

• Maintain clear contracting and alignment with leaders, managers, and HRBPs while preserving the trust and confidentiality required for effective coaching.

• Engage in regular coaching supervision and ongoing development of your own coaching practice.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong partnerships with HRBPs and Talent partners to identify development needs, shape leader engagements, and ensure the right support is provided at the right time.

• Develop a strong understanding of the businesses and leadership populations you support so that coaching and feedback remain grounded in current Netflix context.

• Navigate complex organizational dynamics, stakeholder systems, and cross-cultural contexts while maintaining appropriate coaching boundaries and confidentiality.

Practice Stewardship

• Contribute to the continued evolution of M360, Executive Coaching, measurement, and other EFC products.

• Support external coaches and facilitators with Netflix context and quality guidance where appropriate.

• Maintain accurate portfolio and engagement data and use feedback and measurement to continuously improve the quality of your work.

• Contribute actively to a strong coaching community through case consultation, supervision, shared learning, and peer feedback.

Skills & Experience
We are looking for someone who:

• Has significant experience coaching and consulting with senior leaders in complex, global organizations.

• Demonstrates strong executive coaching capability and a client-centered, development-focused approach.

• Holds an ICF or equivalent coaching certification at PCC/MCC level, or ACC with 10 or more years of Executive Coaching Experience with mid- to executive-level leaders.

• Has experience using psychometric and leadership assessments, including Hogan or comparable tools, to deepen leadership insight and development.

• Demonstrates the ability to understand organizational culture, business context, power dynamics, and stakeholder systems—and incorporate those insights appropriately into development work.

• Builds trust and credibility with senior leaders while maintaining the candor required to support meaningful growth.

• Demonstrates effective listening and questioning skills to recognize patterns, challenge assumptions, and help leaders generate insight rather than simply provide advice.

• Demonstrates the ability to synthesize large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information into clear, concise, executive-ready insights and written reports.

• Has strong judgment about when to coach, challenge, provide perspective, or create space for reflection.

• Works effectively across cultures and adapts their approach to different leaders, businesses, and regional contexts.

• Manages work effectively, exercises sound judgment, and adapts well to different work environments with autonomy.

• Has a strong practice of self-reflection, supervision, feedback, and continuous development.

• Collaborates effectively with HRBPs, Talent partners, peers, and external practitioners while maintaining appropriate coaching boundaries and confidentiality.

Nice to Have

• Experience working as an internal executive coach, leadership consultant, HRBP, or senior Talent practitioner.

• Experience with executive assessment, leadership development, team effectiveness, or organizational development.

• Experience working in technology, entertainment, media, or other fast-moving creative environments.

• Graduate education in Organizational Psychology, Human Development, Organizational Leadership, or a related field.

description:
Enterprise Account Executive, Korea

[Singapore]

Korea is one of Asana's fastest-growing markets, and we're making a significant investment to accelerate that momentum. We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own our go-to-market strategy for Korea, from defining where and how we win to closing the complex, multi-stakeholder deals that get us there.You'll be the face of Asana in market: building relationships with senior decision-makers in Korea's leading enterprises, drawing on your existing network and deep experience selling in Korea, shaping a channel and partner ecosystem that extends our reach, and positioning our AI work management platform, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, as the way modern organizations coordinate human + AI work. You'll partner closely with regional and global colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Partnerships to turn Korea's growth into a durable, scalable business.

This role is based in our Singapore office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve

• Own the Korea go-to-market strategy, including account segmentation, target industries, territory planning, and pipeline generation, and translate it into a clear plan with measurable revenue outcomes.

• Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from first conversation to close, building consensus across business, IT, procurement, and executive stakeholders.

• Build and scale relationships with channel and distribution partners in Korea, driving co-selling, joint pipeline, and partner-sourced revenue.

• Leverage your relationships across Korea's enterprise and partner community to open doors at target accounts, accelerate early pipeline, and establish Asana as a credible, trusted brand in market.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level and line-of-business leaders, translating Asana's value into business outcomes that resonate in the Korean market.

• Position and sell Asana's AI portfolio, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, helping customers identify high-impact use cases for human + AI collaboration.

• Anticipate roadblocks and objections with foresight, crafting win-win solutions that ensure every stakeholder sees the value of Asana.

• Partner seamlessly with SDRs, Field Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive long-term expansion.

• Act as the voice of the Korean market internally, sharing customer and competitive insights with Product, Marketing, and regional leadership to inform localization and strategy.

About you

• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

• Native or professional fluency in Korean and English, with a deep understanding of how enterprise buying works in the Korean market.

• Direct experience selling into Korean enterprises, with a clear understanding of local buying culture, decision-making hierarchies, procurement processes, and relationship-driven sales cycles.

• An established network in the Korean market, such as senior business and IT decision-makers, channel partners, resellers, and system integrators, that you can credibly leverage to build pipeline.

• [8+] years of experience closing business, including [4+] years selling directly into the Enterprise segment, ideally in SaaS or enterprise software.

• Proven track record of closing large, complex deals with consistently high quota attainment, and a working mastery of a structured methodology such as MEDDPICC or Challenger Sales.

• Experience working and managing channel, reseller, or alliance partnerships, and driving partner-sourced or co-sold revenue.

• Demonstrated ability to build a market or territory strategy, ideally in a high-growth or "first-in-market" environment.

• Experience leading multi-threaded sales processes with thoughtful planning and internal coordination across global and regional teams.

• Expertise in cultivating trust and long-term relationships with diverse stakeholders, with a bias toward action.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

Compensation for this role follows an On-Target Earnings (OTE) structure, which includes a competitive base salary and performance-based sales incentive pay (based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan). These ranges are a guideline; actual base salary and OTE may vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process, and the ranges for this role may be modified.

In addition, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and benefits. We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

• Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

• Career coaching & support

• Inclusive family building benefits

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Renewals Manager

As a member of our growing Renewals team, you will be instrumental in defining, testing, and scaling a renewals model that balances high-volume scale with top-down positioning across the Japan market. Based in our Tokyo office, you will partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders such as Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Finance, and Legal to ensure Asana customers are set up for continued success from their Asana investment. Your primary focus will be managing customer renewals to maximize retention, identify expansion opportunities, and drive a high degree of customer satisfaction. You will play a critical role in protecting and growing Asana's customer base by proactively managing renewal risk, demonstrating customer value, and driving timely contract execution.

This role is based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Own, drive, and lead the renewals process for customers in the Japan market, in collaboration with the account team, to preserve and improve customer contracts and relationships.

• Actively engage with key decision-makers to understand customer requirements, demonstrate the value of Asana, and uncover roadblocks to ensure on-time renewals.

• Negotiate and execute renewal contracts that align with customer goals in partnership with Finance and Legal.

• Engage with at-risk customers and develop prescriptive strategies to mitigate potential churn and improve retention.

• Communicate renewal risk clearly, take the lead in developing resolution strategies, and escalate wherever appropriate.

• Discover and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal process to maximize customer growth.

• Maintain and report an accurate 90–120-day rolling forecast of renewals and proactively manage risks and opportunities within the forecast.

• Track and contribute to key business outcomes, including Renewal Rate, Net Retention Rate (NRR), renewal attainment, and expansion.

• Maintain accurate customer and renewal information in Salesforce and other relevant systems.

AsanaのTAMとして、あなたは大規模かつ複雑な要件を持つエンタープライズ顧客に対し、戦略的な技術アドバイザーとしてサポートを提供します。顧客のステークホルダーと深く連携し、技術的なイネーブルメント（定着化）を推進し、継続的な利用を確実にするとともに、Asanaの機能を顧客の長期的目標に合致させます。この役割は、強力な技術的適性、卓越した顧客への共感力、そして社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込む影響力が求められる、クロスファンクショナルなポジションです。

【勤務地・働き方】

このポジションはAsana Japanの技術本部長にレポートします。

私たちは、居住地に関わらず最適な人材をお迎えしたいと考えています。そのため、ご本人の状況に合わせて以下のいずれかの働き方を用意しています。

•
関東圏にお住まいの方： 東京オフィスを拠点とした、オフィス中心のハイブリッドスケジュール（原則 月・火・木曜出社）となります。

•
関東圏以外にお住まいの方（日本国内）： リモートワークでの勤務が可能です。ただし、チームビルディングや重要会議のため、 月1〜2回程度、東京オフィスへの出社をお願いしています （詳細は面接時にご案内します）。

なお、重要な会議やオンサイト支援など、状況に応じて顧客先への訪問や国内出張が発生する場合があります。

【主な業務内容】

•
顧客への技術的アドバイザリーとベストプラクティスの提供

•
エンタープライズ顧客の導入後における「技術的な成功（Technical Success）」に責任を持ち、Asana活用拡大の主要な技術アドバイザーおよびパートナーとして機能する。

Asana API、サードパーティサービスとの連携、認証（SAML/SCIM）、クラウドセキュリティおよび管理者ガバナンスに関するベストプラクティスを、顧客の環境や目標に合わせて設計・提案する。

顧客のシステムアーキテクチャ、ビジネス上の優先順位、技術構成に関する深い知識を維持し、ニーズを先読みした提案を行う。

顧客の健全性維持とリスク管理

顧客との定期的なコミュニケーションや技術レビューを通じて顧客におけるAsana利活用にプロアクティブに関与し、製品価値の定着と継続的な利用を促進する。

各種エスカレーション、移行プロジェクト、重大インシデント対応を社内各部門と連携して主導し、予防・早期検知・透明性のあるコミュニケーションを通じてリスクを最小化する。

•
社内連携と製品へのフィードバック

社内の技術ナレッジの標準化を推進し、再現性のあるベストプラクティスを策定・共有することで、チーム全体の提案力向上に貢献する。

セールス、サポート、プロダクト、エンジニアリングチームと緊密に連携し、統一された顧客体験を提供する。

経験とドメイン知識

SaaS業界における、顧客対面型の技術的役割（TAM、ソリューションエンジニア、導入コンサルタントなど）での5年以上の経験。

大規模なエンタープライズ顧客の複雑なステークホルダー管理を行い、プロジェクトを成功に導いた実績。

技術的専門性

API、システム連携、認証プロトコル（SAML, SCIM）、および技術アーキテクチャについて、顧客と自信を持って議論できる技術的知見。

•
SaaSインフラ、セキュリティ基準、エンタープライズIT環境に関する広範な理解。

•
顧客の技術的な課題や質問を素早く理解し、複雑な概念を噛み砕いて解決策を提示する能力。

•
コミュニケーションと言語能力

•
日本語によるネイティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力（口頭および記述）。

•
英語力は必須ではありませんが、英語の読み書きに抵抗がないこと（会社が用意するAIツールを使用しての対応でも可）

•
優れたドキュメンテーション能力、ファシリテーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力。

•
技術的な内容を、現場の運用担当者から経営層（非技術者）まで、相手に合わせて分かりやすく伝える能力。

•
マインドセットと姿勢

標準化へのリーダーシップ： 属人化を防ぎ、チーム全体の成果を最大化するために、ナレッジの共有やベストプラクティスの標準化（Playbook作成など）を率先して推進できること。

プロセス主導型： すべての顧客に標準化された極めてポジティブな体験を提供するためのプロセスを作成、実装、改善することへの強い意欲。

プロアクティブな行動とコミュニケーション： 常に先回りして行動を起こし、かつ透明性の高い発信を行うことで、周囲からの信頼を確実に獲得できること。

About the Role
Miro is looking for an exceptional General Manager to lead our Japan business. Japan is one of Miro's fastest-growing markets, and that growth is about to accelerate: we've made a significant recent investment in a Japan Data Center, removing a long-standing barrier for enterprise customers and opening the door to a new tier of commercial ambition.

This is a business catalyst role. We need a senior executive who can drive an ambitious commercial agenda while building a team and culture strong enough to carry it, for our people and for the customers we serve. This person earns trust quickly, leads with transparency, and represents Japan credibly inside a global organization while being the external face of Miro Japan.

You'll lead a team that understands customers' most strategic challenges, knows exactly who the key stakeholders are, and helps those customers transform their business with Miro, all while building a Tokyo hub that people are proud to belong to.
What you’ll do
Commercial Leadership
● Set the strategy for Japan's High Touch Sales organization and own its execution
with clear accountability.
● Own an ambitious, sustainable growth target for the region.
● Win new logos, particularly lighthouse accounts, and drive wall-to-wall expansion
across the existing customer base.
● Build effective co-sell motions with partners: new logo acquisition into TSE-listed
parent companies, and expansion into their subsidiaries.
● Act as a trusted Miro expert for enterprise customers, credible with practitioners
and executives alike.

People & Culture Leadership
● Build a Tokyo hub culture grounded in transparency, strong team dynamics,
accountability, and psychological safety.
● Lead and develop a multi-layered team, visibly investing in coaching and growth.
● Act as a genuine bridge between Japan and JAPAC/global leadership, translating
strategy and context in both directions.
● Be an active, engaged member of the regional senior leadership team as well as
the cross functional global leadership team.
● Hold the standard we hold every leader to: how you lead people matters as much
as the results you deliver.
What you’ll need
Experience & Track Record
● 15+ years of experience across direct and partner-led sales.
● A proven track record in direct SaaS sales within enterprise segments.
● A demonstrable partner sales track record, including co-sell motions for new logo
acquisition and subsidiary expansion into TSE-listed groups.
● Experience leading through a layer of management, leading people managers
rather than only individual contributors, across a growing team of 20+.
● Country Manager or GM experience in a global company is a strong plus, as is a
background in SaaS, PLG, or collaboration software.

Leadership & Culture
● A track record of building trust with your team, stakeholders, peers, and
customers.
● Demonstrated ability to build or turn around team culture, backed by concrete
examples of impact.
● Strong experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and working well
amid ambiguity.
● A consistent, accountable, and transparent leadership style.
● A genuine investment in developing talent, evidenced by people on your team
who grew and excelled under your leadership.
What's in it for you
We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. description:
The Role

As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of Account Executives and own one of our most critical growth levers in-market: developing talent that consistently outperforms while helping Japanese sellers succeed. This role is about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire raises the bar, every coaching conversation sharpens execution, and every decision is grounded in data — all within the realities of the Japanese market.

You'll operate at the intersection of local and global. You'll adapt our global playbooks to how deals are actually won in Japan — where trust is earned over time, decisions are made by consensus, and relationships matter as much as the commercial case. You'll bring the rigor, along with the energy.

You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth in a market with long, relationship-driven sales cycles.

You'll partner cross-functionally — locally and with regional/global HQ — to improve how we sell in Japan, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

Build a High-Performance Team

• Hire bilingual Account Executives who can run complex, multi-stakeholder deals in-market, and raise the bar with every addition to your team — competing effectively for scarce sales talent in Tokyo.

• Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards, balanced with the trust and cohesion that Japanese teams are built on.

• Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth.

• Ramp and retain talent in a competitive local labour market where strong bilingual sellers have options.

Co-Sell on Complex Deals

• Sell alongside your team in discovery, business case development and negotiation on your most important pursuits.

• Engage senior stakeholders directly — including owners, operations and finance — and help your team multi-thread and navigate consensus-driven, bottom-up decision-making rather than selling to a single champion.

• Bring commercial judgment to pricing, deal structure and competitive displacement against local players.

• Advance the deal while leaving the AE more capable of running the next one without you.

Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence

• Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics.

• Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement.

• Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team.

• Forecast accurately on long-cycle deals, which depends on stage integrity rather than optimism — and account for local cycle length and relationship-building phases.

Drive Operational Excellence

• Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews.

• Build disciplined execution that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes.

• Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction.

• Build repeatable plays for how this segment is won in Japan — from acquisition through implementation and expansion.

Lead Through Influence

• Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Partnerships and Product — locally and at regional/global HQ — to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution.

• Act as a two-way bridge: bring global best practice into Japan, and bring the Japanese customer voice and field intelligence back to shape strategy and influence product evolution.

• Use customer insights and local market knowledge to localise strategy for Japan's cashless transition (the national push toward ~65% cashless by 2030) and the merchant landscape.

• Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance.

You Have

• 6+ years experience as a sales manager, including time leading teams selling into complex, multi-stakeholder accounts with cycles measured in months.

• Native or business-level fluency in Japanese, plus professional business-level English — able to lead in-market in Japanese and collaborate effectively with regional/global stakeholders in English.

• Deep knowledge of the Japanese market — including the Seller landscape, buying behavior, business etiquette, and consensus-based decision-making — and ideally experience in payments, fintech, SaaS or a related B2B category.

• An understanding of the Japanese cashless/payments environment and competitive dynamics (e.g. QR-code wallets, card networks and bank-led offerings), and how these shape merchant decisions.

• Experience hiring, ramping and retaining Account Executives who can run considered, competitive deals — ideally within the Japanese talent market.

• Experience developing already strong performers into people who win larger and more complex deals.

• Proven track record in collaborating across different teams, including across a local–global structure, with the ability to inspire change.

• Leadership and coaching experience and a desire to help others be their best.

• Expertise in creating structure around sales metrics and managing yourself and others to achieve these metrics, including forecast accuracy on long-cycle deals.

• An understanding of how to refine decision-making and consider the downstream and upstream effects of potential decisions.

• Experience localising global sales playbooks and enablement for the Japanese market.

description:
The Role

The Account Management team is looking for a motivated account manager or sales professional to join our SMB team and help our merchants retain, grow, and get more from Square's platform. In this role, you'll own a portfolio of small and medium-sized business customers, engaging with them at high-stakes moments in their journey — whether that's preventing churn, unlocking a new product, or helping them see what's possible with Square.

You'll be equal parts advisor and problem-solver: diagnosing customer needs, deploying retention and growth strategies, and acting as a connector between the seller and the broader Square team. This isn't a reactive support role — you'll proactively manage your book with urgency and intent, building playbooks and narratives that move the needle.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves the challenge of hard conversations, and cares deeply about small business success. You bring a track record in account management or sales, a natural curiosity for how products work, and the ability to turn insight into action.

You Will

• Own a multi-million dollar, dynamic portfolio of SMB merchants across all verticals, you set the strategy, drive the outcomes, and are accountable for every number in your book

• Obsess over retention: develop a deep understanding of your merchants' businesses, identify churn risk before it surfaces, and deploy commercially precise strategies that consistently convert high-risk moments into durable, long-term wins

• Think and act like a GM of your book: managing a high-velocity pipeline, closing upsell, cross-sell, and contract adoption opportunities with the discipline of someone who knows exactly where each deal stands and what it takes to move it forward

• Earn trust by delivering results: build relationships with business owners where you are the first call when something matters, because you've proven you see their business clearly and act in their interest

• Lean into hard conversations: own competitive threats, commercial pushback, and escalations with clarity and conviction, and walk away with a stronger partnership every time

• Raise the bar for the team: write the post-mortems others learn from, build the talk tracks others adopt, and develop the playbooks that outlast you in the role

• Use data to drive decisions: translate portfolio-level patterns into sharp, specific recommendations that influence how Square builds and goes to market for SMB merchants

• Close the loop cross-functionally: partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Analytics to solve problems structurally and prevent recurrence

You Have

• 5+ years in account management, sales, or a related client-facing role, with a clear track record of delivering against retention and revenue goals in a performance-based environment

• Experience managing a dynamic, high-volume book and closing both retention and growth opportunities simultaneously, you stay organised under pressure and know how to prioritise

• Strong negotiation skills built through real commercial experience, you're comfortable in difficult conversations, find creative paths forward, and keep the relationship intact in the process

• The ability to communicate clearly and persuasively, in writing, in a pitch, or in a tough conversation with a merchant who's ready to leave

• Solid financial and analytical skills; you use data to understand your book, size opportunities, and make a case for the resources or decisions you need

• A collaborative instinct, you work well across Sales, Product, Support, and Analytics, and you bring useful context to those conversations rather than just escalating problems

• A habit of reflection, you write up what went wrong, share what you've learned, and use it to do better next time

• A real interest in small business and the challenges SMB owners face day to day, it shows in how you show up for your merchants

• Language requirement: Native Japanese and business-level English

Bonus Points

• Formal sales methodology training

• Experience with fintech, payments, or SaaS platforms

• A history of contributing to team playbooks, talk tracks, or process improvements

description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google , meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications:

• B.S. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5-8 years of experience in technical customer-facing roles supporting a cloud or cloud-security product (such as Technical Account Manager, Senior Professional Services Engineer, Principal Solutions Engineer, Senior Technical Support Specialist, Lead Customer Success Engineer, or Senior Architect).

• Expert understanding of cloud services and architecture of at least 2 cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI).

• Practical experience deploying and operationalizing containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and addressing corresponding security considerations.

• Practical experience deploying and operationalizing DevOps technologies (CI/CD, Version Control Systems, Infrastructure as Code) and their security implications.

• Experience with Linux and Windows operating system security concepts, and troubleshooting experience.

• Experience managing a book of business with 5+ complex enterprise or strategic customers.

Preferred qualifications:

• Security certifications (such as CISSP, CCSP) and extensive experience helping organizations address complex cloud-security challenges.

• Advanced cloud service provider certifications (such as Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional).

• Deep familiarity with cloud-security best practices, advanced threat models, and complex CNAPP use cases.

• Experience building and maintaining executive-level relationships with enterprise/strategic clients, driving customer outcomes, and exceeding performance targets.

• Exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve highly complex technical issues across intricate internal and external structures.

• Advanced ability to use data and systems (such as CRM, log analysis tools) to monitor customer health, identify complex trends, and strategically inform customer success and retention initiatives.

• Demonstrated ability to manage nebulous job responsibilities while actively improving and developing net-new processes.

• Willingness to work across multiple communication channels and platforms to assist customers (such as Slack, email, and support tickets).

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of an organization, including C-suite executives.

About the Job:

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you’ll be responsible for planning and executing strategies that drive customer adoption and use of the Wiz platform for our largest customers.

Your cloud and security industry expertise will allow you to provide impactful guidance to customers throughout their Wiz onboarding and operationalization journey. You will serve as the bridge between customers and the broader Wiz team – you'll streamline collaboration between Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Support to deliver a cohesive customer experience for our most demanding customers.

Strong technical expertise and customer-facing skills will be essential in addressing the needs of our customers. Your understanding of how large organizations leverage cloud, security, and SaaS technologies will allow you to empathize with customer personas and drive effective conversations with customer personas at all levels.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout your customers’ Wiz journey, confidently navigating them through the deployment, configuration, and operationalization of Wiz using best practices.

• Serve as the primary technical contact for your book of customers, solving technical questions and issues via email, Slack, and support tickets, while staying enabled on new Wiz features and cloud security threats.

• Help customers develop success plans with measurable goals that align with organizational security and compliance objectives, project-managing Wiz adoption across business units.

• Drive and track customers’ achievement of business goals, reporting progress to key Wiz and customer stakeholders in executive-friendly communications and contributing to QBRs/executive briefings.

• Capture feature requests and adoption blockers, advocating for your customers by collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to determine priority and alternative solutions.

• Manage and support a book of up to 10 strategic customers, identifying opportunities for expansion, documenting satisfaction or renewal risks, and securing renewals in partnership with sales.

• Partner cross-functionally to improve processes, assist other TAMs with technical escalations, mentor team members, develop documentation, and participate in industry events to act as a cloud security thought leader.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need for visa sponsorship. This role does not offer visa sponsorship .

description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

As a Vanta Customer Success Manager, you will play a pivotal role in guiding customers through their security and compliance journeys with Vanta's specialized solutions. By combining your customer-centric approach with expertise in Vanta's products and security best practices, you will contribute to the overall success and satisfaction of Vanta's customers in achieving robust security and compliance outcomes through retention of customers and health of the book of business.

Vanta’s success over the last year was exponential and we are now working to solve the problem of how to provide world-class customer experience to as many security-minded software companies as possible. As a Vanta Customer Success Manager, you will be the voice of Vanta, responsible for helping keep our customers moving toward their goals and ultimately successful and happy.

This role is hybrid in our Tokyo office 3 days per week and is not eligible for remote work.

What you’ll do as a Customer Success Manager at Vanta:

• Guide our customers in our Growth segment through onboarding, implementation, product adoption, and value-driven success.

• Work with Vanta customers across industries, functions, and stages of their customer journey in a strategic manner.

• Proactively partner with Account Managers by flagging at-risk accounts, providing customer insights, and highlighting expansion opportunities

• Empower customers to become self-sufficient Vanta champions, solving their immediate needs while focusing on their long-term success, value realization, and retention.

• Monitor and prioritize your book of business based on key indicators of customer health via Catalyst, our CS platform.

• Serve as the point of contact for your customers and drive them to specific business outcomes on their timelines.

• Become a product expert on Vanta and how our platform can be used to improve security posture through our compliance offerings (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, USDP and Custom Frameworks), Trust Reports, and Risk Management solution.

• Provide insightful technical answers and recommend the most efficient way for customers to achieve compliance using our platform while leveraging cross-functional resources and specialized teams.

• Partner with your CS team to co-create plays to drive engagement across the Vanta customer base with impactful adoption and retention results.

• Liaise with Support to help quarterback resolutions for customer issues

• Serve as the voice of your customers cross-functionally, providing feedback to the Product team and broader business

How to be successful in this role:

• Have 3+ years of experience in Customer Success at a SaaS company.

• Background in running a book of business of ~150-170 accounts.

• Background in running a strategic book of business

• Willingness to collaborate with others and drive mutually beneficial outcomes

• Self-motivated and curious: Bias for action and committed to iterating when necessary

• Work effectively in a highly ambiguous, ever-changing environment

• Possess clear and thoughtful communication skills, with strong critical thinking ability

• Be highly empathetic to customers, with a proven track record of long-term customer retention.

• Experience with hitting retention targets and creating happy, healthy customers

• Have stellar problem-solving chops, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up

• Fluent in Japanese and English , with strong verbal and written communication skills in both

• Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar

• Experience working in the security or compliance industry is a bonus

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

• Industry-competitive salary and equity

• Healthcare stipend towards health insurance for you and your dependents

• 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

• Health & wellness stipend

• Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

• Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

• 15 days of Annual Leave per year

• 9 company-paid holidays

• Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

• Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

description:

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We’re looking for a driven, consultative Enterprise Account Executive to lead our growth efforts in the ASEAN region. You’ll be responsible for driving new business and expanding existing relationships with enterprise clients across key verticals.

The ideal candidate has at least 8 years of SaaS selling experience within CRM, Marketing Automation, CDP, Analytics, or Content Marketing Solutions. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, you have a knack for simply selling complex tech solutions, and you excel in fast-paced environments.

• Own the full sales cycle , from prospecting and qualification through to negotiation and close — managing multiple complex deals with enterprise clients (deal sizes ranging from $100K to $1M+).

• Engage C-suite and senior decision-makers across Marketing, Product and IT to define and deliver transformative customer engagement solutions.

• Drive value-based selling using MEDDPICC, clearly articulating Braze’s business impact and ROI.

• Prospect strategically using market research, networking, and partnerships to identify and create new opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Development, Marketing, Solutions Consultants, Customer Success, and Services to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

• Grow existing accounts through expansion and upsell opportunities that align with customer goals.

• Champion innovation , leveraging AI tools and modern productivity platforms to maximize efficiency and performance.

WHO YOU ARE

• Experienced: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience in CRM, Marketing Automation, CDP, Analytics, or related MarTech solutions.

• Proven Performer: Consistent track record of exceeding quota in complex enterprise deal cycles.

• Executive Communicator: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills — confident in leading conversations with C-level executives.

• Collaborative: Skilled in navigating internal teams and partner ecosystems to build strong relationships across various departments and deliver strong business outcomes.

• Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with Salesforce CRM and modern sales productivity tools, including AI-driven applications.

• Entrepreneurial: Resourceful, adaptable, and motivated to build and grow the Braze community in the market.

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

ABOUT BRAZE

From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

description:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Pipeline Generation Team

The Pipeline Generation team builds the system that turns market signal into qualified pipeline for the Account Executive team across APAC. This is a founding, AI-first function: a small group of operators who design and run an automated prospecting motion instead of a manual outbound desk. What this team proves in Singapore becomes the playbook the wider region runs.

About the Role

The Business Development Associate runs Mixpanel's AI-driven prospecting system to deliver qualified, Account-Executive-accepted pipeline across APAC. You will operate the outbound engine day-to-day: building target lists, running campaigns, supervising AI agents that research prospects and draft first-touch outreach, and applying a critical eye to ensure only genuinely qualified opportunities reach an Account Executive. You will work inside targeting logic and quality bars set with the team, sharpen them as you learn what converts, and help document what works. Success is qualified pipeline and system leverage, measured on outcomes rather than activity.

Responsibilities

• Run outbound and prospecting campaigns that produce qualified opportunities for the Account Executive team, owning the flow from signal to accepted handoff.

• Build target lists and enrichment inputs against a defined ideal customer profile, and keep data clean so leads move end to end with minimal manual handling.

• Deploy and supervise AI agents for prospect research, list building, personalization, and first-touch drafting, keeping a human check on quality before anything ships.

• Qualify opportunities against the agreed bar with Account Executive input, so accepted opportunities convert and Account Executive time is protected from low-fit leads.

• Prioritize high-intent accounts using Mixpanel's own product-usage and self-serve signals.

• Analyze metrics to see what is working, and adjust targeting, messaging, and channel mix.

• Document what works and feed it into shared playbooks and templates.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• A hunter's instinct: proactively finds new pipeline and starts cold conversations, moving outreach forward with persistence rather than waiting on inbound.

• Consultative discovery skills: talks with customers as a trusted advisor, asks deep questions to understand the problem and qualify fit, and hands over a well-understood opportunity rather than a raw lead.

• Commercial presence: writes outbound that lands, and speaks credibly with technical buyers in the analytics and data space, framing Mixpanel's value in their terms.

• AI fluency: structures a problem into clear logic, designs prompts and workflows that produce reliable AI output, and reviews and corrects that output rather than shipping first-pass results.

• Hands-on comfort with modern outbound automation and enrichment tools (Clay or similar) and a CRM such as Salesforce, including building lists, working with simple logic and formulas, and reading analytics reports.

• Comfort working inside a system that is still being shaped, staying effective in ambiguity and measured on outcomes rather than activity.

• A background in B2B software pipeline generation, outbound, growth, or sales operations, with a track record of sourced or influenced pipeline, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

• Experience at a product-led or self-serve B2B software company, using product-usage signals to drive outbound.

• Light technical ability: connecting tools with APIs, webhooks, or simple scripting.

• No-code or low-code automation experience.

• Familiarity with product analytics, Mixpanel or similar, as both a tool and a source of buying signal.

#PC-HY

Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

• Mental Wellness Benefit

• Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Volunteer Time Off

• Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

• Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

• Win new enterprise customers across SEA by building on your existing network and experience

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to target verticals and companies, including eCommerce, marketplaces, fintech, online travel and digital content

• Build relationships with senior decision-makers and stakeholders, tailoring complex FX, payments and API solutions to customer needs

• Track performance against KPIs, pipeline health and revenue targets

• Work collaboratively across functions, cultures and seniority levels

• At least 5 years of experience selling complex technology products to enterprise accounts, preferably with several years in fintech.

• A broad existing network of key decision-makers for payments solutions within target enterprise prospects.

• A track record of delivering against KPIs, revenue targets and other commercial outcomes.

• Strong analytical and organisational skills, with a structured approach to managing complex sales cycles.

• Excellent communication and solution-selling skills, with the ability to tailor your approach to customer needs.

• Experience identifying, influencing and managing key decision-makers and stakeholders.

Preferred

• Experience selling APIs or other technically complex products for a similar company.

• Experience selling complex, API-driven solutions.

• A startup mindset and the maturity to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

About the position

We’re looking for an experienced OTC Derivatives Reporting Specialist to help our Legal and Compliance team build and operate reliable swap reporting across APAC, with a particular focus on Singapore and Hong Kong.

You’ll work closely with our internal Trading, Operations and Legal and Compliance teams, and our software engineers, to turn reporting requirements into working systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how swaps are traded, documented, booked and managed throughout their lifecycle, and who enjoys working through the details of how those transactions should be reported.

Additional responsibilities of this role will include:

• Resolving interpretation questions with your Legal and Compliance colleagues, then translating requirements into clear, field-level mappings–from internal bookings and lifecycle events to reporting schemas

• Working with software engineers to specify source data, transformation logic, and exception handling, and testing implementations to ensure reports are complete and accurate

• Understanding where internal booking representations differ from the transactions and events that need to be reported, and identifying reporting challenges caused by booking conventions, missing data or product complexity

• Investigating rejected submissions, reconciliation breaks, and incorrect or missing reports; tracing issues to their root causes; and helping implement corrections and controls to prevent recurrence

• Engaging early on new products and trading flows to explain reporting requirements and to find practical ways to support trading while meeting regulatory obligations

• Keeping pace with regulatory and technical changes, maintaining clear documentation, and working with reporting providers and counterparties to resolve issues

About you

• Have 5+ years experience with both Singapore’s MAS and Hong Kong’s OTC derivatives reporting regimes, including implementing reporting systems or taking meaningful responsibility for their day-to-day operation

• Understand swap economics and trade lifecycles, including amendments, resets, novations, terminations, valuations, and collateral-related data

• Familiar with ISDA documentation and definitions, including how confirmations and relevant agreement terms relate to trade economics and reporting

• Comfortable inspecting trade-level data and reporting messages, querying datasets and discussing data models with software engineers; SQL skills are valuable, and scripting experience is a plus

• Can explain a reporting problem you’ve worked through in detail, connecting the trade economics and internal booking to the applicable requirement, field mapping, implementation, and checks you used to establish that the reporting was correct

• Can communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of detailed problems through to resolution

• Experience with other APAC reporting regimes is a plus, but we’re primarily looking for depth in both Singapore and Hong Kong

• Fluent in English
