Hi, we’re Back Market.
We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.
Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.
Are you ready to join us?
The Product Team organisation at Back Market, is a distributed team in New York, Europe and Tokyo as well as fully remote, ensuring a richly diverse mindset in our approach and deliverables and a passion to build interfaces with the user as our focus.
We zoom out to see the bigger picture, but also understand the devil is in the details. We are responsible for the user experience on Back Market, whether that be our customers or professional refurbishers, and through designing, prototyping, testing, and iterating, we evolve it in collaboration with different (and extraordinary) people.
We do this because we want to make the world a better place. Our credentials speak for themselves; we’re certified BCorp, and we’ve prevented 1 million tons of carbon emissions from entering the atmosphere already. A lot of people talk about tech circularity - we’re making it real. <3

About the Job:

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join us to make Back Market the most successful destination for buying refurbished in Japan.
As a Senior minded PM, you’ll autonomously own the product vision and strategy for our Japan Market, meaning creating new features and innovative journeys for Japanese citizens, taking into consideration their specific needs, which might vary from EU or US.
You’ll collaborate with our Engineers, Product Designers, User Researchers, and Product Managers in other squads/regions to bring a plethora of concepts and product evolution. You’ll work on a daily basis with developers to validate the technical feasibility of your proposals and to ensure the fulfillment of your craft, and you’ll also be connected with other Back Markets functions (Marketing, Brand, Business, Customer Care, Supply etc.) to help articulate the needs and expectations of the customer and the business.

You will also manage the relationships with business stakeholders, other product managers, and localization partners to deliver impactful results.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

• You create your squad’s vision , and you are responsible for defining the Northstar metrics and KPIs: it drives the team toward concrete goals and impacts.

• You will work closely with the Japan General Manager and Marketing Director to align on the short and long term priorities: you liaise with them to ensure your product fits perfectly into the Back Market experience.

• You are the Engineering Manager’s daily partner : you adjust priorities if needed, and your communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineers ensure our quality standards and commitments are met.

• The product management skills have no secret for you, you master the discovery steps (link with research, design, data), as well as delivery (testing and QA are part of the game!).

• You communicate clearly and regularly on the risks and impacts of your roadmap and features: you know how to anticipate problems and dependency to ensure a smooth delivery.

• Data is your best friend : data drives your decisions and vision… you never work without data!

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

• You have a strong Product Manager experience (minimum 5-7 years) and you are comfortable working with Product Designers, UX researchers, as well as Engineering teams.

• You have product management experience in an agile environment (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) and you are able to shape product discovery and delivery according to agile principles.

• You have a good understanding of the Japanese market and, more specifically, ecommerce behaviours and trends in Japan : PayPay or Rakuten do not have any secrets for you.

• You are a brilliant communicator; your peers define you as a facilitator and leader. Your interpersonal skills will be crucial for that role to build strong relationships with stakeholders and top management.

• You have a problem-solver attitude, comfortable navigating ambiguous situations using data and putting the user at the center of all your thoughts.

• Your native language is Japanese and you are comfortable communicating professionally in English, as we are an international team.

• You have an analytical mind , and even better, an analytics background. Monitoring our key performance indicators / being able to define targeted increments is part of your daily life. Data is your secret weapon to better frame and measure the quality of our features and increments.

• You use common sense. You have a strategic but simple vision of your product. For you, the product must amplify the value of business expectations .

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼
At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).
No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:
- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.
- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.
- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.
At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.
We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

description:

ABOUT THE ROLE
Quick commerce sits at the heart of our organisation's strategy. This role supports the maths behind that growth. You will build the models that turn a wide set of initiatives & drivers - basket size, order frequency, cost per order, assortment mix, store throughput, promotional spend - into one cohesive narrative.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Own the numbers end to end. Build and maintain projections, unit economics, ROI cases and scenario plans for new initiatives, store formats and commercial levers.

• Break problems into levers and reconnect them. Size each driver individually, then wire them into a single output, so a change in any input flows through to contribution, margin or growth without manual rework.

• Pressure-test your own assumptions. Ground the model in real data, and be candid about which inputs are solid and which are educated guesses.

• Build workflows at scale. Deep Excel plus AI tooling - LLM-based automation, scripting, low-code - so recurring analysis runs itself.

• Turn output into a decision. Say what we should do, what it costs, what it returns, and what would have to be true for it to fail.

• Support budget planning and resource allocation discussions through analysis and recommendations to help meet growth and profitability targets

• Drive coordination , analysis, progress tracking, and follow-up for the company’s OKR process

• Actively engage and participate in key regular touchpoints: performance updates, financial reviews, budgeting & strategy, etc.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

• 3–6 years in strategy, consulting, investment banking or private equity, commercial finance, or a modelling-heavy role in a high-growth operating business.

• Deep Excel knowledge - ability to build financial models & scenarios with logical assumptions.

• Hands-on use of AI tools to automate analytical work. SQL and/or Python is a strong plus.

• Structured problem solving: you can take a vague question and reach a defensible answer.

• The judgement to know when an estimate is good enough to decide on, and when it is not.

• Comfortable reading and interpreting financial documents, including country P&Ls and investment proposals, and deriving actions from them.

HOW WE WORK

• Quick commerce is at the heart of our strategy. It is one of the fastest-growing parts of our business, which brings a distinct set of problems - and the chance to shape answers that do not exist yet.

• Roll your sleeves up. This is a hands-on role. You will be in the detail as often as you are in the strategy.

• Ship fast. We would rather deliver a solid solution this month and improve it in the open than a perfect one next quarter.

• Ambiguity is the starting point. Problem statements arrive half-formed. You are expected to shape them, following a logical, well-reasoned path to an answer.

• Relationships are the key. Nothing gets done alone. Building trust with cross-functional stakeholders across markets, brands and functions .

Our promise: a fun ride and a deeply enriching professional experience.

Overview:
The Investor Relations Manager supports the Investor Relations team in executing the company’s investor communication programme and in maintaining relationships with the investment community. This role has day-to-day responsibility for preparing earnings and investor materials, covering a defined group of investors and analysts, and providing the analysis that supports targeting and messaging. The role is a step towards full ownership of the earnings cycle and reports directly to the Head of Investor Relations.

Responsibilities:
1. Manage the preparation of quarterly earnings materials, including results commentary, Q&A documents and investor presentations, working with Finance and senior IR.
2. Draft and maintain the core investor presentation and supporting materials, ensuring the equity story is communicated accurately and consistently.
3. Act as day-to-day contact for a defined group of institutional investors and sell-side analysts, handling routine inquiries and escalating material feedback to senior IR.
4. Prepare analysis of the shareholder register, peer valuations and analyst estimates to support targeting and outreach.
5. Support preparation of IR input into regulatory filings and market disclosures, working with legal, finance and external advisers.
6. Coordinate investor roadshows, conferences, site visits and results calls, including logistics, briefing materials and post-meeting follow-up.
7. Prepare regular reporting on investor sentiment, peer benchmarking and market developments for senior management.
8. Support the preparation of materials and logistics for Board and Board committee meetings, working with senior IR and the Company Secretary’s office.
9. Conduct ad hoc research and analysis on peer benchmarking, market developments and specific investor topics to support senior IR and management.
10. Work with external IR service providers, including IR platforms and investor targeting partners, on day-to-day requirements.
11. Collaborate with Finance, Legal, Communications and the business to gather information and ensure consistency across investor-facing content.

Qualifications:
1. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics or a related field.
2. 4–7 years of relevant experience in investor relations, equity research, equity capital markets, investment banking or corporate finance.
3. Experience preparing earnings materials or investor presentations, ideally in an in-house IR role at a listed company.
4. Good understanding of equity markets, valuation concepts and financial statements.
5. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and accurately.
6. Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with IR platforms or market data terminals (e.g. Bloomberg) advantageous.
7. High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams to tight deadlines.
8. High degree of professionalism, discretion and integrity in handling confidential and price-sensitive information.
9. Collaborative team player, comfortable working across functions and with senior stakeholders.
Fluency in English required; Mandarin highly advantageous.

Job Title: B2B Sales & Marketing Manager — Wellness Therapy, Health Supplements & Skin Beauty
Company: Kenko Holdings Pte Ltd
Job Description
The B2B Sales & Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and leading the business-to-business sales and marketing strategy for Kenko Holdings Pte Ltd across wellness therapy services, health supplements, and skin beauty products and services.
The role drives revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion by securing corporate clients, developing distribution channels, and building long-term strategic partnerships. The Director will lead commercial planning, key account development, trade marketing, and sales team performance while working closely with management and operational teams to ensure effective delivery of business commitments.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Strategy and Commercial Leadership

• Develop and execute B2B sales and marketing strategies across the three business categories.

• Establish annual revenue, gross profit, sales pipeline, and marketing budget targets.

• Identify priority customer segments, market opportunities, and potential distribution channels.

• Develop pricing frameworks, partnership models, and commercial proposals that support sustainable growth.

• Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to guide business decisions.

• Present performance updates, forecasts, and growth recommendations to senior management.

2. Corporate Sales and Business Development

• Identify, engage, and secure corporate customers, distributors, retailers, and strategic partners.

• Build relationships with corporate HR and benefits teams, procurement departments, hospitality groups, wellness operators, beauty businesses, and relevant retail channels.

• Lead the sales process from prospecting and needs assessment through proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure.

• Develop tailored solutions, including corporate wellness programmes, therapy packages, product supply arrangements, and promotional partnerships.

• Negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, service commitments, and renewal conditions within approved authority.

• Maintain a qualified sales pipeline and accurate revenue forecasts.

3. Wellness Therapy Partnerships

• Develop corporate wellness offerings such as employee therapy benefits, on-site wellness activities, corporate vouchers, and group service packages.

• Build referral and commercial partnerships with hotels, fitness centres, membership organisations, and other relevant businesses.

• Coordinate with branch and operational teams to confirm service capacity, delivery arrangements, and customer experience standards.

• Review programme participation, client feedback, and commercial performance to improve renewals and repeat business.

4. Health Supplements and Skin Beauty Channel Development

• Develop wholesale, distribution, retail, and professional sales channels for health supplements and skin beauty offerings.

• Identify and evaluate distributors, resellers, beauty salons, spas, and other suitable channel partners.

• Negotiate channel agreements covering product range, sales targets, territory, promotional support, and commercial terms.

• Work with product and operational teams on product positioning, launch plans, sales training, and partner support.

• Monitor partner sales, stock movement, reorder patterns, and expiry exposure where applicable.

• Manage channel conflicts and promote consistent brand positioning and pricing practices within company policies.

5. B2B Marketing and Brand Development

• Lead B2B marketing campaigns that generate qualified leads and support account acquisition.

• Oversee the development of corporate presentations, product catalogues, proposals, case studies, and sales materials.

• Plan trade exhibitions, industry networking activities, product demonstrations, and partner events.

• Work with the marketing team on digital campaigns, email marketing, and professional platforms such as LinkedIn.

• Develop joint marketing initiatives with distributors, corporate clients, and strategic partners.

• Measure marketing effectiveness through lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and commercial returns.

6. Key Account and Partner Management

• Build strong relationships with decision-makers and senior stakeholders at key accounts.

• Develop account plans to support renewals, repeat orders, cross-selling, and account growth.

• Conduct regular business reviews with major clients and distribution partners.

• Resolve commercial issues and coordinate service or product concerns with the relevant teams.

• Maintain accurate records of contracts, account activities, opportunities, and customer commitments.

• Reduce overdependence on individual customers or channels by building a balanced account portfolio.

7. Financial and Operational Coordination

• Monitor revenue, gross margins, discounting, marketing expenditure, and account profitability.

• Work with Finance to assess credit terms, monitor overdue payments, and support collections.

• Coordinate demand forecasts with procurement, inventory, and operational teams.

• Ensure sales commitments reflect available stock, service capacity, and delivery timelines.

• Review commercial risks and escalate exceptions or significant contractual commitments for approval.

8. Team Leadership and Performance Management

• Recruit, lead, and develop the B2B sales and marketing team.

• Set clear individual targets, account responsibilities, and performance expectations.

• Coach team members in prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation, and key account management.

• Establish consistent sales reporting, pipeline reviews, and customer relationship management practices.

• Foster accountability and effective collaboration across sales, marketing, operations, and finance.

9. Responsible Marketing and Business Conduct

• Ensure product information, promotional claims, and sales materials are reviewed and approved before use.

• Coordinate with relevant internal specialists to verify applicable product, labelling, advertising, and market-entry requirements.

• Ensure partners use approved materials and represent the company’s offerings accurately.

• Maintain confidentiality, responsible handling of customer data, and ethical business practices.

Job Requirements

• Degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Typically eight or more years of relevant B2B sales and marketing experience, including at least three years in a senior leadership role.

• Proven track record of achieving revenue and profitability targets, securing corporate accounts, and developing distribution partnerships.

• Experience in wellness, health supplements, beauty, consumer health, hospitality, or related sectors.

• Strong commercial judgement, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

• Experience managing sales budgets, forecasting, pricing, and account profitability.

• Ability to lead teams and coordinate across multiple business categories and sales channels.

• Familiarity with CRM systems, sales analytics, and digital lead generation.

• Regional market development experience and an established industry network are advantages.

• Willingness to travel for client meetings, partner development, and industry events when required.

Key Performance Indicators

• B2B revenue growth and gross profit achievement.

• New corporate accounts and active distribution partners secured.

• Qualified pipeline value, conversion rate, and forecast accuracy.

• Account retention, contract renewals, and repeat orders.

• Revenue growth within existing key accounts.

• Channel productivity and product reorder performance.

• Marketing-generated opportunities and return on marketing expenditure.

• Receivables performance and compliance with approved credit terms.

• Sales team productivity and target achievement.

Business Development Specialist (Power & Smart Building Solutions)
An established international electrical and building technology solutions provider is seeking a commercially driven Business Development professional to expand its presence across the power distribution and smart building markets. The role involves developing new business opportunities, strengthening channel partnerships and managing project-based sales activities, working closely with contractors, system integrators and other industry stakeholders to drive sustainable business growth.
Some of the key responsibilities will include:
• Identify and develop new business opportunities across power distribution, energy efficiency and smart building solutions.
• Build and maintain relationships with system integrators, panel builders, M&E contractors and other industry partners to expand market coverage and business opportunities.
• Work closely with internal sales and specification teams to convert project leads into commercial opportunities, including tenders, RFQs, RFPs and pricing proposals.
• Prepare and manage quotations, budgetary proposals and tender submissions, ensuring commercial competitiveness and alignment with customer requirements.
• Drive the full sales cycle from prospecting and solution presentation through to negotiation and deal closure.
• Provide pre-sales and post-sales support, including basic technical guidance, product presentations and training for internal teams and external partners.
• Collaborate with engineering, product, marketing and operations teams to develop suitable solutions, coordinate order fulfilment and enhance customer satisfaction.
• Monitor market developments and competitor activities, identifying opportunities to strengthen product positioning, market penetration and overall sales performance.
To be eligible for this role you will require:
• A Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
• At least 5 years of relevant B2B sales or business development experience within power distribution, electrical solutions, building automation or related industries.
• Good technical understanding of medium and low voltage power distribution, smart building systems and home automation technologies, including KNX, BACnet or Modbus.
• Proven track record in developing new business, managing channel partners and securing project-based sales opportunities.
• Strong commercial acumen, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• A proactive and hands-on approach, with strong customer orientation and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

description:
Job Summary
To develop, manage and execute the Group's marketing strategies and initiatives to strengthen corporate branding, increase market visibility, promote products and services, generate business opportunities and support the commercial objectives of the Group's companies and Business Units.
Job Responsibilities
A. Marketing Strategy & Planning

• Develop and implement marketing strategies, annual marketing plans and promotional activities aligned with the Group's business objectives.

• Work closely with Management and respective Business Units to identify marketing priorities, target customers and business development opportunities.

• Develop marketing initiatives to promote commercial vehicles, cranes, heavy equipment, spare parts, aftersales services and leasing solutions.

• Support marketing initiatives for new product launches, business expansion and entry into regional markets.

• Conduct market research, competitor analysis and monitor industry trends to identify potential business opportunities.

B. Corporate Branding & Marketing Communications

• Manage and maintain the Group's corporate identity, brand guidelines and branding materials across all Group companies.

• Ensure consistency in corporate branding, messaging, visual presentation and marketing communications across all platforms.

• Develop, design and manage marketing collateral, including corporate profiles, product brochures, catalogues, flyers, presentations, advertisements and promotional materials.

• Coordinate product photography, videography and promotional content highlighting the Group's products, services and technical capabilities.

• Manage corporate signage, vehicle branding, exhibition displays and other branding requirements.

• Develop and maintain professional relationships with relevant brand principals, manufacturers and business partners to ensure alignment with their branding guidelines.

C. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

• Develop and execute digital marketing strategies to enhance brand awareness, customer engagement and lead generation.

• Plan, manage and maintain the Group's social media channels, including Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram and other relevant platforms.

• Develop social media content calendars, graphics, layouts, videos and promotional content.

• Oversee the development, maintenance, content updates and layout design of the Group's corporate websites.

• Manage and coordinate digital advertising, search engine optimisation (SEO), search engine marketing (SEM) and email marketing campaigns, where applicable.

• Monitor online enquiries and customer engagement, ensuring relevant sales leads are channelled to the respective Business Units for follow-up.

• Monitor digital marketing performance and recommend improvements to increase market reach and engagement.

D. Product Marketing & Sales Support

• Work closely with Sales, Parts, Aftersales Service, Leasing and Engineering teams to develop effective product and service marketing initiatives.

• Develop product awareness campaigns highlighting product features, technical capabilities, applications and competitive advantages.

• Support sales teams in preparing sales presentations, product information, customer proposals and marketing materials.

• Coordinate promotional campaigns, product demonstrations, customer engagement activities and new product launches.

• Develop marketing initiatives to generate qualified enquiries and sales leads, and monitor their effectiveness in supporting business growth.

• Liaise with product principals and suppliers on joint marketing activities, promotional materials and branding requirements.

E. Events, Exhibitions & Corporate Activities

• Plan, organise and coordinate trade exhibitions, roadshows, product launches, customer appreciation events and corporate functions.

• Manage event requirements, including exhibition booth design, promotional materials, logistics, vendors and event budgets.

• Coordinate marketing support for corporate events, customer visits, factory visits and product demonstrations.

• Evaluate event effectiveness and prepare post-event reports, including customer engagement, leads generated and recommendations for improvement.

F. Marketing Procurement & Vendor Management

• Source, propose and coordinate the procurement of corporate gifts, premiums, merchandise, uniforms and promotional materials.

• Liaise with external marketing agencies, designers, printers, photographers, event organisers and other service providers.

• Obtain and evaluate quotations to ensure competitive pricing, quality and timely delivery.

• Ensure all marketing-related purchases and expenditures comply with approved budgets and Company procurement and approval procedures.

• Maintain proper records of marketing materials, suppliers, quotations and expenditure.

G. Corporate & Internal Communications

• Develop and coordinate corporate announcements, newsletters, internal communications and publicity materials.

• Support Management and HR in employer branding, recruitment campaigns and employee engagement activities.

• Manage corporate publicity, media communications and public relations activities, subject to Management's approval.

• Ensure all external communications are accurate, professional and aligned with the Group's corporate image.

H. Marketing Budget & Performance Management

• Prepare and manage the annual marketing budget and monitor marketing expenditure across the Group.

• Establish and monitor marketing KPIs, including campaign effectiveness, website traffic, social media engagement, lead generation and return on marketing investment.

• Prepare periodic marketing performance reports and present findings and recommendations to Management.

• Monitor the progress of marketing projects and ensure activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.

• Lead, guide and develop marketing team members, where applicable.

• Undertake other marketing, branding and corporate communication responsibilities as assigned by Management.

Job Requirements

• Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communications, Digital Marketing or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably with at least 2 years in a managerial or supervisory capacity.

• Experience in B2B marketing, automotive, commercial vehicles, heavy equipment, engineering or industrial products will be an added advantage.

• Proven experience in developing and executing marketing strategies, branding initiatives and digital marketing campaigns.

• Experience in organising exhibitions, corporate events and product launches.

• Strong knowledge of corporate branding, digital marketing, social media management and marketing communications.

• Proficient in marketing content development, copywriting and visual presentation.

• Familiarity with graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva or equivalent software.

• Familiarity with website content management, SEO, SEM and digital marketing analytics.

• Good understanding of marketing budget management, campaign performance measurement and vendor management.

• Strong project management, planning, organisational and leadership skills.

• Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.

• Able to work independently, manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

• Willing to travel for regional marketing activities, exhibitions and business events when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Marketing strategy effectiveness and timely execution of marketing initiatives.

• Corporate brand consistency, market visibility and brand awareness.

• Qualified sales lead generation and business growth support.

• Digital marketing performance and customer engagement.

• Quality and timely delivery of marketing materials and Business Unit support.

• Effectiveness of marketing campaigns, exhibitions and corporate events.

• Marketing budget optimisation, cost effectiveness and return on investment.

Key Role Expectation
We seek a commercially astute, creative and results-driven marketing leader who understands that effective marketing is not simply about designing promotional materials, managing social media or organising events, but about creating business value and strengthening the Group's competitive position.
The incumbent must possess the confidence and capability to think strategically, identify market opportunities, initiate creative ideas and translate marketing strategies into measurable business results that support the Group's commercial objectives.
A hands-on leader who thinks independently, acts proactively, takes ownership and delivers results — not merely a follower of instructions.

Company Description
SAGE Healthcare is a trusted partner to veterinarians, researchers, and clinicians across private and public sectors, providing comprehensive solutions to meet diverse healthcare and business needs. The company specialises in healthcare products and services, operating with appropriate HSA licenses and training to ensure best practices and regulatory compliance. SAGE Healthcare is committed to delivering prompt, reliable support and often goes the extra mile to help customers perform better. The organisation focuses on innovation and quality, working closely with brand owners it trusts and expanding in alignment with their market plans, offering team members a stable and growth-oriented environment.

Role Description
The Sales Support Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Singapore. This position supports the sales team with day-to-day administrative and operational tasks, including preparing quotations, processing orders, and updating customer records in internal systems. The role involves coordinating with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery, accurate documentation, and efficient after-sales support. The Sales Support Executive responds to customer inquiries, provides product and service information, and helps resolve issues in a professional and service-oriented manner. The role also includes assisting with sales reports, maintaining CRM data, and supporting sales campaigns or events to drive customer engagement and business growth.

• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.

• Proficiency in administrative and coordination tasks, including order processing, document preparation, and CRM or database management.

• Basic sales support and commercial skills, such as preparing quotations, tracking orders, and assisting with sales reports and forecasting.

• Good organisational and time management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Comfort with digital tools and office software (e.g., MS Office, spreadsheets, email, and CRM platforms).

• Ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment and maintain a service-focused, solution-oriented mindset.

• Prior experience in healthcare, medical, or related industries is an advantage but not mandatory.

• Diploma or degree in Business, Healthcare, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

description:
Furniture is a high-ticket, highly personal purchase. When a customer’s custom dining table is delayed by logistics, or their new sofa arrives with a scuff mark, they get emotional. They get demanding. And yes, sometimes, they will raise their voice and scold you.
We are looking for a Customer Service & Sales Support Specialist who has titanium-level thick skin. If you take customer complaints personally, this job will exhaust you. But if you have ice in your veins, high emotional intelligence, and the ability to disarm an angry, picky customer and turn them into a loyal brand advocate, you will absolutely thrive here.
What You Will Do

• You will be the vital bridge between our sales team, our logistics/warehouse crew, and our clients. Your daily duties will include:

• Frontline Conflict Resolution: Field incoming calls and messages from demanding customers regarding delivery delays, defects, and post-purchase regrets.

• De-escalation: Handle high-tension interactions with empathy, strict professionalism, and authority, knowing how to calm a situation without giving away the house.

• Sales Support: Assist the sales team with processing orders, generating invoices, checking inventory, and following up on leads.

• Logistics Coordination: Liaise directly with the warehouse and delivery drivers to track orders, schedule replacements, and ensure promises made to the customer are kept.

• Quality Assurance Tracking: Log recurring product issues or delivery complaints so management can fix root problems in the supply chain.

Who We Are Looking For

• The "Iron Shield": You do not crumble under pressure. You understand that a yelling customer is upset at the situation, not at you personally.

• Experience in the Trenches: 2+ years in a high-stakes customer service role (e.g., luxury retail, furniture, hospitality, or complaints departments).

• Solution-Oriented: You don't just apologize; you immediately formulate a Plan A and Plan B to fix the issue.

• Exceptional Communicator: Flawless written and spoken English. You know how to write an email that sounds accommodating but holds firm to company policies.

• Detail Obsessed: Furniture involves complex SKUs, dimensions, and materials. You rarely make data-entry mistakes.

What We Offer:

• We Have Your Back: While we expect you to handle tough customers, our management does not tolerate abuse. We will empower you with clear boundaries on when to hang up or fire a client.

• Competitive Compensation: We know this job is tough, and we pay accordingly.

• Growth Path: Master this role, and there are clear avenues to move into senior operations, account management, or sales management.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing effective marketing strategies across digital and offline channels, managing marketing campaigns, and generating quality leads to support vehicle sales. If you already know how to get specified on projects, win over interior designers, navigate commercial budgets, and turn one-off trade inquiries into high-value repeat accounts, we want to talk to you.
What You Will Do
You will take immediate ownership of growing our B2B revenue, applying your proven sales playbook to expand our commercial and trade footprint. Your daily duties will include:

• Immediate Pipeline Generation: Leverage your existing industry knowledge and outreach strategies to bring in new B2B clients—including interior design firms, architecture studios, fit-out contractors, hospitality groups, property developers, and corporate offices.

• Account Expansion: Convert first-time trade buyers into loyal, recurring accounts that come to you first for every new residential or commercial project.

• Seamless Handover: Collaborate with our dedicated sales support, procurement, and logistics teams to verify production lead times, stock availability, and delivery schedules so your clients stay happy.

• Revenue Accountability: Maintain a disciplined CRM pipeline and consistently hit or exceed monthly and quarterly B2B sales targets.

Who We Are Looking For (Non-Negotiable)

• Direct Furniture B2B Experience: 2+ years working specifically in B2B business development, trade sales, or project sales for a furniture brand, distributor, or manufacturer . Applications without furniture B2B experience will not be shortlisted.

• You Know How to Get Sales: You don't need a script or hand-holding. You already have a tested playbook for finding decision-makers, booking meetings, and closing commercial furniture deals.

• Active Industry Network: You ideally bring warm relationships—or know exactly how to quickly build them—with interior designers, architects, procurement managers, and commercial developers.

• Fluent in Furniture Specs: You already understand lead times, MOQs, upholstery/material grading, custom fabrication limits, and how to read floor plans or BOQs.

• Commercially Driven: You are motivated by closing big deals, hitting numbers, and maximizing your commission.

What We Offer

• High Earning Potential: Competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, transparent commission structure built to reward proven rainmakers.

• Zero Admin Drag: You sell; our dedicated procurement, logistics, and customer service teams handle the backend execution so your time stays focused on revenue.

• Autonomy & Growth: We don't micromanage people who deliver. Prove you can grow the B2B book, and you have a direct path to Senior BD, Key Account Director, or Head of Commercial Sales.

description:
As a Senior Executive/Executive, Key Account (HORECA), you will play an important role in strengthening The 1872 Clipper Tea Co. presence within Singapore’s most prestigious hospitality brands. You will be responsible for manging and expanding our footprint within a portfolio of key hotel partners, Michelin-starred establishments, and elite boutique hospitality groups. Your goal is to identify new business opportunities, develop tailored tea solutions and deliver exceptional account servicing to position The 1872 Clipper Tea Co. as the preferred tea partner within the luxury hospitality industry.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Key Account Management

• Manage and nurture relationships with existing key hotel partners , fine dining establishments and premium hospitality accounts to drive customer retention and business growth.

• Build deep-rooted connections with F&B Directors, Executive Chefs and Procurement Heads across the luxury hospitality ecosystem.

• Regularly engage with key accounts to understand their business needs, gather feedback and identify opportunities to expand product offerings.

• Monitor account performance and follow up on sales opportunities to achieve assigned revenue targets.

• Support the implementation of sustainable and eco-friendly packaging solutions across HORECA accounts.

2. Hospitality Sector Engagement

• Identify, prospect and secure new business opportunities within luxury hotels, fine dining establishments, premium restaurants and premium café groups.

• Identify opportunities for menu integration and "Signature Tea" programs tailored to each partner’s unique brand identity.

• Conduct product presentations, tea tastings and training sessions for hospitality partners to promote product knowledge and quality tea service.

• Keep abreast of market trends, competitor activities and developments within Singapore's premium hospitality sector.

3. Wholesale & Category Leadership

• Prepare sales proposals, quotations and commercial agreements for new and existing HORECA accounts.

• Participate in pricing discussions and negotiations to secure profitable business opportunities and long-term customer relationships.

• Work closely with the AGM to enhance the customer journey for the HORECA business from initial business engagement and product introduction to order fulfilment and after-sales support.

• Liaise with internal teams to coordinate customer requirements and ensure timely delivery of products and services.

4. Commercial & Performance Management

• Achieve and exceed assigned revenue targets while maintaining strong gross margin discipline.

• Assist in sales forecasting and demand planning to ensure adequate product availability for key accounts.

• Monitor customer feedback and service issues, working with relevant departments to resolve matters promptly.

• Maintain accurate sales records, customer databases, account plans and business development pipelines.

Requirements

• 2+ years in Key Account Management or Business Development within the premium F&B or luxury hospitality sector.

• A sophisticated communicator with a passion for tea who can represent a heritage brand with poise and professionalism.

About The 1872 Clipper Tea Co.
Founded in Singapore and part of the B.P. de Silva Group, we are a distinguished specialty tea company on a mission to move tea forward. We are redefining the modern tea experience—making the premium tea ritual accessible, vibrant, and relevant to a new generation.
Through ethically sourced teas, world-class retail boutiques, and our signature tea bars, we bridge the gap between deep-rooted heritage and contemporary lifestyle. We don't just sell tea; we curate sensory experiences that honor the grower and inspire the consumer.
Our Culture: How We Show Up
At The 1872 Clipper Tea Co., we operate at the intersection of tradition and disruption. We are looking for a professional who embodies our core values:
● P – Resilient Positivity: Meeting market challenges with a “can-do” spirit.
● E – Excellence: Setting the gold standard in every account interaction.
● A – Total Accountability: Owning the relationship from "leaf to cup."
● C – Radical Collaboration: Supporting the wider team to create the greatest collective impact.
● H – Uncompromising Honesty: Maintaining transparency and integrity in every deal.
● E – Active Empathy: Valuing the perspectives of our producers and our clients alike.
● S – Super Hungry: Continuously learning and never settling for "good enough."
What We Offer
● Wellness & Benefits:
○ Commissions + annual performance bonus.
○ Up to $1,600 in medical and dental coverage.
○ Up to 18 days of annual leave.
○ Exclusive staff discounts across all B.P. de Silva Group brands.
○ Complimentary daily specialty drinks at our tea bars.

description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Sales Analyst is responsible for financial planning, sales data analysis, reporting, strategy development, and performance evaluation across Asia. Key duties include data collection, trend analysis, sales forecasting, report creation, communication with stakeholders, and staying updated on industry trends.

MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES TO BE ACCOMPLISHED:
Data Collection and Analysis:
o Gather and analyze sales data from various sources (e.g., ERM, spreadsheets, reports).
o Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in sales performance.
o Perform statistical analysis and forecasting to predict future sales.
o Ensure data integrity by validating sources, reconciling discrepancies, and maintaining data governance/definitions for KPIs.
o Conduct customer, product, and region segmentation analyses (mix, margin, volume, price) to diagnose drivers of performance.
o Provide ad-hoc analyses (e.g., win/loss, price-volume-mix, pipeline conversion) to support business reviews and decision-making.

Reporting and Communication:
o Create and maintain regular sales reports and dashboards.
o Present data interpretations and insights to stakeholders.
o Communicate findings and recommendations to sales teams and management.
o Standardize reporting cadence (weekly/monthly/QBR) and automate recurring reports to improve speed, accuracy, and scalability.
o Translate complex data into clear executive summaries, insights, and actionable recommendations for leadership.
o Support CRM and pipeline reporting by defining required fields, monitoring hygiene/accuracy, and coaching users on reporting standards as needed.

Sales Strategy Development:
o Develop and implement sales strategies based on data analysis and market trends.
o Contribute to setting sales goals and quotas.
o Identify opportunities for improving sales efficiency and effectiveness.
o Support territory/account planning by analyzing white space, account potential, coverage models, and route-to-market effectiveness.
o Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and profitability analyses (discounts, price realization, margin impact) to guide commercial decisions.
o Assist in sales incentive/commission reporting and performance tracking, ensuring alignment to plan rules and target setting.

Sales Performance Evaluation:
o Evaluate sales representatives' performance and identify areas for improvement.
o Track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure sales success.
o Monitor pipeline health and funnel KPIs (coverage, aging, stage conversion, forecast accuracy) and flag risks/opportunities early.
o Prepare materials for business reviews (MBR/QBR), including scorecards, variance analysis versus plan, and corrective action tracking.

Sales Operations and Process Improvement:
o Own and maintain sales operating metrics and definitions, ensuring consistent measurement across the region.
o Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives (e.g., standard templates, workflow streamlining, reduced manual work).
o Coordinate with Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain on forecast inputs, demand planning assumptions, and alignment to S&OP cycles where applicable.
o Support sales systems master data and setup (accounts, hierarchy, product mapping) in partnership with relevant system owners.

Staying Informed:
o Keep abreast of technological innovations and industry best practices.
o Stay informed of market trends and competitor activities.

EDUCATION
• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Business Administration, Marketing, Mathematics)

EXPERIENCE & KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED:
• 3 years experience with statistical analysis and sales support
• Up-to-date knowledge of industry developments and regulatory changes.

SKILLS REQUIRED (SKILLS FRAMEWORK ALIGNMENT):
• Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze data, identify trends, and draw conclusions.
• Data Management: Proficiency in using data analysis tools and software.
• Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present findings and recommendations.
• Problem-Solving: Ability to identify problems and develop solutions to improve sales performance.
• Business Acumen: Understanding of sales processes, marketing strategies, and business operations.
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in using CRM systems, spreadsheets, and data analysis software.

PERSONALITY TRAITS:
• Results-oriented and able to take ownership of one’s work.
• Has initiative.
• Able to meet deadlines and can work in a fast-paced environment
• Good interpersonal, communication and analytical skills.
• Ability to work under pressure and is adaptable to change.
• Eager, diligent and can work independently.

Working hours:
Mon to Fri, 8:30am to 5:30pm

Key Responsibilities

1. Indoor & Outdoor Sales
- Handle both indoor and outdoor sales activities to promote the company's range of floor and wall tiles, sanitary ware, bathroom fittings and related products.
- Attend to walk-in customers, enquiries and sales leads at the showroom.
- Understand customers' requirements and recommend suitable products based on their design preferences, project specifications and budgets.
- Conduct regular outdoor sales visits to Architects, Interior Designers, Developers, Contractors and other potential customers.
- Prepare quotations, follow up on sales enquiries and negotiate pricing to secure orders.
- Achieve individual sales targets and contribute towards the company's overall sales objectives.

2. Project Sales & Business Development
- Identify and develop new business opportunities within the residential, commercial and hospitality sectors.
- Establish and maintain strong working relationships with Architects, Interior Designers, Consultants, Developers and Contractors.
- Promote the company's products and work towards getting products specified for upcoming projects.
- Follow up on project leads, tenders, quotations and sales opportunities from initial enquiry through to order confirmation.
- Monitor project progress and maintain regular communication with relevant stakeholders to secure project orders.
- Keep abreast of market developments, competitors' activities, industry trends and upcoming projects.

3. Customer Relationship Management
- Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers and business partners.
- Provide product recommendations, technical information and after-sales support.
- Handle customer feedback and resolve sales-related issues professionally.

4. Sales Administration & Reporting
- Prepare sales quotations, proposals and sales reports.
- Maintain accurate records of customer information, sales activities and project pipelines.
- Monitor sales performance and provide regular updates on business development activities.

Requirements & Qualifications
- Minimum 3–5 years of relevant sales experience in the building materials, floor and wall tiles, sanitary ware, bathroom fittings or other Building Materials related industry.
- Prior experience in project sales and proven ability to liaise with Architects, Interior Designers, Developers and Contractors.
- Good understanding of building materials, product specifications and interior design trends.
- Experience handling both indoor showroom sales and outdoor business development activities.
- Strong sales, negotiation and presentation skills.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and develop new business accounts.
- Self-motivated, target-driven and able to work independently.

Working hours:
Alternate 6 days work week (4 weekends and 2 weekdays off per month)

Mon to Fri: 10am to 7pm
Sat or Sun: 10am to 6pm

Job Purpose
Support the day-to-day operations and sales activities of the Catering Business by managing customer enquiries, orders, online catering channels, order coordination and event support.
The role is responsible for ensuring a smooth customer experience from enquiry to fulfilment, while supporting the Catering Development Manager in converting enquiries, growing repeat business and maintaining strong service standards.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Enquiries & Sales Support
• Respond to catering enquiries and prepare quotations and order confirmations.
• Follow up on leads and enquiries to secure orders.
• Maintain good relationships with existing and potential customers.
• Support corporate sales activities and follow-up with repeat clients.
Order & Operations Coordination
• Manage catering orders from confirmation to fulfilment.
• Coordinate with outlets, kitchen teams, delivery partners and customers.
• Ensure orders are accurate, complete and delivered on time.
• Handle customer feedback and resolve service issues promptly.
Online & Platform Management
• Manage daily orders and enquiries from the company website and catering platforms.
• Maintain menus, pricing, product information and availability.
• Monitor online orders and support improvements to platform sales.
Events & Catering Support
• Assist with planning and coordination of catering events and functions.
• Provide on-site support for events when required.
• Coordinate setup, food delivery and service requirements.
Administration
• Maintain accurate customer, enquiry and order records.
• Track quotations confirmed orders and upcoming events.
• Prepare basic sales and order reports for management.
Working Conditions
• Office-based with regular coordination with outlets and catering operations.
• May require evenings, weekends and public holidays for events.
• May involve standing for extended periods and lifting light equipment.
Requirements
• 1–3 years of experience in catering, F&B, sales coordination, customer service or events.
• Experience with online ordering or e-commerce platforms is an advantage.
• Good communication, coordination and customer service skills.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple orders.
• Proactive, organised and able to work independently and as part of a team.

About Starts
Starts Singapore is a local property agency owned by Starts Corporation (Japan). We specialise in supporting Japanese companies expanding their businesses into Singapore and their expatriates for their housing needs.

We are looking for a committed Sales & Customer Executive to grow our market share of Japanese clientele. You will identify new business opportunities and generate new leads in order to improve revenue, profitability and business expansion. • Develop a growth strategy focused both on financial gain and customer satisfaction.

• Building long-term relationships with new and existing clients.

Requirements and skills

• Strong team player and customer service-oriented.

description:
Electro Optic Systems (EOS) is a global defence technology company specialising in the design, development and manufacture of advanced defence systems and remote weapon systems.
EOS Defence Systems Singapore supports customers across the Asia-Pacific region through after-sales support, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), depot servicing, spare parts management, field services and long-term equipment sustainment programmes.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sustainment Commercial Manager to lead the commercial and contractual management of EOS Defence Systems' MRO and sustainment business.
The successful candidate will be responsible for managing customer contracts, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, contract profitability, financial performance and business development opportunities relating to long-term equipment sustainment and lifecycle support programmes.
This role requires a strong understanding of commercial contract management, defence or aerospace MRO operations, customer relationship management and financial planning.
The candidate will work closely with the MRO, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and Quality teams to ensure effective contract execution, commercial performance and customer satisfaction across Singapore and the Asia-Pacific region.

Key Responsibilities
1. Commercial & Contract Management

• Lead the commercial management of MRO, sustainment, depot servicing, field support and spare parts contracts.

• Review, negotiate and manage commercial terms and conditions, including contract scope, pricing, payment terms, warranties, service-level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

• Ensure contractual deliverables, milestones, obligations and commercial commitments are properly monitored and fulfilled.

• Manage contract variations, extensions, renewals, amendments and additional work scopes.

• Identify and mitigate commercial, contractual and financial risks throughout the contract lifecycle.

• Ensure compliance with company policies, customer requirements and applicable contractual and regulatory obligations.

2. Financial Management & Contract Profitability

• Develop and manage contract budgets, pricing models, cost estimates and commercial proposals for MRO and sustainment programmes.

• Monitor contract revenue, cost performance, gross margins, cash flow and profitability.

• Work closely with Finance and Operations teams to establish accurate cost structures for labour, materials, spare parts, repairs and field services.

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, optimise pricing and enhance contract profitability.

• Monitor financial performance against approved budgets and business targets.

• Prepare regular commercial and financial performance reports for senior management.

3. Customer & Stakeholder Management

• Establish and maintain strong commercial relationships with defence customers, government agencies, military organisations and international business partners.

• Lead commercial discussions, contract negotiations and customer business reviews.

• Act as the primary commercial point of contact for key sustainment and MRO accounts.

• Address customer commercial issues, contractual disputes, claims and service-related escalations.

• Work closely with technical and operational teams to ensure customer expectations and contractual deliverables are achieved.

• Support customer retention and long-term partnership development.

4. Business Development & Sustainment Opportunities

• Identify new commercial opportunities arising from existing defence equipment programmes and installed customer systems.

• Develop strategies to secure long-term sustainment, MRO, spare parts, upgrade and lifecycle support contracts.

• Identify opportunities for contract extensions, renewals, additional service packages and aftermarket support.

• Lead the preparation of commercial proposals, quotations, tenders and business cases.

• Support bid management activities, including pricing strategy, cost modelling, commercial risk assessments and tender negotiations.

• Monitor market trends, competitor activities and regional defence sustainment opportunities across the Asia-Pacific region.

5. MRO Operations & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Work closely with the MRO Depot Centre, Engineering, Field Service and Supply Chain teams to align commercial commitments with operational capabilities.

• Ensure MRO pricing and contract assumptions are supported by realistic resource, labour, material and spare parts requirements.

• Monitor service delivery performance against contractual SLAs and customer commitments.

• Support inventory, spare parts and repair cost optimisation initiatives.

• Review operational performance and identify commercial improvement opportunities.

• Ensure effective coordination between commercial and operational teams during contract execution.

6. Reporting & Governance

• Prepare management reports on contract performance, revenue, profitability, risks, business pipeline and customer accounts.

• Establish and maintain appropriate commercial governance, contract review and approval processes.

• Maintain accurate records of contracts, quotations, variations, claims and commercial correspondence.

• Present commercial performance updates and recommendations to senior management.

• Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned by senior management.

Job Requirements

• Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.

• Minimum 8–12 years of relevant commercial, contract management or business management experience.

• Experience in defence, aerospace, aviation MRO, marine, offshore, engineering or industrial equipment industries is highly preferred.

• Proven experience managing complex service, maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), aftermarket or long-term sustainment contracts.

• Strong knowledge of commercial negotiations, contract administration, pricing strategies and financial management.

• Experience in managing contract budgets, cost structures, revenue, gross margins and profitability.

• Demonstrated ability to prepare commercial proposals, tender submissions, quotations and business cases.

• Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

• Good understanding of contractual risk management, claims, variations and dispute resolution.

• Strong analytical, negotiation, communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and engage effectively with senior management and international customers.

• Willingness to travel locally and internationally when required.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

• Previous experience supporting defence, military, aerospace or government-related contracts.

• Experience managing long-term product sustainment, lifecycle support, aftermarket services or integrated logistics support (ILS) programmes.

• Familiarity with defence procurement processes, government contracts and international customer requirements.

• Knowledge of MRO cost structures, spare parts pricing, repair services and field service commercial models.

• Experience with contract profitability, P&L management and business development.

• Professional qualifications in contract management, project management, finance or commercial management would be advantageous.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to manage regional defence sustainment and MRO business activities.

• Exposure to international defence customers and long-term lifecycle support programmes.

• Involvement in strategic commercial planning and business development.

• Opportunity to contribute to the growth of EOS Defence Systems' regional sustainment business.

• Identify market trends, competitor activities, and potential business opportunities.

• Conduct product presentations and introduce products to potential customers.

• Energetic, proactive, and self-motivated.

• Strong interest in sales and achieving results.

• Customer service oriented with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Confident in approaching and engaging with new customers.

• Good negotiation and relationship-building skills.

• Willingness to learn and take on new challenges.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Positive attitude and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Able to manage multiple tasks and follow up on business opportunities.

• Mobility: Possess own vehicle and valid driving license (preferred).

• A perfect opportunity for chocolate and snack lovers to work with products they enjoy!

• Opportunity to build and develop a rewarding career in Sales and Business Development.

• Gain valuable exposure to the FMCG, retail, and HORECA industries.

• Dynamic and fast-paced working environment.

• Friendly and supportive working environment.

Sales Support Executive

The Sales Support Executive provide comprehensive sales administration, event coordination and outreach support to the Domestic Sales team. Enable sales consultants to focus on prospective student engagement and enrolment conversion through efficient sales processes, well-coordinated recruitment activities and effective administrative support.

➤ Student Recruitment, Preview Sessions and Outreach

• Plan, organise, coordinate and deliver programme Preview Sessions, information talks and presentations to working adults seeking to upgrade their qualifications, polytechnic students and other target audiences.

• Coordinate event-day registration, logistics, goodie bags and marketing collateral; support post-event feedback and reporting.

• Maintain accurate inventory records of premiums and promotional items; coordinate gift redemptions, acknowledgement letters and tracking.

➤ Team Coordination and Internal Events

• Prepare sales consultants' event deployment and duty rosters; submit OIL and related claims for staff assigned to events.

OTHER INFORMATION

Job Summary:
The Design & Marketing Executive supports the design and marketing functions. Responsibilities include graphic design, content creation, developing marketing materials, engaging in Public Relations events, managing digital and offline campaigns, and evaluating campaign performance.
Job Scope:
Graphic Design and Content Development

• Conceptualise and develop creative marketing materials, including brochures, product catalogues, posters, banners, digital advertisements, social media content, presentations and event materials.

• Apply knowledge of graphic design principles, branding, layout, typography and visual communication to produce professional and engaging content.

• Use design and content creation tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Canva and CapCut to create and edit marketing materials.

• Ensure that all marketing materials are accurate, visually consistent and aligned with the company’s brand guidelines, and company websites are updated regularly.

• Maintain an organised library of approved brand assets, product images, templates, photographs and marketing materials.

Campaign Strategy and Implementation

• Assist in developing marketing campaignstrategies that strengthen brand awareness, generate leads and support salespriorities.

• Participate in the planning and implementationof integrated digital and offline campaigns across social media, websites,email, advertising, exhibitions and customer events.

• Manage campaigns from concept and contentdevelopment through execution, coordinating with internal teams, vendors andexternal partners to ensure timely delivery.

• Track and analyse campaign reach, engagement,inquiries, qualified leads and sales conversions, and use the findings toimprove future campaigns.

• Monitor campaign expenditure and deliveractivities within approved budgets.

Events and Partnerships

• Participate in the planning, coordination andexecution of Public Relations events, exhibitions, roadshows, product launchesand customer engagement activities, managing logistics, schedules and budgets.

• Coordinate with internal teams, vendors, venuesand external partners to ensure events are delivered on time and within budget.

• Build and maintain relationships with businesspartners, industry associations, suppliers and sponsors to create jointmarketing and co-branding opportunities.

• Support Business Development and Sales teams infollowing up on event leads and partnership opportunities, and maintainaccurate records.

• Evaluate event and partnership outcomes,including attendance, leads generated and return on investment, and recommendimprovements for future activities.

Business Development and Sales Support

• Support the Business Development and Sales teamsin identifying target markets, customer needs and growth opportunities throughmarket and competitor research.

• Liaise and follow up with existing projectpartners on project milestones, coordinating product deliveries to ensure theyarrive on time and in line with project timelines.

• Coordinate the handover of marketing-generatedleads to Sales, monitor follow-up progress and maintain accurate records ofleads, customer inquiries and business opportunities.

Collaboration with Sales Teams

• Work closely with Sales teams to understand customer requirements, sales priorities, market challenges and upcoming business opportunities.

• Develop targeted campaigns and promotional materials to support product launches, sales initiatives and customer acquisition.

• Gather Sales feedback on lead quality, customer responses, competitor activities and market conditions, and use these insights to improve marketing messages and campaigns.

• Provide customised presentations, product information and customer communication materials, and review their effectiveness to improve Sales support.

• Participate in Sales and Business Development meetings and coordinate across relevant departments to align marketing supportwith commercial priorities

Requirements:

• Diploma or Professional Qualifications in Graphics Design, or a related field preferred.

• Possess skills in photography and video shooting

• Working knowledge of design software (e.g. Adobe Suite, Canva, Capcut)

• Familiar with digital marketing tools (e.g. Meta Ads, Google Analytics, Shopify and A.I.)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present effectively to clients, management, and team members.

• Adaptability to fast-paced and dynamic environments, with a willingness to learn and stay updated on design and market trends, and new technologies.

Employee Benefits

• Annual Wage Supplement (13th month)

• Training and Career Progression Opportunities

• Company Incentive Trips

• Annual Leave and Medical Benefits

Working Location: 1 Tampines North Drive 1, #04-18, T-Space, Singapore 528559
Working Hours: Mondays to Fridays, 8.30am to 5.30pm

• Liaise with customers and suppliers regarding orders and enquiries

description:
Sales Support – Marine Industry
Location: Singapore
Industry: Marine & Offshore / Shipping / Marine Equipment
About the Role
We are looking for a detail-oriented and organised Sales Support Executive to support the sales team in managing customer enquiries, quotations, orders and day-to-day sales activities within the marine industry.
The role will work closely with Sales Managers, Business Development Managers, customers, suppliers and internal departments to ensure that sales enquiries are handled efficiently and orders are processed accurately and on time.
This is a sales coordination and support role, with the primary focus on assisting the sales team rather than independently hunting for new business.
Key Responsibilities

• Provide day-to-day sales and administrative support to the marine sales team.

• Handle incoming customer enquiries and coordinate responses with the relevant Sales Manager or technical team.

• Prepare and issue quotations, proposals, price lists and sales documentation.

• Obtain pricing, availability and lead times from suppliers and manufacturers.

• Follow up with suppliers and internal departments on outstanding quotations and product information.

• Assist Sales Managers with customer follow-ups and quotation tracking.

• Process customer purchase orders and coordinate order fulfilment.

• Liaise with procurement, warehouse, logistics and operations teams to monitor order status.

• Provide customers with updates on pricing, order confirmation and delivery schedules.

• Maintain accurate records of quotations, purchase orders, sales orders and customer information.

• Track outstanding quotations and follow up to ensure timely closure.

• Assist with preparing sales reports, sales forecasts and pipeline updates.

• Support the sales team in preparing presentations, tenders and RFQ submissions.

• Coordinate customer meetings, appointments and sales activities.

• Assist with product enquiries by providing customers with relevant catalogues, specifications and technical documentation.

• Coordinate with finance teams regarding invoices, payment status and outstanding accounts where required.

• Assist in resolving customer issues by coordinating with the relevant internal departments.

Job Description
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Business Development Manager to expand our Reinforcement Steel business in Singapore. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing customer relationships, and promoting our range of Reinforcement Steel products, including Rebar, BRC Mesh and Cut & Bend services.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify and develop new business opportunities within Singapore's construction industry.

• Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.

• Self-motivated, proactive and able to work independently.

• Good problem-solving and relationship management skills.

• Develop and execute a structured new-business development strategy to achieve revenue and margin targets.
• Proactively identify and approach potential customers rather than relying solely on inbound enquiries.
• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects, opportunities and projects.

o Manufacturing transfer opportunities on PCBA requirements

o Production capacity constraints, Supplier consolidation initiatives

Assistant Relationship Manager – Corporate Banking
Job Summary
Support Relationship Managers in managing and developing corporate client relationships, including credit assessment, transaction execution, client servicing and ongoing account monitoring. Work closely with internal stakeholders to deliver timely client service and ensure compliance with the Bank’s policies and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Client Coverage and Business Development
• Assist Relationship Managers in managing corporate client portfolios, understanding client needs and identifying business opportunities.
• Support the assessment of new transactions and preparation of credit proposals, deal presentations and other business submissions.
• Participate in client meetings, customer visits and roadshows, and follow up on agreed action items.
Credit Assessment and Portfolio Monitoring
• Conduct financial and credit analysis, identify key risks and assist in structuring facilities with appropriate risk mitigants.
• Prepare credit applications, annual and interim reviews, including financial spreading, industry analysis and assessment of repayment capacity.
• Monitor account conduct, financial performance, facility utilization and compliance with approved conditions and covenants.
• Identify and escalate emerging credit concerns, excesses and deviations, and assist in obtaining necessary approvals or waivers and following up on remedial actions.
• Maintain complete and updated credit files and ensure timely completion of credit reviews and post-lending monitoring.
Transaction Execution and Client Servicing
• Assist in coordinating facility documentation, security arrangements and fulfilment of conditions precedent, working with internal teams, legal counsel and other lenders where required.
• Coordinate loan drawdowns, rollovers and other transaction requests, ensuring the necessary documentation and approvals are in place.
• Handle day-to-day client enquiries, including account matters, payments, balances and rate quotations, in coordination with relevant teams.
• Follow up on service issues and escalate matters appropriately to the Relationship Manager or relevant internal stakeholders.
Client Onboarding and Compliance
• Coordinate with clients, onboarding teams and Compliance to ensure timely completion of account opening, KYC, customer due diligence and periodic or trigger-event reviews.
• Assist in AML, sanctions and transaction-monitoring checks, including obtaining supporting information and following up on alerts with relevant teams.
• Ensure required checklists, client records and supporting documents are complete and maintained in accordance with the Bank’s policies and regulatory requirements.
Team Support
• Work closely with Relationship Managers, Operations, Risk and Compliance to support effective client coverage and transaction execution.
• Provide backup support to team members and undertake other duties assigned by the Head of Department or Relationship Managers.
Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
• Preferably 1–3 years of relevant experience in corporate banking, commercial banking or related financial services. Fresh graduates with a strong interest in corporate banking may also be considered.
• Basic understanding of financial statements, credit analysis and corporate banking products. Knowledge of trade finance, loan documentation and credit administration is an advantage.
• Familiarity with KYC, AML and relevant regulatory requirements is an advantage.
• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to prepare clear written submissions.
• Good communication, interpersonal and coordination skills.
• Well organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Proficiency in written and spoken English and Mandarin to support Chinese corporate clients and liaise with Chinese-speaking internal and external stakeholders on cross-border business.
• A responsible and proactive team player who can work independently and demonstrates a willingness to learn.

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people.
