description:
About Hagar Singapore
Hagar is an international organisation dedicated to supporting survivors of human trafficking, modern slavery and abuse. Through survivor-centred, trauma-informed programmes, Hagar works to support recovery, rebuild lives, strengthen communities and prevent further exploitation.
Hagar Singapore plays an important role in supporting Hagar's international programmes while developing local initiatives aligned with its mission.
We are seeking a committed, resourceful and experienced Programme Manager to help strengthen our programme development, implementation and impact measurement capabilities.
About the Role
The Programme Manager will lead the development, implementation and evaluation of Hagar Singapore's local programmes while supporting overseas field offices in strengthening programme proposals, implementation plans and impact reporting.
This is a dual-portfolio position combining hands-on programme management with international programme development and fundraising enablement.
The successful candidate will work closely with local community partners, Hagar's international field offices, and the Resource Development team to ensure programmes are evidence-based, financially realistic, responsive to community needs and supported by measurable outcomes.
A key responsibility is translating programme needs into compelling concept notes, funding proposals, programme updates and credible impact reports that demonstrate meaningful change in the lives of survivors and vulnerable communities.
The role requires someone who can combine strategic programme thinking with practical implementation, strong stakeholder engagement, analytical capabilities and excellent written communication.
Key Responsibilities
A. Local Programme Development & Implementation (50%)
1. Programme Strategy and Development

• Identify emerging community needs, service gaps and opportunities aligned with Hagar's mission in Singapore.

• Conduct needs assessments, environmental scans, stakeholder consultations and feasibility studies to inform programme development.

• Design local programmes and intervention models addressing survivor recovery, reintegration, prevention, community awareness and trauma-informed care.

• Establish programme objectives, target beneficiaries, eligibility criteria, intended outcomes and sustainability considerations.

• Develop theories of change, logic models, programme plans, implementation schedules and budgets.

• Identify opportunities to pilot, adapt or scale proven Hagar international interventions within the Singapore context.

2. Programme Implementation and Operations

• Lead the planning, coordination and implementation of approved local programmes and pilot initiatives.

• Develop implementation plans, milestones, operating procedures, resource requirements and performance indicators.

• Manage programme budgets, timelines, operational requirements and risks in collaboration with relevant colleagues.

• Coordinate delivery partners, service providers, volunteers and other stakeholders.

• Monitor programme performance, address implementation challenges and recommend corrective actions.

• Ensure programme delivery complies with appropriate professional, ethical, safeguarding and operational standards.

3. Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement

• Develop relationships with government agencies, social service agencies, community organisations, educational institutions and potential programme partners.

• Identify collaborative opportunities that strengthen programme effectiveness, reach and sustainability.

• Establish partnership arrangements with clearly defined objectives, responsibilities and performance expectations.

• Represent Hagar Singapore at relevant programme meetings, sector engagements and stakeholder discussions.

4. Programme Evaluation and Improvement

• Establish appropriate monitoring and evaluation frameworks for local programmes.

• Collect and analyse programme participation, delivery quality, beneficiary feedback and outcome data.

• Conduct regular programme reviews to assess effectiveness, relevance, efficiency and sustainability.

• Identify improvement opportunities and document programme learning and good practices.

• Prepare programme progress reports, case studies and outcome evidence for management, the Board and donors.

B. International Programme Development, Fundraising Enablement & MEL (50%)
1. International Programme Development and Field Collaboration

• Serve as a key programme liaison between Hagar Singapore and relevant international field offices.

• Work with field teams to understand programme priorities, community needs, implementation challenges, resource requirements and funding gaps.

• Review and strengthen programme concept notes, proposals, implementation plans and budgets to improve clarity, quality and funding readiness.

• Support field offices in translating programme activities into clearly articulated objectives, outputs, outcomes and intended long-term impact.

• Ensure programme proposals accurately reflect local conditions, implementation capacity, realistic commitments and community needs.

• Develop and maintain a structured portfolio of funding-ready programme opportunities for Hagar Singapore's Resource Development team.

2. Programme Proposals and Fundraising Support

• Collaborate with the Resource Development team to prepare compelling programme proposals for corporate partners, foundations, family offices, trusts and institutional donors.

• Develop concise programme summaries communicating the scale of the problem, urgency of intervention, proposed solutions and expected benefits to survivors and communities.

• Prepare comprehensive proposals incorporating needs assessments, programme rationale, theories of change, activities, implementation schedules, budgets, risks and measurable outcomes.

• Adapt programme documentation to different donor requirements while maintaining technical accuracy and programme integrity.

• Develop programme briefs, funding presentations, impact summaries and technical information for donor engagement and funding applications.

• Support donor meetings by providing programme insights, implementation details and evidence of outcomes.

• Collaborate with Finance and field offices to ensure programme budgets are realistic, complete and aligned with funding requirements.

3. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL)

• Develop and strengthen practical MEL frameworks for programmes supported by Hagar Singapore.

• Define appropriate performance indicators, baselines, targets, data sources, reporting frequencies and accountability arrangements.

• Ensure programmes clearly distinguish between activities, outputs, outcomes and longer-term impact.

• Establish reporting templates and programme dashboards to monitor implementation progress, funding utilisation and programme performance.

• Coordinate regular programme reviews with field offices to assess achievements, emerging risks, implementation challenges and learning opportunities.

• Support the collection and interpretation of quantitative and qualitative programme evidence, including beneficiary feedback and appropriately consented case studies.

• Translate programme results into accessible, credible donor-facing reports and impact narratives.

• Ensure impact claims are supported by appropriate evidence and distinguish verified results from anticipated longer-term changes.

4. Grant Management and Donor Accountability

• Maintain accurate programme records covering funding commitments, deliverables, milestones, reporting obligations and implementation progress.

• Coordinate with field offices, Finance and Resource Development to monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets.

• Track delivery against donor commitments and escalate material delays, budget variances and implementation risks.

• Coordinate timely preparation of programme updates, narrative reports and impact reports.

• Support donor visits, programme briefings, project reviews and due diligence processes.

• Maintain programme documentation and appropriate audit trails to support transparency, accountability and responsible stewardship of donor funds.

5. Programme Knowledge Management

• Develop and maintain a central repository of programme concept notes, proposals, budgets, results frameworks, progress reports and case studies.

• Establish common templates and minimum quality standards for programme documentation used in fundraising.

• Document effective interventions, implementation learning and programme outcomes across the Hagar network.

• Support consistent, evidence-based programme narratives that strengthen Hagar Singapore's credibility with donors and partners.

C. Cross-Cutting Responsibilities

• Uphold Hagar's survivor-centred and trauma-informed principles across programme design, implementation and reporting.

• Ensure appropriate safeguarding, confidentiality, consent and personal data protection practices.

• Promote meaningful participation and feedback from survivors and communities while minimising potential risks and burdens.

• Collaborate effectively with programme, fundraising, finance and international teams.

• Contribute to annual planning, organisational reporting, risk management and continuous improvement.

• Undertake other relevant responsibilities assigned by the Executive Director.

Requirements
Education and Professional Experience

• Bachelor's degree or Graduate Diploma in Social Work, Social Sciences, International Development, Psychology, Public Health or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.

• Minimum five years of relevant experience in programme development, programme management or social service delivery.

• Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, managing and evaluating social programmes.

• Experience preparing programme concept notes, funding proposals, implementation plans and budgets.

• Experience working with community partners, social service agencies, donors or international programme teams.

Technical Competencies

• Sound knowledge of programme planning, project management and implementation methodologies.

• Working knowledge of theories of change, logic models, results frameworks, performance indicators and outcome evaluation.

• Ability to translate community needs into structured programme interventions with measurable results.

• Strong proposal-writing skills, including the ability to communicate programme needs, urgency, interventions and expected outcomes to potential donors.

• Financial literacy, including programme budgeting, expenditure monitoring and grant accountability.

• Ability to analyse programme data and translate findings into meaningful reports and impact narratives.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management applications and basic reporting or dashboard tools.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Personal Attributes

• Strong commitment to Hagar's mission and the dignity, safety and wellbeing of survivors.

• Strategic and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving capabilities.

• Hands-on, resourceful and able to manage multiple priorities within a lean organisational environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate across cultures and organisational boundaries.

• Empathetic, culturally sensitive and committed to ethical, survivor-centred programming.

• Self-motivated, organised and accountable for delivering agreed outcomes.

• Comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a collaborative team.

Desirable Experience

• Familiarity with trauma-informed care, survivor rehabilitation, human trafficking prevention or safeguarding.

• Experience within Singapore's social service sector or international development organisations.

• Experience working with overseas programme teams or managing donor-funded programmes.

• Exposure to programme impact measurement, results-based management or grant reporting.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will contribute to:

• Developing and implementing credible, sustainable local programmes aligned with Hagar Singapore's mission.

• Building strong local programme partnerships and expanding opportunities for meaningful community impact.

• Strengthening the quality and funding readiness of international programme proposals.

• Equipping the Resource Development team with compelling, evidence-based programme propositions.

• Establishing practical MEL frameworks that demonstrate programme outputs, outcomes and longer-term impact.

• Improving programme reporting, donor accountability and organisational learning.

• Strengthening collaboration between Hagar Singapore and international field offices.

Why Join Hagar Singapore?
This is an opportunity to contribute directly to an organisation committed to helping survivors of human trafficking, modern slavery and abuse rebuild their lives.
You will have the opportunity to develop local initiatives, collaborate with international programme teams and help strengthen the connection between programme delivery, funding support and measurable social impact.
We are looking for someone who believes that good programmes should not only deliver activities but also demonstrate meaningful and lasting change in the lives of the people and communities they serve.
Join us in strengthening programmes, supporting survivors and creating meaningful, measurable impact.

• Produce group-level collateral for partnerships, institutional relationships, and investor-facing materials, working with Finance and Strategy.

• A strong visual eye and working proficiency in Canva or Figma; you can brief designers and also execute yourself.

• Comfort working directly with senior leaders and managing competing requests across countries and time zones.

• Active use of AI tools in your workflow, and the judgment to know where they help and where they don’t.

• Communications experience during fundraising, M&A, or rapid scale-up.

description:
About Dayos
Dayos is the AI-first version of the systems integrators and application management firms that have supported enterprise ERPs for decades. We're building this company in Singapore, for the long term.

Hero, our platform, doesn't just watch your systems. It logs in, does the work, and validates the output inside Oracle, Workday and SAP. At a Singapore enterprise, Hero closed 9 of 10 support tickets that had been open for an average of three weeks, taking roughly 10 minutes per request.

Every company in the world runs Oracle, Workday or SAP, and many run more than one. Yet no school teaches students how to implement and manage them, and fewer people do this work every year. That gap is what we're built to close.

Enterprises spend billions every year supporting these systems, and much of that work is still manual. Three years building Hero. Enterprise customers already in production. Now we're closing our seed round and building the Singapore go-to-market team from the ground up.

The Role
We're building our first Pre-Sales Consultant team in Singapore. This is a clear career path into enterprise AI sales, and it is not a high-volume seat. You'll research deeply, form a point of view, and open enterprise accounts other people can't.

You'll open accounts at the Oracle, Workday and SAP enterprises across Singapore and Southeast Asia who are quietly frustrated with what they're paying for support and what they're getting back. Your job is to find them, understand what's actually broken, and get them into a conversation with us.

You'll work directly with our founder, who runs every demo and owns every deal cycle as your Account Executive and serves as your workplace mentor. The AE owns the deal cycle, but the top of that cycle is yours: the research, the first outreach, the initial framing of the problem in our terms, and the handoff once the conversation is real.

You're not joining an established sales machine. You're helping build one. You'll be one of the first Pre-Sales Consultants on our team, learning together, competing for the best accounts, and writing the Singapore outbound playbook that every hire after you will follow.

This will be demanding. Enterprise sales means rejection, ambiguity and uncomfortable conversations with senior people. We'll give you unusual responsibility early, and we expect you to grow into it quickly.

Employment type: Full-time, permanent (12-month minimum commitment). Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents. Location: Singapore, on-site. Start date: December 2026 or January 2027.

What You'll Do
- Own the top of the funnel across a named-account territory of Oracle, Workday and SAP customers in the region
- Research the accounts struggling with the cost, responsiveness or quality of their current ERP and HCM support, and work out where Hero fits
- Write outreach that earns a reply. Across call, LinkedIn and email.
- Run discovery with the accounts that engage, and work out what's actually broken in their support model: tickets, cost, turnaround and quality
- Explain Hero in the buyer's terms, and answer first-line technical and commercial questions before the deal moves to your Account Executive
- Partner with your Account Executive on account strategy, and hand off qualified conversations when the fit is clear
- Join every demo you source and learn how enterprise deals actually close
- Feed the market back to us. You'll often know the market's real objection before anyone else in the company does
- Build pipeline strategy for a named territory, track outreach, reply and demo-booking rates, and defend it in weekly reviews with the founder
- Negotiate agreed next steps, demo commitments and scope with senior buyers, and support your Account Executive in first-line commercial discussions on Starter and Pro, to reach outcomes that work for both sides
- Use data analytics and AI tools to analyse outreach, reply and demo-booking data, build dashboards in HubSpot and Google Sheets, and generate insights that predict which target accounts are most likely to convert
- Document the Singapore outbound playbook from call reviews and live accounts, and coach the Pre-Sales Consultants who join after you on what works

Your Career Path
Our route to Account Executive runs through Solutions Engineering. We think the people who sell Hero should be able to demo it themselves.
- Months 0-3. Master enterprise prospecting, Hero, Oracle/Workday/SAP economics and executive outreach, with live shadowing on active accounts
- Months 3-6. Own account strategy and qualified pipeline across your named enterprise accounts, with weekly 1:1s with the founder
- Months 6-12. Begin running discovery and participating directly in enterprise deal cycles alongside our founder
- After 12 months, Solutions Engineer. Top-performing Pre-Sales Consultants who hit quota are considered for our Solutions Engineering training programme. You run your own demos and your base goes up 20%
- Next, Account Executive. Top-performing Solutions Engineers who make quota are considered for promotion, with another 20% raise

What You Bring
Formal sales experience isn't expected.
- Charisma and hustle. You read a room fast, get people talking, and don't wait for someone to hand you the next move
- Evidence of unusual performance. Your career, athletics, building something of your own, fundraising, sales: anywhere the results were measurable and stood out
- Real curiosity about big enterprises. You want to understand why a Fortune 500 finance team is stuck on a support ticket for three weeks, and you'll dig until you know
- Work experience outside sales. Finance, HR, procurement, IT or anywhere else. If you've worked inside Oracle, Workday or SAP, even better
- A strong writer. You can turn ten minutes of research on a company into a three-sentence email a CIO actually reads
- A strong communicator on the phone. You build rapport fast and hold your own with senior finance, procurement and HR leaders
- Resilient by disposition. Cold outreach means constant no's, and you treat each one as information about the market
- A growth mindset. You want the hard feedback from call reviews because it's the fastest way to get better
- Fluent with AI tools. You use them daily and have a point of view on how a lean go-to-market team should run on them

What You'll Learn
By the end of your first year, with weekly call reviews and direct coaching from our founder:
- Communicate with senior finance, IT and procurement leaders, handle objections, and hold your own in executive-level conversations
- Speak fluently about Oracle, Workday and SAP economics: what they cost, what they replace, and where they fail
- Understand how AI is reshaping enterprise operations, not at a headline level but in the details buyers care about
- Build pipeline strategy for a named territory and defend it in weekly reviews
- Run discovery, qualify opportunities, and progress deals toward close

Compensation and Benefits
- Base salary. S$3,000 to S$5,600 per month, depending on experience
- Commission. S$700 per qualified demo held, S$2,400 when that demo closes as Starter, S$3,600 when it closes as Pro. Uncapped, with accelerators above quota
- Career growth. +20% base on promotion to Solutions Engineer, another +20% on promotion to Account Executive
- Leave. Unlimited PTO, plus Singapore public holidays
- Medical. Comprehensive coverage included
- CPF. Contributions for eligible employees
- Global exposure. Customers across Southeast Asia, North America and Europe. Regional travel comes with the seat as accounts mature
- Equipment. Whatever you need to do the job well

Interview Process
- Phone screen, 30 minutes. Align on the role, your background and timing
- Written exercise. A short research task on a real enterprise, and the outreach you'd write off it
- Role play, 45 minutes. A cold call and an objection-handling scenario, together
- Founder conversation, 30 minutes. Mission, expectations, mutual fit

4. Support BLG team’s efforts in identifying, cultivating, and maintaining relationships with Prominent Business Leaders (PBLs), key opinion leaders (KOLs) with significant economic interests in both China and Singapore, and the region.

About Us
We are a Singapore-based investment company with exposure across global index ETFs, bonds, hedge funds, private credit, private equity (funds and direct investments), real estate and digital assets within approved limits. We operate through an institutionalised investment process with tiered due diligence, independent risk review and Investment Committee decision-making.
Role Overview
This is a hands-on investment role in a lean family office for an experienced professional who can take substantial ownership of the full investment lifecycle - from opportunity screening, analysis and due diligence through Investment Committee approval, transaction execution, ongoing monitoring and eventual exit. The role also contributes to portfolio implementation and monitoring within the CIO/IC-approved framework.
Candidates with approximately 6 years of relevant experience may be considered at Senior Investment Analyst level. Candidates demonstrating independent transaction ownership may be appointed Investment Manager. Candidates with strong portfolio-management experience - including portfolio construction, asset allocation and SAA/TAA - may be appointed Portfolio Manager.
Key Responsibilities
· Screen and prioritise fund, manager, private credit, private equity direct and co-investment opportunities and maintain a clear investment pipeline.
· Lead qualitative and quantitative fund/manager due diligence, including investment process, performance, risk, capacity, fees, terms, operational due diligence and conflicts.
· Lead or coordinate commercial, financial and investment due diligence on private equity direct and co-investments, including external legal, tax, financial and valuation work where required.
· Build and review financial models and analyse LPAs, PPMs, term sheets, shareholder agreements and transaction structures, identifying material commercial terms, downside protections and exit mechanics.
· Prepare concise, decision-ready investment memoranda and Investment Committee materials, and clearly present recommendations, key risks, open items and proposed mitigants.
· Support and, where assigned, independently manage post-IC execution, signing/closing, ongoing monitoring and eventual exit, coordinating with advisers, counterparties and financial institutions.

· 6+ years of relevant experience in buy-side investing, family office, FoF/fund research, private equity, private credit, investment banking M&A or transaction services.

· Experience across fund/manager due diligence and direct/co-investment analysis, with strong financial modelling capability.
· Ability to independently read and analyse LPAs, PPMs, term sheets, shareholder agreements and related investment documents and identify the commercial implications of key provisions.
· Ability to assess liquidity, concentration, asset allocation and portfolio fit. Candidates considered for Portfolio Manager title should demonstrate strong portfolio construction, asset allocation and SAA/ TAA experience.
· Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to produce decision-ready Investment Committee materials and clearly articulate investment risks and open issues.
Preferred
· Multi-asset family office, FoF, private markets or portfolio-management experience.
· CFA, CAIA, CPA/CA or another relevant professional qualification; practical investment capability remains the primary consideration.
· Familiarity with PitchBook, Preqin, eFront or similar databases/systems.
· Relevant investment, GP, private-bank or professional networks in Singapore and/or China.

Job Description
As a Technical Pre-Sales Business Consultant, you will work closely with the Business Development Director and business development team to understand clients' business and technical requirements, translate those requirements into suitable solutions, and support the team throughout the sales and solution-development process.
You will act as a bridge between clients, the commercial team, technology partners and solution providers. The role combines technical understanding, business analysis, client engagement and consultative solution development. You do not need to be a software developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how technologies and systems work and explaining them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You will gain hands-on exposure to Nabcore's physical and digital brand protection, product authentication, tracking and anti-counterfeiting solutions. You will participate in client discovery sessions, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concept activities, proposal preparation and technical-commercial presentations.
You will be expected to understand the client's problem before recommending a solution. As your product and industry knowledge develops, you will progressively take greater ownership of solution discussions, technical presentations, proposals and pre-sales engagements.
For experienced professionals transitioning from another industry, we recognise that you may bring valuable transferable capabilities in areas such as Sales, IT, Enterprise solutions, Project management, Operations, Consulting, Technical sales, Account management or Customer engagement.

Job Requirement
We welcome candidates from different career stages and professional backgrounds. Prior experience in brand protection or anti-counterfeiting is not essential. We are interested in your technical aptitude, problem-solving ability, client-facing capabilities, potential, attitude and transferable experience.
• Interest in technology, business problem-solving and client-facing work.
• Ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into practical business solutions.
• Good written, verbal and presentation skills.
• Confidence engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, industries and business models.
• Resourcefulness and the ability to work through unfamiliar challenges.
• Initiative, ownership and the ability to follow through on commitments.
• Good organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a dynamic SME environment.
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous, but is not mandatory:
• Technical pre-sales or solutions consulting
• Software, SaaS or enterprise technology
• Engineering or technical project management
• Business analysis
• Implementation or solution delivery
• Technical account management or customer success
• Technology consulting
• Operations involving technology or process improvement
• Business development with strong technical exposure
Fresh graduates, experienced professionals, candidates affected by restructuring or retrenchment, individuals returning to the workforce, and candidates seeking a career transition are welcome to apply. Moving into a new industry does not mean starting from zero; relevant transferable experience can provide a strong foundation for this role.

This job position is supported by Career Conversion Program (CCP). Successful candidate will have to go through up to 6 months of training.
Job Function
• Client Discovery & Requirements Analysis: Engage clients to understand their business, operational and technical needs; gather requirements and translate them into clear solution requirements, workflows and use cases.
• Technical Pre-Sales & Solution Design: Design and recommend suitable solutions using Nabcore’s physical and digital security, authentication, tracking and anti-counterfeiting technologies, while assessing feasibility, integration needs and technical risks.
• Sales & Business Development Support: Support the business development team throughout the sales cycle, including client meetings, presentations, proposals, quotations, RFIs/RFPs, tenders and technical submissions.
• Solution Demonstration & Proof of Concept: Prepare and conduct solution demonstrations, proof-of-concepts and pilot activities; define success criteria, gather feedback and facilitate handover to implementation.
• Market, Product & Technology Intelligence: Research competitors, market trends and emerging technologies, and identify potential technology partners and new capabilities that can strengthen Nabcore’s solutions.
• Projects & Continuous Improvement: Participate in client and internal projects, collaborate with relevant stakeholders, document outcomes and continuously improve pre-sales processes, solution materials and client experience.
• Ownership & Delivery: Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects, ensuring agreed deliverables are completed effectively and on time

· Technical pre-sales and consultative solution selling
· Business and technical requirements analysis
· Solution design and solution architecture thinking
· Client discovery and stakeholder engagement
· Product and solution demonstrations
· Proof-of-concept and pilot planning
· Proposal, RFI, RFP and tender preparation
· Technical-commercial presentations
· Project coordination and implementation handover
· Brand protection and anti-counterfeiting technologies
· Product authentication and track-and-trace solutions
· Business development and commercial negotiation
· Technology and market analysis

About Resaro
Resaro was founded on the belief that AI will change the world in ways we cannot even imagine, but every new technology needs safeguards to advance.

description:
Role overview:
The Cash Management Implementation Manager owns client onboarding for Transaction Banking, taking corporate and institutional clients from signed mandate to live, stable usage. The role covers cash management (accounts, liquidity and payment/collection services), SWIFT connectivity (MT/MX, FileAct), host-to-host (H2H) integration, online banking and e-commerce collection solutions.
You will be working closely with Corporate Banking, Product, IT, Operations, Legal & Compliance and China Head Office to deliver complex mandates on time, within risk appetite, and with a strong client experience.
Key responsibilities:
Client implementation and onboarding
• Lead end-to-end implementation of cash management mandates, from kick-off and requirements gathering through solution design, documentation, testing, go-live and post-implementation support.
• Act as the client's main point of contact during onboarding, running project plans, status meetings and issue logs to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
• Ensure complete and accurate onboarding documentation and system set-up, in line with KYC, legal and internal control requirements.
Connectivity and channels
• Implement host-to-host connectivity, including SFTP set-up, encryption/key exchange, file format mapping (ISO 20022 pain/camt, MT940/942, CSV and proprietary formats) and acknowledgement/status reporting.
• Onboard clients onto SWIFT channels (MT101, MT940/942, ISO 20022 MX, SCORE/FileAct), coordinating BIC/RMA set-up and testing with clients and Operations.
• Implement cross-border cash pooling structures, covering structure set-up, participating account linkage, sweep rules and testing with clients and China Head Office.
• Set up and configure online banking for corporate clients, including user entitlements, approval workflows, token/authentication set-up and user training.
• Implement e-commerce and digital collection solutions (e.g. payment gateway, PayNow/QR, virtual accounts, eGIRO/direct debit), including merchant onboarding, API/plug-in integration and reconciliation set-up.
Testing and go-live
• Plan and coordinate connectivity and user acceptance testing (UAT) with clients, IT and Head Office, track defects to resolution, and obtain sign-off before go-live.
• Manage go-live cutover, monitor initial live transactions, and resolve post-implementation queries and incidents promptly.
Stakeholder management and pre-sales support
• Partner with Corporate Banking and Product teams in pre-sales, providing technical and implementation input to proposals, solution designs and RFP responses.
• Liaise with China Head Office and IT on system configuration, enhancements and change requests to meet local client requirements.
• Provide clear implementation updates and pipeline reporting to management.
Process, risk and continuous improvement
• Develop, maintain and execute implementation procedures, checklists and templates; identify and streamline processes to shorten time-to-revenue and improve client experience.
• Ensure implementations comply with internal policies, MAS regulations, technology risk management guidelines and audit requirements; support risk assessments, audits and control testing.
• Capture client feedback and recurring issues, and feed them into the product roadmap and system enhancement requests.
• Keep abreast of market developments, including ISO 20022 migration, API banking and new payment rails, and help the team adapt implementation capabilities accordingly.

Requirements:
• A recognised university degree in Banking, Finance, Business, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent professional qualifications.
• At least 5 years of experience in cash management implementation, client onboarding, client service or channels management at a financial institution.
• Hands-on experience implementing: host-to-host, SWIFT, corporate online banking, or e-commerce/digital collection solutions.
• Good working knowledge of payment and collection products, clearing systems (e.g. MEPS+, FAST, GIRO, PayNow) and cross-border payment flows.
• Familiarity with banking file formats and standards (ISO 20022, SWIFT MT, BAI2, CSV), SFTP/encryption, APIs and ERP integration (e.g. SAP, Oracle).
• Strong project management skills, with proven ability to run multiple implementations in parallel and meet deadlines.
• Effectively bilingual in English and Chinese, to communicate with China Head Office and Chinese-speaking clients.
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage client treasury and IT teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a high sense of ownership.
• Positive, resourceful and independent, with the ability to multi-task under pressure.

As a Management Trainee, you will rotate through the following critical areas of restaurant operations:

• Manage food and beverage inventory; conduct weekly counts and place orders with vendors.

• Ensure strict compliance with health, safety, and sanitation standards (e.g., ServSafe).

4. Financial Performance

• Learn to analyze weekly sales reports and cost of goods sold (COGS).

• Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business, or a related field (preferred but not required).

• [OR] Equivalent of 1-2 years of experience in a fast-paced environment (retail, hospitality, or food service).

• Strong computer literacy (MS Office, POS systems).

• Relentless Drive: You are self-motivated and eager to learn.

• Resilience: You thrive in a fast-paced, high-energy environment and can handle the heat during rush hour.

• Punctuality: You understand that "on time" means "15 minutes early."

description:
About the role
We are building Maxify, an AI-native operating platform where agents own real business workflows, act through company systems and remain accountable to source data, permissions, evaluations and measurable outcomes.
We are looking for a junior management trainee to build and operate production AI workflows on top of our shared platform. You will translate validated business processes into reliable agents that connect to company data, tools and systems and produce measurable outcomes.
This is not a prompt-writing or chatbot role. You will own complete workflows from discovery and tool design through testing, deployment, monitoring and improvement.
What you will own

• Validate users, pain points, sources of truth, baseline metrics and expected value before building.

• Model business processes as explicit states, actions, decisions, approvals and exception paths.

• Build business-specific agents that complete production workflows end-to-end.

• Develop tools, structured outputs and context strategies.

• Integrate approved APIs, databases and enterprise systems.

• Use deterministic code where probabilistic model behavior is unnecessary or unsafe.

• Create evaluations for completion, accuracy, safety and business outcomes.

• Implement monitoring, escalation, exception handling and human-review paths.

• Diagnose failures and convert repeated issues into tests, guardrails or platform requirements.

• Measure revenue, cost, customer-experience or operational-attention improvement.

What we are looking for

• Strong production software engineering ability in Python and/or TypeScript.

• Experience building LLM applications, agents or substantial workflow automation.

• Experience with APIs, webhooks, databases and asynchronous processing.

• Ability to translate ambiguous operations into explicit system behavior.

• Understanding of tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, context management and model limitations.

• Experience testing deterministic and non-deterministic systems.

• Strong debugging skills across instructions, application code, data, tools and external services.

• Good judgment about when to use an LLM, deterministic code or human approval.

• Ability to connect engineering work to measurable business outcomes.

• Clear written communication, high agency and rapid learning.

Strong signals

• You have shipped an agent or automation that performs real actions in production.

• You can demonstrate measurable business impact from something you built.

• You design approval, exception and escalation paths instead of assuming perfect model behavior.

• You use AI development tools heavily while verifying and owning the result.

• You can explain a failed workflow run, identify the root cause and show the prevention mechanism.

• You understand that reliable agents require source data, workflow state, tools, evaluations and observability, not prompts alone.

Nice to have

• Experience with OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, OpenClaw or comparable systems.

• Experience with Lark/Feishu, Shopify, CRM, accounting or enterprise SaaS integrations.

• Experience with workflow automation or operations-heavy products.

• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, ontology design or governed memory.

• Experience working directly with business teams or customers.

What this role is not

• Prompt engineering without code or operational ownership.

• Building isolated chatbot demonstrations.

• Pure machine-learning research or model training.

• Pure frontend, data-science or infrastructure work.

• Allowing agents to act without evaluations, permissions or traceability.

Success in the first 30 days

• Validate one business workflow, its source of truth and baseline performance.

• Map its states, tools, decisions, approvals and exception paths.

• Ship at least one meaningful production improvement.

• Deliver one production workflow on the shared platform.

• Add evaluations covering normal, edge and failure cases.

• Implement monitoring, escalation and human-review paths.

• Demonstrate measurable improvement in speed, quality, cost or customer experience.

• Identify at least one reusable requirement for the shared platform.

These outcomes are subject to timely access and platform readiness.
How we work

• We move quickly and build for permanence.

• We start from the business outcome and source of truth.

• We use deterministic systems where they are more reliable.

• We treat evaluations, observability and recovery as part of the product.

• AI accelerates the work; it does not remove engineering accountability.

Interview process
Shortlisted candidates will complete an onsite prototyping test based on a practical AI workflow. We evaluate working output, engineering judgment, effective use of AI tools, debugging ability and clarity of explanation.

description:
Exciting news! We are on a growing journey and building a stellar team!
At Sunnystep, we are not just building leaders – we are cultivating a dynamic team that thrives on innovation, collaboration, and collective success.

Why should you be part of Sunnystep’s success?
We are an innovative force in consumer retail with a clear brand purpose — we believe wellness starts with our feet. Good shoes support our feet and our body, and help us move and live better.

We are redefining comfort in every step to an unparalleled experience without compromising on style. Our mission is to revolutionize the footwear industry by crafting the most comfortable shoes with unwavering commitment to environmental responsibility ensuring that every step our customers take not only embodies unrivalled comfort but also leaves a positive impact on the planet.

The Management Trainee is a dynamic and developmental role designed for recent graduates or early-career professionals seeking to build a career in management. The trainee will undergo a structured training program to gain hands-on experience across multiple departments, including marketing, sales, operations, and consumer service. The goal is to develop well-rounded managers who understand the various facets of the business and can contribute to its growth and success.

You will also be responsible for:

• Training and Development:
Participate in a comprehensive training program designed to provide knowledge and skills across various departments of the business.
Attend workshops, seminars, and training sessions to gain insights into company operations and industry best practices.
Complete assigned projects and tasks to develop practical experience in different areas of the business.

• Cross-Departmental Experience:
Rotate through key departments such as Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Customer Service to gain a holistic understanding of the business.
Assist in the execution of department-specific tasks and projects, providing support to managers and team members.
Learn and apply departmental processes, systems, and tools to contribute effectively to ongoing projects.

• Project Management:
Take ownership of specific projects or initiatives within different departments, ensuring timely and successful completion.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project objectives and deliver results.
Monitor project progress, report on key milestones, and address any issues or challenges that arise.

• Performance and Reporting:
Track and report on performance metrics related to departmental goals and individual projects.
Analyze data and provide insights to improve processes and drive business outcomes.
Present findings and recommendations to management based on project results and performance evaluations.

• Strategic Contributions:
Contribute to strategic planning and decision-making processes by providing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas.
Support the implementation of new strategies and initiatives designed to improve business performance.
Assist in identifying opportunities for operational efficiencies and process improvements.

• Team Collaboration:
Work closely with team members and managers to support daily operations and project tasks.
Engage in team meetings, brainstorming sessions, and collaborative activities to contribute to departmental goals.
Build strong working relationships across the organization to foster a collaborative and supportive work environment.

• Professional Development:
Seek feedback from mentors, managers, and peers to continuously improve skills and performance.
Pursue additional learning opportunities and certifications relevant to career development and the consumer brand industry.
Demonstrate a commitment to personal and professional growth through proactive learning and development initiatives.

We would want to speak with you if you are / have –

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Operations, Finance, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

• 0-2 years of relevant work experience or internships, preferably within the consumer goods industry.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with business software and tools.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

It would be great if you have:

• Experience with project management tools and techniques.

• Knowledge of industry trends and consumer behavior.

• Familiarity with digital marketing, sales strategies, or operational processes.

Headquartered in Singapore, Sunnystep is committed to fostering community, inclusivity, integrity, and technology to support everybody’s journey of possibilities.
We review each application thoroughly and will arrange an initial discussion with the shortlisted candidates who best meet our requirements. If you find that the requirements align to your experience and expertise, you may express your interest through this job advertisement or you may reach out to our Hiring Team – hiring@sunnystep.com.

description:
At Conrad Hotels & Resorts, we believe that true luxury is being yourself. As a member of Hilton's luxury portfolio, Conrad delivers intuitive service, meaningful connections, and purposeful experiences that empower both our guests and our Team Members.
The Cluster Learning & Development Manager serves as a strategic business partner and culture champion responsible for driving learning excellence, leadership development, talent growth, service culture, and organizational effectiveness across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
This role is instrumental in cultivating a high-performance learning culture that reflects Conrad's Luxury Service Standards, Hilton Values, and Employer of Choice aspirations. The incumbent acts as a catalyst for continuous learning, leadership capability building, and cultural transformation while ensuring that all Team Members are equipped to deliver exceptional guest experiences with passion, purpose, and excellence.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As a Cluster Learning & Development Manager , you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
Learning & Development Strategy
• Develop and execute the annual Cluster Learning & Development Strategy aligned with business goals, Conrad Brand Standards, and Hilton's global learning framework.
• Lead the design, implementation, and evaluation of all learning and capability-building initiatives across both hotels.
• Establish a culture of continuous learning that supports operational excellence, talent retention, and career growth.
• Identify learning needs through performance data, guest feedback, quality audits, and business priorities.
• Ensure training interventions deliver measurable improvements in guest satisfaction, team engagement, and operational performance.
Luxury Service Culture & Brand Excellence
• Champion the Conrad Luxury Service Culture and ensure all Team Members understand and embody Conrad's service philosophy.
• Facilitate and sustain brand immersion programmes that reinforce luxury hospitality standards and memorable guest experiences.
• Lead initiatives that strengthen service excellence, guest engagement, and personalized luxury experiences.
• Collaborate with department leaders to embed brand standards into everyday operations and team behaviors.
Leadership Development
• Develop leadership capability at all levels through structured learning programs, succession planning initiatives, and coaching interventions.
• Facilitate Hilton leadership development programs and support participation in regional and global learning initiatives.
• Coach Department Heads, Managers, and Supervisors in leadership effectiveness, performance management, communication, and people development.
• Support talent reviews and succession planning processes to strengthen leadership bench strength across both properties.
Team Member Development
• Drive onboarding, orientation, and assimilation programmes to ensure a strong Team Member experience from day one.
• Manage and facilitate all mandatory Hilton and hotel-specific training programs.
• Design learning pathways that support technical skills, service excellence, cross-functional exposure, and career growth.
• Support individual development plans and facilitate career conversations across all levels.
• Mentor high-potential Team Members and emerging leaders.
Talent Management & Organizational Development
• Partner with the Human Resources team and business leaders to support talent management, succession planning, and workforce capability development.
• Support organizational change initiatives, culture transformation projects, and employee engagement strategies.
• Conduct learning and development needs analyses to address capability gaps and future business requirements.
• Facilitate interventions that improve team effectiveness, collaboration, and workplace culture.
Departmental Training Excellence & Train-the-Trainer Programme
• Develop, implement, formalize, and continuously enhance a comprehensive Cluster Train-the-Trainer (TTT) Programme across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
• Establish a structured departmental trainer framework to ensure every department maintains qualified and certified trainers who support ongoing learning and capability development.
• Partner with Department Heads to identify, appoint, and develop Departmental Trainers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
• Facilitate Train-the-Trainer certification programmes focusing on adult learning principles, facilitation skills, coaching techniques, presentation effectiveness, and learning evaluation.
• Ensure departmental trainers are equipped to deliver onboarding, technical skills, luxury service standards, compliance, and brand-related training programmes consistently.
• Monitor trainer effectiveness through training audits, observations, participant feedback, and business performance indicators.
• Conduct regular trainer calibration sessions to ensure consistency in learning delivery and alignment with Conrad Brand Standards and Hilton learning philosophies.
• Create and maintain a training governance framework that drives accountability for learning delivery within every department.
• Recognize and celebrate training champions who demonstrate excellence in developing Team Members and fostering a learning culture.
Training Planning & Coordination
• Lead the annual and quarterly learning planning process across both hotels, ensuring training initiatives are strategically aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.
• Develop comprehensive learning calendars and training schedules that maximize participation while minimizing operational disruption.
• Prioritize learning activities effectively across multiple stakeholders, locations, and business demands.
• Ensure all learning programmes are delivered within established timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
• Maintain strong project management discipline in the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of all learning initiatives.
• Utilize data and workforce insights to forecast learning needs and proactively address capability gaps.
Operational Partnership
• Build strong partnerships with General Managers, Executive Committee Members, and Department Heads to align learning initiatives with business needs.
• Conduct regular training reviews and learning effectiveness discussions with department leaders.
• Support operational departments with coaching, facilitation, and performance improvement initiatives.
• Ensure learning interventions support key commercial, operational, guest experience, and people metrics.
Learning Administration & Compliance
• Manage Hilton learning systems and ensure compliance with all required training and certification programmes.
• Maintain accurate training records, training reports, and compliance documentation.
• Monitor completion rates and effectiveness of mandatory, brand, safety, and compliance training.
• Ensure all learning activities meet company, legislative, and operational requirements.
Internship, Education & External Partnerships
• Develop strategic partnerships with educational institutions, hospitality schools, and training providers.
• Manage internship programmes, management trainee programmes, and industry attachment opportunities.
• Represent both hotels at learning, talent, and employer branding initiatives.
• Maintain active relationships with relevant government agencies and workforce development organizations.
• Stay informed on national training grants, funding schemes, and workforce development initiatives applicable to the hospitality industry.
Financial Management
• Prepare and manage the annual Cluster Learning & Development budget.
• Monitor monthly training expenditure and maximize training resources efficiently.
• Ensure effective utilization of Hilton learning resources, government grants, and training support programmes.
• Track return on investment and overall effectiveness of learning initiatives.
• The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Education
• Degree or Diploma in Human Resources, Learning & Development, Hospitality Management, Organizational Development, Psychology, Business Administration, or related discipline.
• Professional certifications in learning, facilitation, coaching, or talent development are advantageous.

Experience
• Minimum 5 years of progressive Learning & Development experience within luxury hospitality, hotels, or service industries.
• Prior experience in a management-level L&D role.
• Cluster or multi-property experience preferred.
• Experience in leadership development, organizational development, talent management, and facilitation.

Knowledge & Skills
• Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
• Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality service standards.
• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
• Proven coaching and mentoring capability.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Excellent project management and organizational skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and digital learning platforms.
• Ability to analyze training data and demonstrate business impact.

Essential Competencies
• Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Train-the-Trainer programmes and departmental trainer networks.
• Strong organizational, planning, and project management capabilities.
• Exceptional time management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities across a cluster environment.
• Ability to develop structured learning roadmaps, training calendars, and succession-focused development plans.
• Strong attention to detail and follow-through with demonstrated execution excellence.
• Ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability for learning outcomes across all departments.
• Excellent facilitation, coaching, and mentoring skills.
• Strong analytical capability with the ability to measure and demonstrate learning effectiveness and business impact.
How We’ll Help You Thrive
At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:
Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you covered
*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

description:
About the Role
Build your career through AKC’s two year Management Trainee Programme, designed to develop future Team Leads and business leaders.
You will complete four six-month rotations across Customer Success& Marketing, Revenue, Training Management and Compliance, and Business Development. Through hands-on assignments, mentorship and cross-functional projects, you will gain a strong understanding of AKC’s customers, operations, products and growth strategies.
High-performing trainees may be considered for progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist position upon successful completion.
What You’ll Be Doing
1. Customer Success & Marketing

• Conduct market and competitor research.

• Follow up on leads, registrations and customer engagement.

• Support digital campaigns, paid advertising, content creation and course promotions.

• Assist with roadshows, events and course launches.

• Track campaign performance, lead generation and conversions.

2. Revenue

• Support sales pipelines, revenue tracking and performance reporting.

• Maintain accurate records across CRM, ERP and reporting systems.

• Analyse business data and identify performance trends.

• Support workflow improvement, automation and digitalisation projects.

3. Business Development

• Research new markets, clients and partnership opportunities.

• Support corporate outreach, meetings and presentations.

• Prepare proposals, quotations and tender submissions.

• Assist with partnerships, new courses and business expansion projects.

4. Training Management and Compliance

• Support the planning, coordination, and administration of training programmes.

• Coordinate training materials, assessments and certification records.

• Assist with quality assurance, audits and regulatory compliance.

• Monitor compliance processes and recommend improvements where appropriate.

Leadership Development
In addition to the four rotations, you will:

• Receive coaching and mentorship from staff and senior leaders.

• Lead or support cross-functional projects.

• Present recommendations and project outcomes to management.

• Develop skills in decision-making, communication and stakeholder management.

• Take on increasing responsibility throughout the programme.

• Build the capabilities needed to progress into a Team Lead position.

What You’ll Gain

• Four structured six-month departmental rotations to develop a holistic understanding of the business.

• Practical experience solving real business and operational challenges.

• Potential progression into a Team Lead or suitable specialist role

What We’re Looking For

• Diploma or degree in Business Management or related disciplines

• Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome.

• Strong interest in business management and leadership.

• Good communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proactive, adaptable and willing to take ownership.

• Able to work independently and collaborate across teams.

description:
Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. We are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. Whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or AI/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.
Summary
We are seeking ambitious, high-potential graduates and early-career professionals for Sanmina’s Accelerated Leadership Pathway (ALPS)—an intensive 2.5-year management trainee programme designed to cultivate our next generation of global manufacturing leaders. In this fast-track rotational program, you will complete structured assignments across five core functional pillars: Quality Assurance, Program Management, Material Control, Manufacturing & Test Engineering, and Production. Working side-by-side with senior operations executives and cross-functional teams, you will tackle high-impact Lean projects, master advanced PCBA and box-build operations, solve complex engineering and supply chain challenges, and develop the strategic vision and executive acumen required to lead world-class manufacturing organizations.
What You'll Do

• Rotate across five key operational departments—Quality Assurance, Program Management, Material Control, Manufacturing & Test Engineering, and Production—to master the end-to-end electronics manufacturing lifecycle.

• Champion Quality Management Systems (QMS) governance, ensuring rigorous adherence to international medical, industrial, and automotive standards.

• Partner with global OEM customers in Program Management, orchestrating product portfolios from initial demand forecasting through final fulfillment.

• Manage inventory flow and supply chain logistics in Material Control to mitigate component bottlenecks and ensure 100% production uptime.

• Drive New Product Introduction (NPI) roadmaps and process engineering optimizations for complex, high-reliability electronic assemblies.

• Develop, evaluate, and troubleshoot advanced test platforms and inspection equipment to safeguard hardware performance and product yield.

• Gain direct frontline leadership experience in Production by supervising high-speed assembly lines, balancing workflows, and driving team productivity.

• Take ownership of high-impact Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and Kaizen initiatives from day one to eliminate operational waste and shorten cycle times.

• Engage with executive mentors and senior leaders through dedicated 1-on-1 coaching to refine your leadership capabilities and strategic problem-solving skills.

• Leverage digital workflows and AI-assisted tools to automate operational reporting and extract actionable manufacturing insights.

• Transition upon successful program completion into a full-time leadership role aligned with your core operational strengths.

What You'll Bring

About Sanmina
Sanmina Corporation (Nasdaq: SANM) is a leading integrated manufacturing solutions provider serving the fastest-growing segments of the global Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) market. Recognized as a technology leader, Sanmina Corporation provides end-to-end manufacturing solutions, delivering superior quality and support to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) primarily in the communications networks, defense and aerospace, industrial and semiconductor systems, medical, multimedia, computing and storage, automotive and clean technology sectors. Sanmina Corporation has facilities strategically located in key regions throughout the world.

Role Overview
Sanmina’s Accelerated Leadership Pathway (ALPS) is a 2.5-years management trainee programme aimed to develop high-potential engineering, operations, and business graduates into future leaders in complex, global manufacturing operations.
As an ALPS Management Trainee, you will be rotated through 5 different departments to gain a deep understanding of our manufacturing ecosystem. You will engage in strategic, engineering, and operational tasks to build a well-rounded foundation for a future leadership career at Sanmina.

• Quality Assurance: Oversee Quality Management Systems ensuring compliance with global medical and industrial standards.

• Program Management: Serve as the strategic bridge with global customers, orchestrating complex portfolios from forecast to fulfillment.

• Material Control: Manage inventory flow and supply chain activities to support efficient, uninterrupted production.

• Manufacturing and Test Engineering: Lead New Product Introductions (NPI) and optimize manufacturing processes for complex electronic products and develop test solutions and troubleshoot advanced hardware to ensure product performance and reliability.

• Production: Gain hands-on experience managing high-speed production lines and diverse teams while driving efficiency in a fast-paced environment.

Who Should Apply
We are seeking highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to learn and grow. The ideal candidate will possess excellent analytical capabilities and good communication skills.

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, or a related field. Graduates or candidates with 3 years of electronics manufacturing experience are welcome to apply.

• Strong track record of leadership or initiative in student associations, sports, volunteering, or co-curricular activities.

• Strong interest to build a career in Contract Electronics Manufacturing.

• Proficiency in Google Workspace, and basic knowledge of AI tools.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, manufacturing processes, and quality concepts gained through academic coursework, projects, internships, or practical training.

• Able to work collaboratively in a manufacturing and cross-functional team environment.

• Fast learner, take initiative, and develop technical and professional skills in a hands-on engineering environment.

Why ALPS

• Build Your Network: Work directly alongside senior executives and cross-functional teams.

• Drive LEAN Projects: Take ownership of high-impact manufacturing and business challenges from day one.

• Discover Your Strengths: Rotate across core functions to identify where you build your career within Sanmina.

• 1-on-1 Mentorship: Receive dedicated coaching throughout the program to provide an alternative perspective and nurture your professional development journey.

• Accelerate Your Growth: Build the technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and business perspective needed to take on increasing responsibilities.

Training & Development
By the end of ALPS, you will have:

• Operational Excellence: Deep operational knowledge of advanced PCBA manufacturing processes.

• Cross-functional Collaborations: Experience working with various teams toward shared business goals.

• Strategic Problem Solving: Experience solving real operational and business problems.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Exposure to customer-facing and supplier-facing activities.

• Career Clarity: Uncover your core strengths to define your future leadership path.

• Professional Networking: A lasting network of mentors and industry leaders.

Application Process
Interested to be part of the team?

• Application Deadline: 31 October 2026.

• Selection Process: Shortlisted candidates will participate in psychometric assessments and panel interviews.

• Onboarding: Successful candidates will join Sanmina as full-time employees in January 2027.

• Program Completion: Upon successful completion, Management Trainees will take on full-time positions to further specialize their skill sets and continue their leadership development journey.

Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Arrangement: Flexible Working Arrangement

About the Role
Are you looking to kick-start your career in the financial services industry with opportunities for continuous learning and career growth?
We are looking for motivated, enthusiastic, and driven individuals to join our team as Management Trainees .
Whether you are a fresh graduate or have limited working experience, we welcome you to apply. You will receive structured professional training, mentorship from experienced leaders, and continuous on-the-job coaching to help you develop the knowledge and skills needed to build a successful career.
This position offers a mid-management career progression pathway above the Financial Planner level. Candidates without prior experience may begin at an entry-level position, with opportunities to develop their expertise and progress into a management role within approximately two to three years, subject to performance and development.
If you have a positive attitude, enjoy interacting with people, and are eager to learn and grow professionally, we would love to hear from you!
Key Responsibilities

• Understand clients' financial goals, needs, and objectives before recommending suitable financial and investment solutions.

• Review clients' financial plans regularly and provide recommendations based on changes in their financial circumstances and goals.

• Assist clients in managing and optimising their investment portfolios to support their long-term financial objectives.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients.

• Participate in company training programmes, workshops, and industry seminars to continuously enhance professional knowledge and skills.

What We Offer

• Basic allowance with additional performance-based incentives.

• Paid structured professional training programme.

• One-to-one coaching and mentorship from experienced leaders.

• Clear career progression and management development opportunities.

• Supportive and collaborative working environment.

• Flexible working hours and hybrid working arrangements.

• Opportunities for local and overseas business travel.

• Recognition and rewards for outstanding performance.

Working Arrangement
We offer a flexible, appointment-based working arrangement that allows you to plan your working hours according to your schedule.
Work locations are generally determined by client appointments, giving you the flexibility to choose suitable venues for client meetings.
However, attendance at designated company training sessions and meetings is mandatory and will require you to be physically present at the office.
Professional Certification Support
In addition to the training provided, we offer financial support for the four required industry certification papers: M5, M9, M9A, and HI .
Examination Sponsorship:

• First attempt: 100% sponsored.

• Second attempt: 50% sponsored if the first attempt is unsuccessful.

• Third attempt: 25% sponsored.

Certification Rewards:
Successful candidates will also receive monetary rewards upon passing each certification paper:

• First paper passed: SGD 100.

• Second paper passed: SGD 200.

• Third paper passed: SGD 300.

• Fourth paper passed: SGD 400.

Job Requirements

• Minimum qualification of Polytechnic Diploma, GCE A-Level, Bachelor's Degree, Professional Degree, or equivalent.

• Must be at least 21 years old, in accordance with MAS regulatory requirements.

• Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome to apply.

• Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

• Good communication with interpersonal skills, self-motivated, goal-oriented, and driven to achieve results.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team.

• Experience in working in corporate environment is a plus.

Additional Benefits

• Employee discounts.

• Flexible working schedule.

• Professional development and continuous training.

• Hybrid working arrangement.

• Career advancement opportunities.

Start your professional journey with us and discover opportunities to learn, grow, and build a rewarding career!

description:
Job Purpose:
Management Trainee will undergo 2 years’ training program to become an Outlet Manager with the Job Purpose and Main Duties as below:
This position is responsible for the daily operations of an outlet, including the selection, development and performance management of employees, overseeing the inventory and ordering of food and supplies, optimising profits and ensuring that customers are satisfied with their dining experience.
Main Duties:

• Oversee and manage all areas of an outlet assigned to the job holder and accountable to the Area Manager for the delivery of efficient, quality and profitable service. Keep Area Manager promptly and fully informed of all issues and take prompt corrective action where necessary or suggest alternative courses of action.

• Adhere to Han’s standards and service levels to increase sales and minimise costs, including food, beverage, supplies, utility and labour costs.

• Ensure that all daily sale collections are securely banked and personnel/payroll related administrative duties are completed accurately, on time and in accordance to Han’s policies and procedures.

• Enforce sanitary practices for food handling, general cleanliness, and maintenance of kitchen and dining areas. Ensure compliance with operational standards and Han’s policies.

• Ensure consistent high quality of food preparation and service.

• Supervise portion control and quantities of preparation to minimise waste.

• Estimate food needs and work with Central Procurement to place orders and schedule delivery.

• Ensure customer service in all areas. Respond to complaints, and take appropriate immediate corrective actions. Educate staff on prevention of future occurrence.

• Ensure that proper security procedures are in place to protect staff, customers and company assets.

• Ensure safe working and guest environment to reduce the risk of injury and accidents. Complete accident reports promptly in the event a customer or employee is injured.

• Management shifts which include: daily decision making, scheduling and planning.

• Interview job applicants. Direct recruitment, supervision, development and, when necessary, termination of employment of employees.

• Conduct orientation which includes safety briefing, and oversee the training of new employees.

• Develop employees by providing ongoing feedback, establishing performance expectations and by conducting performance appraisal.

Requirements:

• Diploma with 1-year experience working in the F&B or Hospitality Industry

• Need to perform shift work and work on Public Holiday and weekends

• 6 days work per week

• Physically fit as require to stand long hours

• Good team player with position work attitude.

• Must be able to climb up to containers for inspection.

• 5.5 Days work week

• Performance incentive (annual increment and annual performance bonus)
